标题: La Zarza , el pueblo que resurgió de las cenizas : ? Utilizaron el tejado de mi
正文: La Zarza, el pueblo que resurgió de las cenizas: «Utilizaron el tejado de mi casa para parar el fuego» Los supervivientes recuerdan lo ocurrido el 31 de julio de hace ochenta años en un municipio vallisoletano arrasado por las llamas La Zarza En los pueblos de Castilla la historia reside en la memoria de los mayores, aquellas personas que en un tiempo pasado jugueteaban en las calles ... del mismo lugar donde ocho decenios después aún residen, en las fotografías conservadas y en las casas que ya no están. La Zarza, un pueblo vallisoletano rodeados de campos de cereales y pinares, fue testigo a mediados del pasado siglo, concretamente el 31 de julio de 1945, de un voraz incendio que asoló tres cuartas partes de las viviendas. Y ahora, ochenta años después, la historia se esconde tras las puertas reconstruidas de lo que un día fueron cenizas. La versión oficial, registrada en los escritos de las autoridades de la época, acerca del origen del incendio recoge que en una de las casas una niña arrojó cenizas en el corral y el viento sopló tan fuerte que originó el infierno de llamas y humo. Como en cualquier historia, existe otra versión que habla de que fue el padre de las niñas quien quiso cocinarse un huevo frito en el corral y prendió el pueblo. En cualquier casom basta con indagar en los documentos conservados de la época y preguntar por el fuego del 45 en algunas viviendas de La Zarza para comprender la magnitud de la tragedia. La 'niña' a la que atribuyeron el fuego escribió en 2015 al Ayuntamiento para lamentar que la acusación fue fruto del «ambiente de odio entre guerras» Amelia Garrido, que en 1945 tenía 8 años, reside en el número 25 de la calle Real, donde se originó el fuego. «Esta fue la casa que utilizaron para el fuego. Các chuyên gia cứu hỏa và kỹ thuật công trình cảnh báo những tòa nhà bị ảnh hưởng trong vụ cháy chung cư ở Hong Kong đang đứng trước nguy cơ suy yếu cấu trúc. Dave Downey, cựu chỉ huy lực lượng cứu hỏa và cứu hộ hạt Miami-Dade (Mỹ), nói với CNN rằng đám cháy đã lan nhanh và dữ dội, “tấn công trực diện” vào kết cấu các tòa nhà. “Dù là công trình bê tông cốt thép, nó chỉ chịu được một ngưỡng nhiệt nhất định. Lửa vẫn tiếp tục bùng lên tại các tầng cao của ít nhất hai tòa nhà, theo báo South China Morning Post (SCMP). 标题: Hong Kong : ocho detenidos por corrupción tras el incendio de Tai Po que deja 12
正文: Corrupción y tragedia en el mayor incendio de Hong Kong en décadas La Comisión Independiente Contra la Corrupción de Hong Kong (ICAC) ha detenido a ocho personas por su presunta implicación en irregularidades en las obras de renovación del complejo Wang Fuk Court —también citado como Hung Fook Court— en Tai Po, escenario del devastador incendio que ha causado al menos 128 muertos y ha dejado a más de 200 vecinos desaparecidos. Las pesquisas conectan ahora la posible corrupción en el proyecto con fallos de seguridad que habrían amplificado la magnitud de la tragedia. De la tragedia a la investigación por corrupción El fuego se declaró el 26 de noviembre en el complejo residencial Wang Fuk Court, un conjunto de ocho torres de 31 plantas en el distrito de Tai Po, en los Nuevos Territorios de Hong Kong. En cuestión de minutos, las llamas treparon por el entramado de andamios de bambú y redes de protección que envolvían los edificios por unas obras de renovación exterior, hasta convertir siete de los bloques en una sola pared de fuego visible a kilómetros. Las autoridades cifran por ahora en 128 los fallecidos, con al menos 79 heridos y más de 200 personas aún desaparecidas, en lo que ya se considera el incendio residencial más mortífero de la ciudad desde 1948. Entre las víctimas hay un bombero que murió durante las labores de rescate. El caso ha reavivado el debate sobre la seguridad en la vivienda pública y la regulación de las obras de rehabilitación de grandes complejos residenciales. Las primeras investigaciones apuntan a una combinación letal: materiales altamente inflamables en paneles y sellados exteriores, andamiaje continuo entre bloques y sistemas de alarma contra incendios que no funcionaron adecuadamente, lo que habría retrasado la evacuación de cientos de residentes, muchos de ellos ancianos. 标题: В Гонконге произошел крупнейший пожар за десятилетия : 55 человек погибли
正文: Мощный пожар, вспыхнувший в жилом комплексе Ван Фук на севере Гонконга, привёл к тяжелейшим последствиям для города. По данным властей, число погибших достигло как минимум 55 человек, при этом около 280 жителей остаются пропавшими без вести. Пожар стал самым трагическим для Гонконга с 1996 года, когда в результате аналогичного по масштабу происшествия погиб 41 человек. Несколько десятков пострадавших были госпитализированы, и часть из них находится в критическом состоянии. Глава гонконгской администрации Джон Ли выразил соболезнования семьям погибших и пообещал оказать всю необходимую помощь. По предварительным данным, пожар мог начаться на внешних строительных лесах одной из башен, которая в момент происшествия находилась на реконструкции. Распространению пламени по комплексу способствовали сильный ветер, бамбуковые леса и защитная пластиковая сетка, а также строительные материалы, которые, как предполагают власти, не соответствовали нормам пожарной безопасности. Министр безопасности Крис Тан заявил, что скорость распространения огня была «необычной», а на фасадах и у окон некоторых зданий обнаружены плиты пенополистирола, который легко воспламеняется и ускоряет развитие пожара. Пожарная служба столкнулась с серьёзными трудностями при тушении огня. По словам заместителя директора пожарной службы Дерека Армстронга Чана, спасателям приходилось пробиваться сквозь плотный дым и нестабильные конструкции, что значительно замедляло работу. В операции приняли участие более 140 пожарных машин и несколько десятков карет скорой помощи. Несмотря на это отдельные башни продолжали гореть и спустя сутки после начала пожара. Комплекс Ван Фук состоит из восьми высотных блоков, построенных в 1980-х годах и рассчитанных почти на две тысячи квартир. 标题: 《 尘封档案 》 拾遗之203 ： 吴山秘宅失窃案 - 博客
正文: 本文转载自《逐木鸟》“尘封档案”系列 一、 浙江省城杭州西湖东南侧，有一座海拔百余米的小山，因春秋时为吴国南界，故名吴山。吴山虽不高，却也山势起伏，绵亘数里，山体伸入杭州市区。吴山顶上有极目阁，登阁览胜，左为西子湖，右是钱塘江，杭州全城，尽收眼底；更且通山葱翠，百鸟啁啾，花香泌人，空气清新，故长期以来一向被人们视为游览胜地，居家佳境。本世纪30年代中期，时任国民党复兴社特务处处长的大特务头子戴笠，以巧取豪夺的手法在吴山脚下西临西湖一侧，霸占了一幢住宅，作为其在杭州从事反革命活动和寻欢作乐的秘密据点。 本文所叙述的这起特大盗窃案件，就发生在这幢秘宅里。 戴笠秘宅日常的警戒任务由复兴社特务处的一个警卫小组负责。这个警卫小组共有7名特务，自组长寿光发以下，人人都是百发百中的神枪手，而且都会拳术。戴笠来杭州时，必下榻秘宅，警卫小组则负责秘宅的外围守卫。戴笠个人的安全，由其带来的副官和贴身卫士负责。戴笠不在杭州时，警卫小组的特务则担负起保卫宅邸安全和日常清洁卫生的责任。相对而言，自然是后一种责任轻松，所以，寿光发这一班人常常希望戴老板不要来杭州，即便来也最好不要在杭州过夜。 1936年9月、10月，整整60天戴笠未来杭州。寿光发相他的部下过得轻松自在，人人额手称幸。可惜好景不长，从10月31日到11月12日这不到两星期的时间里，戴笠竟接连3次来杭州，一共住了6个晚上，把警卫小组搞得疲惫不堪。末一次戴笠从上海来，带了个妖艳的姘妇，住了一夜于12日下午坐汽车同赴南京了。戴笠一走，寿光发7人个个欢天喜地，谁也没有意识到当晚将会有梁上君子光临，搞一个使他们人人过堂、个个上刑的大动作。 寿光发指挥部下清扫过宅邸后，下令道：“今晚这里留2个人值勤，其余人员准许自由活动。外出人员必须做到两点：一是务必在明晨7时前返回；二是要把去向讲清，留下地址，免得有急事没处找。” 一番计议后，决定让两个在杭州没有亲友的组员张森林、洪宝贵留下值勤；寿光发、恽靖、黄明贵、胡安、唐得康5人均外出，或走亲、或访友、也有去相好家串门或逛妓院的。 张森林、洪宝贵待寿光发等人走后，关上秘宅大门，落了锁，看看天色渐晚，便去厨房炒了几个菜，开了两瓶烧酒，缩在卧室里畅饮。过了一会，外面淅淅沥沥下起了小雨，两个出去各处转了一圈，见门窗都关着，便回到卧室继续喝酒。张、洪两个酒量都还可以，每人喝光1斤烧酒犹自不醉，又喝着茶聊到10点钟过后才睡觉。 下半夜，雨停了，却刮起了风。张森林睡得很死，什么声音也没有听见。洪宝贵也睡得沉，却比张森林略略好些，拂晓时分，他听见外面偶尔传来“砰砰”的声响。初时，他以为是梦境中的幻觉，没有在意；后来睡意渐淡，终于分辨出那是风吹动窗子的撞击声音，但其时脑子还未清醒，所以只抬头看看不是卧室的窗后便又合上了眼睛。过了一会，一阵大风吹来，那窗子“砰”过后，紧接着又传来玻璃破碎的声音。这一下把洪宝贵彻底惊醒了，他马上分辨出这是后面院子那里传来的，于是一骨碌爬起来，推醒张森林： “老张，戴先生房间的窗玻璃被风吹得碰碎了！” 张森林睡瞠惺松地问道：“什么？” 洪宝贵又说了一遍。 张森林一下子清醒了，比洪宝贵还清醒，惊叫道：“那房间的窗子关得好好的，怎么会吹开呢？不好——难道遭贼偷了？！”话音刚落，早已跳到地下，迅速穿上衣服，开了门直往后院奔。 洪宝贵被这话惊呆了，怔了一怔，连忙尾随而去。两人一前一后跑到后院门口，院门关得好好的，上面的那把清代的大铜锁依旧牢牢地锁住了两个圆形门环。洪宝贵暗松一口气，连说“还好”。但是，接下来就“好”不起来了。张森林掏出钥匙把大铜锁打开，推门进去，定睛一看，顿时呆若木鸡—— 戴笠的卧室房门洞开；两扇窗子，一开一闭，几块玻璃已经碎落地下 洪宝贵直跺脚：“糟糕！窃贼来过了！” 张森林又惊又气，牙齿咬得“格格”响？“他妈的！好大胆的贼，竟敢太岁头上动土！” 两人走到卧室门前，因考虑到要保护现场，所以不敢往里迈步，站在门口探头探脑往里一看，头都大了：一套红木镶银家具的橱门、抽斗以及屋角那个保险箱都已被撬开，室内满地都是乱纸，被风吹得团团打转。两人对视一眼，不约而同哀叹道：“完了！” 接下来该怎么办？洪宝贵年轻，已经吓得转不过脑子了。张森林比他大8岁，已过而立之年，特务饭也多吃了几年，总算勉强镇定下未，想了一会，总算有了一个主意：洪宝贵留在这里看守现场，他立刻照昨天寿光发几人留下的地址去紧急通知其余5人迅即赶回秘宅。如何处理，还得由组长寿光发拿主意。但是，为避嫌疑，他们两人待会儿绝对不能进入现场，以免在戴笠卧室里留下脚印，讲不清楚。 20分钟后，去离戴笠秘宅最近的亲戚处的小特务恽靖赶回来了。又过了一会，黄明贵、胡安也火急返回了。组长寿光发最后一个回来，踏进秘宅大门时正好7点钟。众特务见组长来了，便拥着寿光发往后院去。寿光发站在房门外，瞥见室内那副情景，

O aparelho ajudava o fotógrafo a economizar com mototáxi e outros meios de transporte, mas se tornou um problema na última quinta-feira, 23, quando explodiu na sala de estar de Igor e da esposa, Clara. - Receba as principais notícias direto no WhatsApp! 正文: Großer Brand in Scharnitz Stefan Dietrich 	 		25. Feber 2026 	 	 	 	Am 2. November 1893 erlebte Scharnitz eine der größten Katastrophen seiner Geschichte. Gegen 1 Uhr früh brach mitten im Ort ein Brand aus, der in kurzer Zeit fünf Häuser und die Kirche erfasste. Das Feuer bekam reichlich Nahrung durch die Erntevorräte, die in den Tennen der Bauernhäuser lagerten. Unser Foto stammt aus der Ortschronik Scharnitz und zeigt das Ausmaß der Zerstörung. Da sich die Poststation in einem der brennenden Häuser befand, konnte man die Feuerwehren der umliegenden Orte nicht telegrafisch verständigen. So wurde ein reitender Bote nach Mittenwald geschickt, um Alarm zu schlagen. Bereits eine Stunde nach Ausbruch des Brandes traf dann auch die Feuerwehr Mittenwald ein. Die Wehren aus Seefeld und Zirl folgten später. Da die Scharnitzer Feuerwehrspritze nicht einsatzfähig war, bildeten die Bewohner zum Löschen eine Eimerkette, mit der Wasser aus der Isar herangeschafft wurde. „Trotzdem war nichts mehr zu retten. Der Kirchturm stand in Flammen, die Glocken waren herabgestürzt. Es konnten nur mehr die umliegenden Häuser geschützt werden“, berichtet die Ortschronik. Schließlich stürzte ein Teil des Kirchturms ein und zerstörte dabei das Dach und das Gewölbe des Gotteshauses. Kurz zuvor hatten noch einige junge Scharnitzer unter Lebensgefahr Gegenstände aus der Kirche und der Sakristei gerettet. Bald nach der Katastrophe wurde eine Hilfsaktion für die Leidtragenden des Großfeuers gestartet. Denn die Not war groß. Zu den am schwersten Betroffenen gehörten der Lehrer Josef Mariner und seine Familie. 正文: 习近平总书记引领全党树立和践行正确政绩观 来源： 新华社 2026-02-25 09:33:00 原标题：实干担当 为民造福——习近平总书记引领全党树立和践行正确政绩观 新华社北京2月25日电 题：实干担当 为民造福——习近平总书记引领全党树立和践行正确政绩观 新华社记者 一个胸怀远大目标、立志于中华民族千秋伟业的政党，必然凭实绩立身致远。 “政绩观问题是一个根本性问题，关乎立党为公、执政为民。”政绩为谁而树、树什么样的政绩、靠什么树政绩，是初心之问、使命之问，也是时代之问、实践之问。 对于政绩观，习近平总书记始终有着深邃思考与明确指引，锚定为民造福的根本目的，坚守求真务实的基本路径，把握科学精准的衡量标尺，倡导实干担当的鲜明导向。 近日，中共中央办公厅印发《关于在全党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育的通知》。《通知》指出，经党中央同意，在全党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育。 “坚持从实际出发、按规律办事，自觉为人民出政绩、以实干出政绩。” “十五五”开局之年，习近平总书记发出号召，激励广大党员干部进一步树立和践行正确政绩观，跃马扬鞭、马不停蹄，投身强国建设、民族复兴的关键一程。 （一）为政之道 常思常想——“树立和践行正确政绩观，起决定性作用的是党性” 2026年1月，中央党校，省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神专题研讨班开班。 开局之年“第一课”，习近平总书记阐明新征程上树立和践行正确政绩观的深远考量：“‘十五五’开局之年，无论是制定规划还是部署实施，都需要有正确的政绩观。省市县乡领导班子将陆续换届，强调政绩观也很有针对性。” 习近平总书记鞭辟入里，深刻分析两种不同政绩观的内在本质—— “正确政绩观要求我们坚持从实际出发、按规律办事，通过科学决策和实干苦干，创造经得起实践和历史检验、真正造福人民、得到群众公认的业绩。” “错误政绩观则是从个人或小团体利益出发，心浮气躁、急功近利、弄虚作假、盲目蛮干，搞‘形象工程’‘政绩工程’，留下包袱和隐患，引起人民群众强烈不满。” 时间回到2004年2月，主政一方的习近平同志参加中央党校省部级主要领导干部专题研究班。 在发言中，习近平同志表示“正确的政绩观指导我们正确地改造主观世界”，并条分缕析阐释树立正确政绩观必须着重解决的问题。那一年，他在《浙江日报》“之江新语”专栏陆续发表文章，阐明政绩观的是非标准与实践路径。 “我们每一个领导干部都要常思常想‘入党为什么，当“官”干什么，身后留什么’。”从地方到中央，一路走来，树立和践行正确政绩观的叩问与思索，从未停息。 上世纪90年代初，福建省领导科学研究会曾邀时任宁德地委书记习近平对青年领导干部谈谈如何干好工作的问题，一篇《从政杂谈》引经据典、发人深省—— “在中国几千年的文明史上，帝王将相何其多，但在百姓头脑中留下记忆的也不过百来号人。”“青史留名与官阶并无本质联系，而是与做事相联系。” “有些人入仕数十年，终为名利所困，或一事无成，或身败名裂。究其原因，是没有树立正确的当官宗旨。”“当官，当共产党的‘官’，只有一个宗旨，就是造福于民。” 汲古润今，鉴往知来，习近平总书记始终自觉从马克思主义理论和党的光辉历史中重温为政初心，总是善于从中华文明积淀的智慧中汲取为政之道。 在中央政治局专题民主生活会上，明确强调“我们的一切都应该为了人民，没有自我，先公后私，克己奉公”“我们最核心的这一层人，应该是具有献身精神的一批人”；主持中央政治局集体学习时，一一列举“郑人买履”“掩耳盗铃”“揠苗助长”“画蛇添足”等讽刺形而上学的故事，要求按照实际决定工作方针。 2022年，中央党校中青班开班式上，面对年轻干部，习近平总书记的论断掷地有声：“创造业绩，必须解决好为谁创造业绩、创造什么样的业绩、怎样创造业绩的问题，也就是要解决好政绩观问题。说到底，树立和践行正确政绩观，起决定性作用的是党性。” 百年党史峥嵘。中央党校内，立于广场上的一块巨石两面，“实事求是”“为人民服务”的箴言格外醒目，校园两侧，焦裕禄、谷文昌塑像静立，映照始终不渝的初心、不随境迁的追求、不为时易的坚持。 扎根黄土地的岁月，让青年习近平“懂得了什么叫实际，什么叫实事求是，什么叫群众”。因而，“今后如果有条件、有机会，我一定要从政，做一些为老百姓办好事的工作”。 标题: Recopilación de casos y accidentes en 2025 en Coahuila y Durango
正文: En la Comarca Lagunera y zonas aledañas en Coahuila y Durango se vivieron una serie de incidentes críticos durante el año 2025, que abarcan desde accidentes viales, fallecimientos por presunta negligencia y hasta operativos de seguridad nacional que derivaron en detenciones importantes. En MILENIO realizamos un recuento de los casos relevantes que más impactaron a los laguneros en orden cronológico. Atropellamiento en la calzada Abastos Fue el 10 de febrero de este 2025 cuando alrededor del mediodía, una mujer identificada como Ofelia Hernández Barbosa, de 54 años, murió instantáneamente tras ser arrollada en la calzada Abastos de Torreón. Según testimonios, el conductor de un auto Volkswagen Bora que viajaba a exceso de velocidad la embistió mientras ella intentaba cruzar la calle. El responsable, Alonso 'N', de 31 años, huyó inicialmente del lugar, pero se entregó a las autoridades media hora más tarde. Incendio cobra la vida de una adolescente embarazada El 24 de marzo quedará en la memoria de los laguneros, pues durante la madrugada de este trágico día, un incendio en un domicilio de la colonia Luis Donaldo Colosio en Gómez Palacio, cobró la vida de una adolescente de 13 años. Sarai, 'la güerita' como solían llamarla, estaba embarazada y murió durante el incendio. El resto de la familia de su novio logró salir de la casa con vida, sin embargo, ella quedó atrapada en la cocina. El incidente ocurrió a las 4:00 de la madrugada cuando un estallido por acumulación de gas alertó a los vecinos. Algunos empleados de la empresa estaban almorzando en el edificio en ese momento, mientras que otros habían salido de la oficina, dijo Condro. Las imágenes difundidas por el cananl de noticias Kompas TV mostraban a decenas de bomberos intentando evacuar a la gente, y algunos sacaban bolsas para cadáveres del edificio. Se vio a algunos empleados escapar de los pisos superiores utilizando escaleras portátiles. 正文: Solidarité et résignation après l’incendie à Castres : les habitants de l’immeuble sinistré récupèrent ce qu’ils peuvent L’incendie d’un immeuble à Castres laisse des locataires désemparés face aux décombres. Entre suie et gravats, chacun tente de sauver quelques biens encore intacts. Un peu d’espoir et beaucoup de résignation : les locataires des appartements situés au 30 avenue Albert 1er à Castres étaient de retour sur les lieux, ce mardi matin, pour récupérer dans leurs logements ce qui pouvait l’être, après le violent incendie qui a ravagé le bâtiment dimanche. Certains appartements sont inaccessibles Accompagnés des sapeurs-pompiers, certains ont pu accéder à leur appartement pour retrouver l’essentiel. Sans trop d’illusions, comme ce papa venu aider sa fille : "Tous les faux plafonds sont déchiquetés, tout est tombé, il y a de la suie partout, de l’eau, ça s’infiltre partout… On va récupérer les vêtements, qu’on va laver plusieurs fois." Sa fille, Pauline, enceinte, confirme : "On va essayer de récupérer le textile, la vaisselle… Après, tout ce qui est électrique ou électronique, c’est fichu." Ordinateurs, machines à laver, télévisions… La plupart des locataires de l’immeuble savent qu’ils ne les récupéreront pas. La sœur de Pauline a d’ailleurs lancé une cagnotte en ligne pour l’aider à reconstruire rapidement sa vie. 正文: The worst fire to hit Hong Kong since 1948 has left an unspeakable tragedy: at least 128 people dead, 79 injured, and dozens still missing. The Wang Fuk Court complex, with its eight skyscrapers in the Tai Po area, became a death trap within minutes. The complex houses approximately 4,600 residents across 1,984 apartments, according to the 2021 census, nearly 40% of whom are aged 65 or older. Authorities and residents say this disaster could have been prevented if safety protocols in high-rise buildings had been followed. Skyscrapers—symbols of modern architecture and urban development—are not always safe. History shows that fires in tall buildings can result in hundreds of casualties. Joelma Building – São Paulo, Brazil (1974): On February 1, 1974, the Joelma building, a landmark in São Paulo, became the site of one of Brazil’s most devastating tragedies. Within 20 minutes, the fire spread throughout the entire building, killing 179–189 people and injuring around 300. It remains one of the deadliest high-rise fires in history. The fire began due to an electrical short circuit in an air conditioner on the 12th floor and spread rapidly, fueled by flammable materials in the building. Most victims died from smoke inhalation and burns, unable to escape the fast-moving flames. Some jumped from the building in desperate attempts to survive. In addition to the initial fault, inadequate emergency exits and failures in the fire suppression system worsened the situation. Grenfell Tower – London, United Kingdom (2017): On June 14, 2017, the 24-story Grenfell Tower in West London went up in flames after a faulty refrigerator sparked a fire that spread rapidly due to the building’s flammable cladding, installed during a 2015–2016 renovation. 正文: Smoke, Green Mesh and Questions: Inside the Hong Kong Tower Blaze That Shook a City Night fell over Tai Po and the usual hum of the district — scooters, karaoke from a nearby shop, the distant clink of cutlery from dai pai dong stalls — was broken by an urgent, metallic staccato: sirens, shouted orders, the dull thump of water hoses. A row of 32-storey towers, sheathed in the familiar green construction mesh and bamboo scaffolding that punctuate Hong Kong’s skyline, glowed orange. Flames licked the temporary sheeting, and a city that for decades has lived on vertical tightropes watched, horrified, as one of its own high-rise homes burned. When the smoke finally cleared, the official toll stood at 55 dead, 72 injured and nearly 300 people — some reports say 279 — still uncontactable. Among the dead was a firefighter, a grim reminder that every rescue carries risk. For many in Hong Kong, where affordable housing is scarce and whole families have shared single flats for generations, the loss is both intimate and collective. What Happened at Wang Fuk Court? Wang Fuk Court is not an unfamiliar sight to residents of this city: eight tightly packed blocks, roughly 2,000 flats and some 4,600 people living in a compact grid of community life — elders playing Chinese chess in stairwells, kids running along the corridors, the smell of wok-fried garlic drifting through unlocked windows. 正文: Mayor Zohran Mamdani: Good morning, everyone. 标题: Incendio consume vivienda en colonia Puerta del Oriente – Periódico Zócalo | Not
正文: Saltillo Por Daniel Revilla Publicado el lunes, 16 de febrero del 2026 a las 20:55 Saltillo, Coah.– Una intensa movilización de cuerpos de emergencia se registró la noche de este lunes en la colonia Puerta del Oriente, luego de que una vivienda ardiera en llamas sobre la calle Convenciones. Fue cerca de las 20:00 horas cuando vecinos comenzaron a escuchar detonaciones y chasquidos provenientes del interior del inmueble, similares a los que provoca un cortocircuito. Alarmados, salieron de sus casas y en cuestión de segundos confirmaron que la vivienda ya estaba envuelta por el fuego, cuyas llamas se extendían con rapidez hacia el patio. El reporte al sistema de emergencias provocó la inmediata llegada de elementos del Cuerpo de Bomberos, quienes trabajaron intensamente para sofocar el incendio que ya había consumido prácticamente todo el interior, además de diversas pertenencias acumuladas en el exterior. Tras controlar la situación, los apagafuegos señalaron que el siniestro presuntamente se originó por una sobrecarga eléctrica, ya que el inmueble presentaba conexiones irregulares a la red de energía, lo que habría detonado el cortocircuito inicial. Durante las labores de inspección y remoción de escombros, los bomberos lograron rescatar con vida a un cachorrito de aproximadamente tres meses de edad que se encontraba dentro de la casa. Vecinos del sector indicaron que la vivienda se encuentra abandonada desde hace tiempo, sin embargo, denunciaron que con frecuencia es utilizada por pandilleros para consumir sustancias ilícitas, por lo que, solicitaron mayor presencia policial y recorridos preventivos en la zona para evitar que el inmueble vuelva a convertirse en punto de reunión y riesgo para la comunidad. 正文: Multiple displaced after fire at apartment complex in Bellevue According to NFD officials, crews were called there for reports of a dryer fire. NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - Update: Multiple people have been displaced after a fire at an apartment complex in Bellevue on Saturday morning, according to Nashville Fire Department District 19 Chief Aaron Sparkman. Sparkman said NFD crews responded to the Slate Apartments at 7439 Highway 70 South at around 10 a.m. for reports of an appliance fire. When crews arrived at the apartments, they found the fire in a first-floor apartment, which was in the middle of the building. The fire continued to spread throughout the building as crews worked to contain it. One firefighter was transported to a hospital with minor burns to his arms, and some other firefighters also reported some heat cramps. However, no resident was injured in the incident. Sparkman said he believes the building is a total loss, with 12 total units impacted by the fire. The apartment complex has reached out to the American Red Cross, and they are assisting those who have been displaced. Sparkman said there was another fire at this apartment complex “in the last couple years or so.” Earlier: According to Sparkman, 15 engine companies, 6 truck companies, two rescues, three or four ambulances, four or five fire chiefs responded to the incident. 标题: Incendio en edificio de Barranquilla : hombre murió al caer de piso tras huir
正文: Blu Radio es una cadena de radio colombiana, propiedad de Caracol Televisión en donde encontrará las noticias de Colombia y el mundo sobre deportes, actualidad, tecnología, política, fútbol. Fredy Mandón Castro lamenta no haber podido contestar a tiempo la llamada que le realizó su hermano Wilson Mandón, de 60 años, para informarle que había un incendio en el conjunto Flores de Recreo, donde vivía desde hace 12 años. Contó que, a las 4:30 de la madrugada del domingo, justo cuando se estaba presentando la emergencia por el incendio en la torre A y B del conjunto, su hermano Wilson lo llamó, pero él solo vio su teléfono hasta las 6:00 de la mañana, cuando la noticia ya estaba por todas las redes sociales. “Él me hizo una llamada a las 4:30 de la mañana, pero desafortunadamente no escuché la llamada y de pronto era que estaba en pánico pidiéndome ayuda, pero no tuve la oportunidad de contestarle”, detalló Fredy. (Lea también: Administración de conjunto que se incendió en Barranquilla dio desolador mensaje: “No se pudo hacer nada”) A Wilson, quien era administrador de empresas y vivía solo, le habría ganado el desespero y murió al caer del piso 8 de su apartamento, cuando intentó evacuar la edificación amarrado de una sábana que no resistió su peso, contó Fredy. “Mi hermano, en su desespero creo yo, por la afectación del humo pensó, abrió la puerta del apartamento y, al ver tanto humo, se puso nervioso, entró en pánico y tomó la decisión de pensar que eso se estaba incendiando totalmente, pero únicamente había humo y calor, entonces entró en pánico y tomó la decisión de amarrarse y tratar de bajar con una sábana. Desafortunadamente, la sábana no aguantó su peso y cayó al vacío”, indicó el hermano de la víctima. Wilson Mandón trabajaba administrando una empresa familiar que tienen en la calle 30, en Barranquilla. El hombre era padre de dos hijos que viven en Cúcuta, a donde será llevado su cuerpo en las próximas horas. * Pulzo.com se escribe con Z LO ÚLTIMO

正文: 每日经济新闻 2025-11-27 07:52:59 每经编辑｜陈柯名 据新华社，香港警方和消防部门27日凌晨召开记者会宣布，大埔屋邨宏福苑火灾目前已造成44人遇难，45人受伤。警方已拘捕3名涉嫌误杀的男子。 图片来源：每经记者 孔泽思 据央视新闻，11月26日下午，香港大埔宏福苑发生五级火警。27日凌晨，香港特区行政长官李家超表示，极度重视本次火灾，目前首要工作是扑灭火情及救助伤者。现场火情已经基本受控。 最新现场图，图片来源：每经记者 孔泽思 11月27日凌晨，香港特区政府保安局局长邓炳强表示，根据现场初步调查情况分析，本次火灾不排除刑事案件的可能性，目前已经交由香港警方进一步调查。 27日，香港警方以涉嫌误杀罪拘捕负责维修大厦的工程公司三名负责人。 据新华社，香港警方展开调查，发现建筑物外墙有保护网、防水帆布、塑料布，疑未符合防火标准，另有一座未波及的大厦每层电梯大堂窗外都有发泡胶包封，易燃且可能加速火势蔓延，不排除发泡胶是迅速蔓延的原因。 警方发现一工程公司负责安装上述相关材料，相信该工程公司负责人严重疏忽，导致火势迅速蔓延，造成重大伤亡。警方拘捕的3人为工程公司负责人，包括2名董事、1名工程顾问，年龄介于52岁至68岁。 此前，每经记者了解到，伤者中有一位为消防队队长，其左脚受伤，有一位消防员热衰竭送院，另有一名消防员死亡。26日晚，香港消防处官网页面已变为黑白色。 在本次行动中，香港消防处一共派出了128辆消防车和57辆救护车，总共出动了767名消防和救护人员，还有400名警务人员，合计出动上千名救援人员。 据新京报，香港大埔区议员李文杰表示，目前疏散区域等待的居民超500人，主要是逃出的住户以及刚下班回家的居民。受灾5栋楼约有8000到10000人，老年人占比较多。 据九派新闻援引粤tv消息，港大埔建筑外墙棚架起火事故持续引发关注。11月26日，深圳莲塘口岸，深圳消防车队经莲塘口岸，跨境驰援香港大埔火灾。 另据南方+报道，26日晚，有网友发现深圳莲塘口岸附近出现消防车辆，猜测是内地消防支援香港大埔火灾。对此，记者向香港消防处求证，香港消防处表示目前没有向内地要求支援。 此前报道，据每经记者了解，事发的宏福苑正在进行维修工程，小区外立面都围着绿色工程网，搭满了竹棚架。 香港中原地产官网显示，宏福苑入伙日期是1983年，距今楼龄已有42年，位于大埔市中心大埔公路元洲仔3821号，邻近港铁大埔墟站。宏福苑共有8座，提供1984个单位。 宏福苑是香港“居者有其屋计划屋苑”，是香港的资助出售公共房屋计划之一，由香港房屋委员会兴建公营房屋并廉价售予低收入市民。 图片来源：央视新闻 值得一提的是，宏福苑去年10月举行过火警演习暨消防安全讲座。同时，在去年7月—8月的工程解说会上，有业主提问棚网是否有防火功能时，相关工程顾问公司及承建商表示，工程所使用的棚网必须具有阻燃性，但并非完全绝燃。 对于有什么消防项目需要维修的问题，彼时相关工程顾问公司及承建商回应称，会修防火门、更换楼梯防火窗、更换消防水缸盖等；暂时未有短期内屋苑会收到消防安全工程改善命令的迹象。 有业内人士向南都N视频记者分析，此次香港大埔的五级火警，其扑救难点主要源于高层建筑“立体燃烧”的复杂性。火势在拥有40余年楼龄的旧楼外墙棚架上迅速蔓延，形成“烟囱效应”，加之强风天气，导致灭火难度极大。 据央视新闻，警务处大埔警区指挥官江永祥表示，如果有任何市民怀疑朋友或者亲友在此次火情中失联，可以致电警方，警方会尽量协助有关市民查看怀疑失踪人士去向。他表示，警方动用400名警务人员进行现场疏散和外围封锁工作。 警方还提到，受火情影响，附近部分道路需要封闭。警方会根据救援行动的进程实时调整封路范围，呼吁驾驶人员遵从现场警务人员的指示，并呼吁公众顾及自身安全，如无必要切勿前往火情范围附近一带。 另据特区政府教育局消息，大埔区多所学校将停课。 此外，大埔民政署开放五个社区会堂，并借用广福邨两间社福机构以及大尾笃的过渡性房屋等，作为临时庇护中心，给有需要的居民入住，现时有超过700人使用庇护中心。相关部门也会协助有需要的死伤者家属，申请紧急救援基金或者特别援助基金。 社会福利署表示，已派出人员到各庇护中心提供紧急的支援服务，包括社工和临床心理学家，为有需要的灾民和家属提供情绪支援。 编辑|陈柯名 杜波 校对|何小桃 每日经济新闻综合新华社、央视新闻、新京报、南方都市报、每经网等 如需转载请与《每日经济新闻》报社联系。 未经《每日经济新闻》报社授权，严禁转载或镜像，违者必究。 读者热线：4008890008 特别提醒：如果我们使用了您的图片，请作者与本站联系索取稿酬。如您不希望作品出现在本站，可联系我们要求撤下您的作品。 欢迎关注每日经济新闻APP

标题: Berlin : Zahlreiche Br?nde am Wochenende – Wo die Feuerwehr l?schen musste
正文: Die Berliner Feuerwehr musste am Samstag und bis in den Sonntagvormittag hinein zu fünf Bränden ausrücken. Verletzt wurde nieman, in den meisten Fällen konnten die Einsatzkräfte Schlimmeres verhindern. Hier eine Übersicht der Einsätze von Samstagfrüh bis Sonntagmorgen: Müllraum in Kreuzberg brennt: Am Samstag um 6.25 Uhr wurde der Brand eines 20 Quadratmeter großen Müllraums in der Kreuzberger Waldemarstraße gemeldet. Der Raum stand bei Eintreffen der Feuerwehr im Vollbrand, konnte aber schnell gelöscht werden. Die Wohnung darüber war stark verraucht und musste belüftet werden. Der Einsatz war nach einer Stunde vorbei. Morgenpost der Chefredaktion Morgenpost der Chefredaktion Balkon in Haselhorst brennt: Um 16.26 kam es zu einem Brand auf einem Balkon in der Paulsternstraße in Haselhorst. Die Flammen drohten, auf die Wohnung überzugreifen, was die Einsatzkräfte aber verhindern konnten. Ein Tanklöschfahrzeug sicherte die Wasserversorgung in der weitläufigen Wohnanlage. Küche in Spandau in Flammen: Um 19.46 Uhr brannten Einrichtungsgegenstände in der Küche einer Wohnung in der Spandauer Jüdenstraße. Auch hier konnten die Einsatzkräfte die Flammen schnell löschen. Die Wohnung wurde per Drucklüfter entraucht. Laub in einem Kellerschacht sorgt für starke Rauchentwicklung: In der Nacht zu Sonntag brannten geringe Mengen Laub in einem Kellerschacht in der Utrechter Straße in Wedding. Das kleine Feuer reichte aus, um den Keller völlig zu verrauchen. Zwei Trupps unter Atemschutz und ein Drucklüfter waren nötig, um den Keller zu entrauchen. Auch interessant Einrichtungsgegenstände auf Balkon brennen: Auf dem Balkon einer Wohnung im Erdgeschoss eines Wohnhauses standen Sonntagnacht gegen 3.15 Uhr Einrichtungsgegenstände in Flammen. Als die Feuerwehr am Einsatzort in der Borstellstraße in Steglitz eintraf, hatten die Flammen bereits auf das Wohnzimmer übergegriffen. Die Feuerwehr konnte mit 34 Einsatzkräften den Brand löschen und die Wohnung entrauchen. alu

正文: Gratwein-Straßengel: Ausgedehnter Küchenbrand in einem Mehrparteienwohnhaus Einsatzort: 8112 Gratwein-Straßengel, Ortsteil Gratwein, Am Grünanger Alarmzeit: 12:21 Uhr In der Mittagszeit des 15.02.2026 wurde die zuständige Feuerwehr Gratwein sowie die Nachbarfeuerwehren Judendorf-Straßengel, FF Eisbach-Rein sowie die Teleskopmastbühne der Btf Sappi zu einem Küchenbrand in einem Mehrparteienwohnhaus alarmiert. In der ersten Phase drang dichter schwarzer Rauch aus allen Fenstern einer Wohnung im ersten Obergeschoss. Ein Atemschutztrupp begab sich umgehend mit einer Löschleitung in die Wohnung, um den Küchenbrand zu bekämpfen. Ein weiterer Atemschutztrupp durchsuchte alle nicht betroffenen Wohnungen nach Personen und konnte 4 Personen über das druckbelüftete Stiegenhaus retten und dem Rettungsdienst übergeben. Alle Bewohner des Wohnhauses wurden durch den Rettungsdienst betreut und bei Bedarf in ein Krankenhaus zur weiteren Abklärung transportiert. Alle nicht betroffenen Wohnungen wurden in der Folge ebenfalls gründlich inspiziert. Bei der Messung mittels Mehrgasmessgerät wurden erhöhte Schadstoffkonzentrationen festgestellt. Eingeleitete Lüftungsmaßnahmen zeigten schnell Wirkung, jedenfalls wäre ein Verbleib in den Wohnungen zur Lebensgefahr geworden. In Abstimmung mit der Gemeinde konnte das Gasthaus Schusterbauer in Eisbach als erste Aufnahmestelle für die Bewohner organisiert werden. Die freigemessenen Wohnungen konnten dafür kurz zum Mitnehmen wichtiger Sachen betreten werden. Laut Auskunft vor Ort sind mehrere Personen vom Rettungsdienst betreut worden. Sechs Personen mussten in ein Krankenhaus transportiert werden. Eingesetzte Kräfte: Feuerwehr: FF Gratwein, FF Judendorf-Straßengel, FF Eisbach-Rein, TMB37 Sappi, TL Eisbach-Rein mit elf Fahrzeugen und 52 Frauen und Männer ÖRK: 2 RTW, 1 NEF und 1 KDO mit zwölf Frauen und Männer Polizei: 4 Fahrzeuge, Kriminaltechnischer Dienst zur Brandursachenermittlung Quelle: Freiwillige Feuerwehr Gratwein

标题: Feuer und Rauch in einer Wohnung in Ludwigsburg
正文: Ludwigsburg. Vor Ort bestätigte sich die Lage: Im Treppenhaus des Mehrfamilienhauses in Ludwigsburg waren Brandgeruch und eine Rauchentwicklung wahrnehmbar, so die Feuerwehr. In der Erstphase war noch unklar, ob sich Personen in der betroffenen Wohnung aufhielten. Die Feuerwehr leitete umgehend einen Löschangriff mit einem Löschrohr ein. Parallel dazu wurde eine Drehleiter in Stellung gebracht, um die Wohnung über ein Fenster zu erkunden und eine mögliche Menschenrettung vornehmen zu können. Gemeinsam mit dem Rettungsdienst wurden die übrigen Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner des Hauses in Sicherheit gebracht und betreut. Die Wohnungstür der Brandwohnung im dritten Obergeschoss war verschlossen. Die Feuerwehr verschaffte sich mit Brechwerkzeug Zugang, heißt es weiter. Vor der Wohnung wurde ein Rauchschutzvorhang gesetzt, um eine Ausbreitung des giftigen Brandrauchs in das restliche Gebäude zu verhindern. Die Wohnung wurde nach Personen abgesucht – es wurde niemand angetroffen. Im Verlauf des Einsatzes stellte sich heraus, dass sich der Bewohner zum Zeitpunkt des Brandausbruchs nicht in der Wohnung aufhielt. Das Feuer konnte zügig unter Kontrolle gebracht werden. Da es sich um eine Wohnung mit hoher Brandlast handelte, gestalteten sich die Nachlöscharbeiten aufwendig. Mithilfe einer Wärmebildkamera konnten verbliebene Glutnester lokalisiert und abgelöscht werden. Parallel zur Brandbekämpfung wurde ein Lüfter eingesetzt, um den giftigen Brandrauch aus der Wohnung zu entfernen. Die angrenzenden Wohnungen wurden ebenfalls durch die Feuerwehr kontrolliert. Bei dem Einsatz wurde niemand verletzt. Die Feuerwehr war mit insgesamt sieben Fahrzeugen und 32 Einsatzkräften über zwei Stunden im Einsatz. Unterstützt wurde sie durch den Rettungsdienst und die Polizei. Die Feuerwehr Ludwigsburg weist in diesem Zusammenhang darauf hin, dass bei unklarem Brandgeruch in Gebäuden unverzüglich die Feuerwehr über den europaweiten Notruf 112 zu verständigen ist. (red)

标题: Whiteville fire marshal issues pine straw warning after apartment blaze
正文: Whiteville fire marshal issues pine straw warning after apartment blaze WILMINGTON, N.C. (WECT) - The Whiteville fire marshal is warning property owners about the dangers of pine straw after discarded smoking materials ignited the ground cover, spreading flames to an apartment building last week. Seven families were displaced after the Friday afternoon fire destroyed multiple units at the Sawmill Apartments in Whiteville. The fire started around 3:30 p.m. and destroyed eight units, though only seven were occupied. The roof burned off the building as well. Fire Marshal and Emergency Services Director Hal Lowder said pine straw ignited and quickly spread flames to an open stairwell between the two buildings, engulfing the primary exit for those apartments. No one was injured in the fire; however, Fire Chief David Yergeau said one firefighter was taken to the hospital for heat exhaustion. Lowder is encouraging owners and managers of commercial and multi-family structures to use alternative landscaping materials within 10 feet of buildings. He urges residents to swap pine straw for mulch nuggets or rocks near buildings with combustible siding. “Pine straw is extremely combustible and has a very rapid rate of fire spread (often over 90 feet per minute). Placing it directly against a building foundation—especially near entryways, stairwells, or windows with combustible framing—poses a serious fire risk from discarded cigarettes, grills, or electrical faults," said the City of Whiteville. “Combustible siding materials increase the risk of vertical fire spread into the attics of structures.” Wind conditions on Friday also played a part in the fire spreading quickly, Lowder said. “We’re not anti-pine straw, but we recommend up next to buildings with combustible siding to use nuggets or something with a slower flame spread, the rocks the nuggets.” The American Red Cross is assisting the displaced families. 标题: Djevoj?ica porijeklom iz BiH poku?ala spasiti brata i sestru iz po?ara u Austrij
正文: Istraga požara koji je početkom sedmice potresao bečki Ottakring završena je, a austrijske vlasti potvrdile su da je tragediju izazvala neispravna baterija ručnog usisivača. U nesreći su teško povrijeđena djeca porijeklom iz Bosne i Hercegovine, koja se i dalje nalaze u bolnici u veoma teškom stanju. Požar je izbio u ponedjeljak poslijepodne u stambenoj zgradi u ulici Effingergasse, u naselju Davidhoff. U trenutku nesreće u stanu su bila tri maloljetna člana porodice iz BiH. Djevojčica pokušala spasiti brata i sestru Prema pisanju austrijskih medija, četrnaestogodišnja djevojčica ostala je sama sa mlađim bratom i sestrom kada je došlo do zapaljenja baterije usisivača. Vatra se, kako navode, proširila iznenada, a tinejdžerka je pokušala reagovati i ugasiti požar prije dolaska vatrogasaca. Tom prilikom zadobila je lakše povrede, ali i pretrpjela snažan šok zbog svega što se dogodilo. Na teren su ubrzo stigle ekipe vatrogasaca, policije i hitne pomoći. Spasioci su u zadimljenom stanu pronašli dvogodišnjeg dječaka i trogodišnju djevojčicu bez svijesti. Djeca su odmah iznesena iz prostora zahvaćenog dimom, nakon čega su medicinski timovi započeli reanimaciju unutar zgrade. Djeca u kritičnom stanju Austrijski mediji prenose da je kod oboje djece došlo do srčanog zastoja, a pretpostavlja se da je uzrok bilo teško trovanje dimom. Nakon pružene prve pomoći hitno su prevezeni u bolnicu, gdje su smješteni na intenzivnu njegu. Ljekari se i dalje bore za njihove živote. Stanari zgrade ostali su potreseni prizorima koje su zatekli nakon izbijanja požara. Jedna od komšinica, Lieselotte K. (59), opisala je dramatične trenutke za austrijski portal oe24. “Kada sam pogledala kroz prozor, vidjela sam kako hitna služba iznosi dvoje djece na nosilima iz zgrade. Bilo je užasno, nisu se pomjerala i odmah su ih odvezli u dvije hitne pomoći”, kazala je ona. Nadležni organi nakon provedene istrage zaključili su da je uzrok požara kvar na bateriji ručnog usisivača.

标题: Storbrann i Stj?rdal : Fire gutter siktet
正文: Fire gutter siktet To av guttene har i avhør knyttet seg til stedet.  Fire gutter under 15 år er siktet etter storbrannen i en bygård i Stjørdal sentrum torsdag, melder Adresseavisen og Bladet.  – Per nå er fire personer siktet i saken. De er alle under den kriminelle lavalderen og kan ikke straffes, sier etterforskningsleder Ellen Mari Burheim ved Stjørdal politistasjon til Bladet. Alle er nå avhørt, ifølge Trønder-Avisa. – De har knyttet seg til stedet og har kommet med en forklaring om hva som har skjedd, sier Burheim til Adressa. – Hypotese styrket Avhørene har styrkets politiets mistanke om at de har vært med på noe som kan ha forårsaket brannen. – De skal ha tatt seg opp på taket og sittet der en stund. De har ingen klar kobling til bygget, sier Burheim. Hun vil foreløpig ikke si noe om hvordan brannen startet. – Vi må få avhørt alle partene før vi kan si noe mer om dette. To av fire er avhørt, og begge bekrefter at de har vært på taket av bygget før brannen. Jeg ønsker å være litt tilbakeholden før de siste avhørene, men hypotesen om bruk av åpen ild på taket er styrket, sier Burheim til Bladet. Kraftig brann Brannen brøt ut med eksplosiv kraft på takterrassen på bygget like før klokken 16 torsdag. Da nødetatene rykket ut, var det allerede full overtenning i toppetasjen på den tre etasjer høye bygningen. Flere nabobygg ble evakuert. Bilder fra stedet viste kraftig svart røyk som steg til værs, og teglstein og bygningsdeler som hadde falt ned på parkerte biler i området. Like etter klokken 17 hadde brannvesenet kontroll på brannen. Hele bygget ble gjennomsøkt, og det ble bekreftet at ingen personer var savnet. Ingen er meldt skadet. Bygården består av både en næringsdel og et borettslag. Alle leilighetene i bygget er ubeboelige etter brannen, og området rundt bygården er sperret av. Politiet er bekymret for at nedfall fra brannen skal antenne tørt gress, og brannvesenet holder derfor vakt i området fremover for å hindre spredning.

标题: Photo of the Week : Atlanta Squad 4
正文: Calling all fire photographers: FireRescue1 wants to see your pictures! The next time you come across something inspiring, take out the camera and submit it to FireRescue1! Just remember to include your name, agency information and brief background information on the picture. ATLANTA — Atlanta firefighters stopped a structure fire on Euclid Avenue after arriving to heavy smoke from the upper floors of a multi-story residential building on March 25. On social media, the department said Squad 4 arrived first, took command and began operations as crews stretched handlines, searched the building and located fire in the attic with extension into wall spaces. Firefighters faced difficult access because of a narrow stairway to the third floor, where the fire started, but were able to get water on the fire and keep it from spreading to nearby homes. Crews later ventilated the building, checked for hot spots and moved into salvage operations. No injuries were reported. Follow Squad 4 on Instagram. Firefighters don’t have the opportunity to pause and take in what is happening at a fire The pace is relentless and firefighter safety doesn’t lend to reflection in the moment. That is exactly why taking a quick crew photo after a fire matters. It’s not about social media or self-promotion — it’s about capturing a shared experience that only that crew, on that day, under those conditions, will ever fully understand. Years from now, that image becomes a touchpoint: a reminder of the work, the teamwork, and the trust that carried the job through. There’s also a quieter benefit. Crew photos reinforce identity and cohesion in a way that reports and run numbers never will. They document the people behind the response — the tired faces, the soot, the pride and the small signs of a job well done. Taking the extra minute to capture them helps preserve the culture, the pride and the human side of the fire service that can otherwise get lost in the routine.

Einer Sprecherin des Polizeipräsidiums Mittelfranken zufolge brach das Feuer gegen 1.30 Uhr im ersten Stock des Mehrfamilienhauses aus. Als die Polizei vor Ort ankam, stand bereits das erste Obergeschoss und das Dachgeschoss in Flammen. Die Feuerwehr löschte den Brand und konnte verhindern, dass es auf Nachbargebäude übersprang. Ein 17-Jähriger und eine 44-Jährige konnten ihre Wohnung aufgrund der Brandentwicklung nicht mehr über das Treppenhaus verlassen und sprangen aus dem Fenster des zweiten Obergeschosses, noch bevor die Feuerwehr mit entsprechenden Rettungsmittel vor Ort waren, wie die Polizei mitteilt. Sie erlitten leichte sturzbedingte Verletzungen, wurden aber wegen einer schweren Rauchgasvergiftung ins Krankenhaus gebracht. Eine weitere 35-jährige Bewohnerin erlitt ebenfalls eine schwere Rauchgasvergiftung. Beim Absuchen des Gebäudes fand die Feuerwehr außerdem einen leblosen Hund. Das Gebäude sowie zwei Nachbaranwesen wurden geräumt. Insgesamt waren 27 Personen von der Evakuierung betroffen. Der entstandene Sachschaden liegt ersten Schätzungen zufolge im mittleren sechsstelligen Bereich. Das zuständige Fachkommissariat der Nürnberger Kriminalpolizei hat die Ermittlungen aufgenommen. Die Brandursache ist derzeit noch unklar. Während der kriminalpolizeilichen Sachbearbeitung stellten die Beamtinnen und Beamten am Dienstagvormittag erneut Flammen am Brandort fest. Die Feuerwehr musste wieder zum Löschen kommen. Die Arbeiten der Feuerwehr werden laut Informationen der Polizei bis in die Abendstunden andauern. Die Einsatzkräfte sperren daher die Marienbader Straße in nördlicher Fahrtrichtung. Dieser Artikel wurde am 23. September 2025 um 13 Uhr aktualisiert. महाराष्ट्र: डोंबिवली में बेसमेंट आग से हड़कंप, 29 बाइकें खाक महाराष्ट्र के डोंबिवली ईस्ट के सागाव इलाके में एक रिहायशी इमारत के बेसमेंट में भीषण आग लगने से हड़कंप मच गया भीषण आग में पांच लोग घायल, दमकल ने बचाई बड़ी त्रासदी - सागाव इलाके की रिहायशी इमारत में अचानक लगी आग - धुएं से घबराए लोग, बच्चों-बुजुर्गों को सुरक्षित निकाला गया - शॉर्ट सर्किट से हादसे की आशंका, लाखों का नुकसान डोंबिवली। महाराष्ट्र के डोंबिवली ईस्ट के सागाव इलाके में रविवार को एक रिहायशी इमारत के बेसमेंट में भीषण आग लगने से हड़कंप मच गया। इस हादसे में 29 दोपहिया वाहन और कई साइकिलें जलकर पूरी तरह खाक हो गईं, जबकि आग बुझाने की कोशिश में पांच लोग घायल हो गए। हालांकि, दमकल विभाग की तत्परता से बड़ा जान-माल का नुकसान टल गया। घटना सागाव स्थित चेडा नगर, जय भारत स्कूल के पास ‘राज अपार्टमेंट’ और ‘रविकिरण सोसायटी’ नामक जुड़ी हुई इमारतों के बेसमेंट पार्किंग में हुई। प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के अनुसार, पार्किंग में खड़ी एक बाइक में अचानक आग लग गई, जिसने कुछ ही मिनटों में विकराल रूप धारण कर लिया। पास-पास खड़े अन्य दोपहिया वाहन भी आग की चपेट में आ गए। देखते ही देखते बेसमेंट से उठती आग की लपटें और घना धुआं सीढ़ियों के रास्ते ऊपरी मंजिलों तक फैल गया, जिससे इमारत में रहने वाले लोगों को सांस लेने में दिक्कत होने लगी। अफरा-तफरी के माहौल में बच्चों और बुजुर्गों को तुरंत घरों से बाहर निकालकर सुरक्षित स्थानों पर पहुंचाया गया। आग बुझाने के प्रयास में पांच निवासी हल्के रूप से झुलस गए और धुएं से प्रभावित हुए। घायलों को तत्काल नजदीकी अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया, जहां उनका उपचार जारी है और उनकी स्थिति स्थिर बताई जा रही है। सूचना मिलते ही कल्याण-डोंबिवली महानगरपालिका की दमकल गाड़ियां मौके पर पहुंचीं। दमकल कर्मियों ने करीब एक घंटे की कड़ी मशक्कत के बाद आग पर काबू पाया। अधिकारियों के अनुसार, समय रहते आग पर नियंत्रण पा लेने से बड़ा हादसा टल गया, अन्यथा इमारत को गंभीर क्षति पहुंच सकती थी। प्राथमिक जांच में शॉर्ट सर्किट को आग लगने की संभावित वजह बताया जा रहा है। हालांकि पुलिस और अग्निशमन विभाग की ओर से विस्तृत जांच और पंचनामा किया जा रहा है। इस हादसे में लाखों रुपए के नुकसान का अनुमान लगाया जा रहा है।

Erwin said he was among those rescued from a balcony around 10:30 a.m. "They got us down with the ladders, it was definitely very scary," he said. Fire crews from multiple departments responded to the three-story building and worked to knock down flames that started on the second floor. Officials said one resident later died at the hospital, another remains in critical condition, and six others were treated for non-life-threatening injuries. "Fires in apartment buildings are exceptionally challenging when the fire is anywhere below the top floor. You have all of the floors above to deal with. So in this case you have people trapped on the second floor, you have people trapped on the third floor," said Nick Martin, fire chief for Upper Darby Township. One firefighter suffered burn injuries and was hospitalized but has since been released and is recovering. The fire caused extensive damage, with smoke affecting apartments on the second and third floors and water damage on the first floor. Delaware County Emergency Services, the Red Cross, and other support groups assisted displaced residents. A reception center was set up at Drexel Hill Middle School before the apartment complex property manager secured temporary housing. " It's definitely a little traumatizing, very scary, honestly I'm still trying to process it," Erwin said. Firefighters said the flames were contained to one apartment. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

标题: Apartment residents recount  crazy  3 - alarm fire in Towson
正文: 'Our building's on fire': Towson apartment building residents recount 3-alarm fire Residents said they were caught off guard by a three-alarm fire that broke out at a multistory apartment building in Towson Monday night. Fourteen people were hospitalized with minor injuries and many other residents were forced to evacuate the building around 7:30 p.m. Fire officials said it began on the third floor of the Berkshires at Town Center Apartments on Joppa Road. Crews contained the flames after around an hour. "I was just working out downstairs, and all of a sudden, a couple firefighters burst in and said, 'You guys know the building is on fire, right?'" said Zach Wildhorn. Wildhorn, unaware of the fire, said he evacuated the building immediately. Antwone Hoffman first learned about the fire through his roommate. "I got a call from my roommate. He said, 'Yeah, our building's on fire,' Hoffman said. "I was like, 'What?'" Building residents said the fire started in a trash room but caused significant damage to the third floor. Firefighters used large ladders to rescue residents who were trapped on their balconies as thick smoke filled the hallways. "Obviously, the hallways were completely smoke-filled," Wildhorn said. "People were on the balconies, and they had cranes and ladder-type things they were sending up to get people down safely." "They had to break down doors, kicking down doors and everything like that, evacuating everyone. It was crazy," Hoffman said. Residents were eventually allowed to return to the building around 1 a.m. While those interviewed said their individual units weren't damaged, the smell of smoke lingered throughout the building, even on the higher floors. "All the smoke came from the third floor and traveled all the way up," Hoffman said. "We live on the fifth floor, so it traveled all the way up to the fifth floor and above." Fire officials are still investigating the cause of the fire.

标题: Mother dies while saving 3 children using ladder during house blaze in Prayagraj

正文: PRAYAGRAJ: A mother lost her life while saving her children from a massive fire that broke out in a crockery trader’s house in Prayagraj earlier this week. The tragic incident took place on the night of May 12 in the narrow lane of Naini Bazaar of Prayagraj’s trans-Yamuna area, where a devastating blaze engulfed a multi-storey residential building. According to reports, the fire is suspected to have started due to a short circuit in the ground-floor godown and rapidly spread through the building, trapping several family members on the upper floors. Amid thick smoke and flames, the deceased mother, Archana Kesarwani, continued trying to save her children and relatives for nearly 30 minutes. In a desperate attempt to rescue her family, she first wrapped her one-year-old child in a bedsheet and handed the infant across to neighbours standing on a nearby rooftop. The child was safely rescued. She then arranged a ladder between the rooftops and managed to send her two daughters (aged 13 and 10) and a nephew to safety. However, while rescuing the others, she became trapped in the smoke and flames. Officials said the woman suffered severe burn injuries and later died during treatment. One of her daughters also sustained burn injuries and is undergoing treatment, while another family member suffered fractures after jumping from the building during the panic. Local residents said the narrow lanes delayed the entry of fire brigade vehicles, making rescue operations difficult. Around a dozen fire tenders were later pressed into service to control the blaze, which was finally brought under control after several hours. A video of the woman rescuing her children amid the flames surfaced on Saturday and has drawn widespread praise for her courage and sacrifice. Residents across the city have hailed her bravery and described her actions as an extraordinary example of a mother risking everything to save her children.

标题: Feuerwehr rettet 12 eingeschlossene Bewohner bei Wohnungsbrand in K?ln
正文: In einem Hochhaus in Köln-Meschenich bricht nachts ein Feuer aus. Mehrere Menschen sind in ihren Wohnungen eingeschlossen. Mehrere VerletzteFeuerwehr rettet 12 Bewohner bei Wohnungsbrand in Kölner Hochhaus In einem Hochhaus an der Straße An der Fuhr in Köln-Meschenich ist in der Nacht zu Dienstag (23. September) gegen 2 Uhr ein Brand im Hochparterre ausgebrochen. Dichter Rauch breitete sich rasch über das Treppenhaus bis in die oberen Etagen aus. Der Sicherheitsdienst des Wohnkomplexes schlug Alarm, gleichzeitig gingen mehrere Notrufe bei der Leitstelle der Feuerwehr Köln ein. Die Bewohnenden berichteten von verrauchten Fluren und eingeschränkter Sicht – viele konnten ihre Wohnungen nicht mehr verlassen und machten sich von den Balkonen aus bemerkbar. Brand in Köln: Menschen machen sich auf Balkonen bemerkbar „Beim Eintreffen der ersten Einsatzkräfte bestätigte sich das Meldebild“, teilte die Feuerwehr mit. Umgehend drangen mehrere Trupps unter Atemschutz in die Brandwohnung ein, löschten das Feuer und durchsuchten gleichzeitig die Flure und den Treppenraum nach weiteren Personen. Ein Bewohner wurde beim Versuch zu fliehen durch heiße Rauchgase verletzt und in ein Krankenhaus gebracht. Zwölf weitere Menschen konnten nur mithilfe sogenannter Fluchthauben in Sicherheit gebracht werden. Nach medizinischer Erstversorgung durch den Notarzt mussten drei von ihnen leicht verletzt ins Krankenhaus, neun konnten vor Ort verbleiben. Feuereinsatz in Köln: Zwölf Menschen mit Fluchthauben gerettet „Dank der schnellen und gezielten Löschmaßnahmen konnte eine Ausbreitung des Feuers auf weitere Gebäudeteile verhindert werden“, heißt es im Einsatzbericht. Die betroffene Wohnung jedoch brannte vollständig aus. Insgesamt waren 61 Einsatzkräfte der Feuerwehr und des Rettungsdienstes mit 22 Fahrzeugen im Einsatz. Gegen 5 Uhr war der Einsatz beendet. Die Polizei hat die Ermittlungen zur Brandursache übernommen. (sbo)

标题: Emergency personnel quell Tamaqua apartment fire

正文: A 28-year-old Tamaqua woman has been charged with arson after police say she intentionally started a second-floor apartment fire midday Wednesday. Tamaqua Police issued a warrant for Keyshawna Hausman’s arrest Thursday afternoon. Six charges were filed against Hausman, including first-degree felonies of Arson, Inhabited Building; Aggravated Arson, Bodily Injury; Arson, Danger of Death or Bodily Injury; third-degree felonies of Risking Catastrophe and Criminal Mischief; and a second-degree misdemeanor of Recklessly Endangering Another Person. All four Tamaqua Fire Companies responded to the fire incident that was reported around 12:42 p.m. Wednesday, when callers reportedly saw flames coming from the 9-unit apartment building located at 44 Mauch Chunk St. Tamaqua EMS and Police, and Coaldale Fire Department also responded to the scene. Upon arriving, fire personnel found an active fire and rescued Hausman, a tenant, from a second-floor window via a ladder. Police say Hausman admitted to starting the fire on purpose, after being evaluated by EMS. Hausman was taken to St. Luke’s Miners Hospital in Coaldale for smoke inhalation and other injuries, where police say she is still receiving care. A 62-year-old female tenant was also rescued — an EMT carried the woman, who uses a walker, out of the building. Besides a second EMT who received onsite care for smoke inhalation, no other injuries were reported. Later in the day, Tamaqua Police and the State Police Fire Marshal discovered remnants of a shower curtain within the fire area. Officials determined that the fire originated along a wall in the suspect’s unit and spread throughout the apartment. Police say damage was contained to the apartment unit that the fire originated in, thanks to emergency responders’ timely response. Apartment residents were permitted to return to their homes later in the day, after the building was deemed safe and secure.

标题: Homeless man in Bronx booked for sparking deadly high - rise fire and explosion
正文: A homeless man was booked in the Bronx on Wednesday for setting off a massive four-alarm fire inside an apartment building that left one person dead, 15 others injured and more than 175 residents displaced. Samuel Calderon, 55, faces murder, manslaughter, and a host of other charges for his alleged role in igniting the inferno within the Boston Secor Houses at 3475 Bivona St. in Eastchester just before 12:30 a.m. on Jan. 24. The fire sparked an explosion on the 15th and 16th floors, damaging six apartments, Fire Department officials said. Ten other units were severely damaged by the blaze. In searching the location, firefighters came across Ronald McCallister, 60, who lived at the complex. He was unconscious and unresponsive, and subsequently pronounced dead at the scene. Firefighters also located a 37-year-old man who was also severely injured. EMS rushed him to a local hospital in critical condition. Fifteen other residents were hospitalized for injuries related to the blaze. The fire displaced 175 residents of the building. Sources familiar with the investigation said that Calderon previously lived in the apartment building with his former girlfriend. Police believe Calderon had recently moved out of the apartment and relocated to a shelter. The sources said he allegedly returned to the location Friday night and ripped out a small, gas-powered stove — causing a gas leak that led to the explosion and fire. The suspect had allegedly intended to steal the stove and sell it to feed his drug addiction, the sources noted. McCallister was not believed to be intentionally targeted, ABC7 reported, citing law enforcement sources. Calderon, meanwhile, was walked out by detectives out of the 47th Precinct stationhouse on Wednesday night and transferred to Bronx Criminal Court for arraignment. He faces charges of murder, manslaughter, assault, burglary, petit larceny, criminal contempt and harassment.

标题: 3 die in Uttara apartment fire

正文: News Flash DHAKA, Jan 16, 2026 (BSS)- At least six people were killed in a devastating fire that broke out in a residential building in the city's Uttara area on Friday morning, authorities confirmed. The six dead included two women, one man and a child. The names and identities of the other deceased are not yet known. The fire erupted around 7:50 am in a flat on the second floor of a six- to seven-storey residential building on Road 18, Sector 11 in Uttara. Fire Service and Civil Defence (FSCD) received the alert at 7:54 am and immediately dispatched firefighting units to the scene. According to FSCD media officer Talha Bin Jasim, two fire units from Uttara Fire Station reached the building by 7:58 am, with more units joining shortly afterward. Firefighters brought the blaze under control around 8:25 am and fully extinguished it by around 10:00 am. Initially, three people were found dead at the scene, while 13 injured residents were taken to Kuwait Bangladesh Friendship Government Hospital for treatment. Later, three more victims died while undergoing treatment, raising the death toll to six, said Uttara Division Deputy Commissioner of Police Shahriar Ali. Fire service officials said the fire spread rapidly due to a large amount of furniture inside the affected flat. Md Abdul Mannan, deputy assistant director of Fire Service Dhaka Zone-3, said the fire may have originated from an electrical short circuit, although the exact cause will be confirmed following an investigation. The flames spread from the second floor to the third floor, worsening the situation and filling the building with thick smoke. Local residents described scenes of panic and chaos as occupants struggled to escape the smoke-filled stairwells. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident and urged?residents to strictly adhere to fire safety measures to prevent similar?tragedies in the future.

标题: Mother in ICU after throwing daughter out of burning apartment
正文: Mother in ICU after throwing daughter out of burning apartment A fire at a Milwaukee apartment building Friday morning left five people injured, including a mother who threw her 9-year-old daughter to safety from a second-story window. Prosecutors say a Milwaukee man, angry about neighbors smoking marijuana, allegedly poured gasoline in a hallway and ignited it. Seven felony charges were filed. "It has been rough, man. I am trying to keep it together for my daughter," Luis Ramirez, the father of the 9-year-old, said. Ramirez's daughter, Ni'lah, and her mother, Kessy, were inside the building. "Her mother was like, 'Please catch her,' and then boom, my heart, and it could be my nieces or nephew, so I had to catch her," said a neighbor who caught Ni'lah. Ramirez expressed his gratitude, saying, "If it wasn't for him, I don't know what other injuries she could have sustained." Ni'lah was released from the hospital with only a scratch on her leg and minor smoke inhalation, but Kessy remains in the ICU under heavy sedation and on breathing tubes. "We are 50/50 right now," Ramirez said regarding Kessy's recovery prospects. Milwaukee police announced the arrest of a 43-year-old man in connection with the arson. "Shame on you, first and foremost — God says forgive so I got to forgive, but it is going to be a process," Ramirez said when asked about the suspect. Authorities arrested Keith Alan Luko on Jan. 16 after he allegedly admitted to starting the fire. According to the complaint, Luko told police he "was angry about his neighbors smoking marijuana" and "poured gasoline in the hallway" before igniting it with a lighter. Luko has been charged with arson of a building, first-degree reckless injury and five counts of first-degree recklessly endangering safety. Ramirez has set up a GoFundMe to support his family as he works to move them forward while Kessy remains hospitalized.

标题: FDNY says closing doors could have avoided deaths in 5 - alarm Bronx fire
正文: A five-alarm Bronx fire that killed two people on Tuesday afternoon spread quickly because multiple doors were left open, according to the FDNY. FDNY officials said firefighters arrived just minutes after the flames broke out at the five-story apartment building on East 187th Street in Belmont. They found heavy smoke and fire on all floors of the building, according to officials. The FDNY said an ongoing investigation found multiple doors in the building were left open, including the one to the apartment where fire marshals believe the fire started. “Door was left open to the fire apartment, door was left open to the front of the building, and the door was left open to the bulkhead, which is the exit to the roof,” FDNY First Deputy Commissioner Daniel Flynn said at a press briefing Friday morning. “If not for those doors being open, we believe that the fire may have even been contained in that one apartment, and we would have not, not had lost anybody.” Officials also said people in the Bronx building did not use the building’s fire escapes, and that the building’s door was propped open. On Thursday, they urged New Yorkers to ensure they always close the door behind them in the event of a fire, and also ensure their windows are not blocked and that they can access their fire escapes. “ Walk out onto the fire escape, show your children where the fire escapes are. Do not get caught off guard when these fires occur,” Flynn said. “Always know how you're going to escape.” Flynn said the two victims of Tuesday’s fire were found in the stairwell, and said they were making their way down from higher floors. It’s been an active week for the FDNY. On Thursday, firefighters responded to a five-alarm fire at a church in Queens. And on Friday, an impound lot in Brooklyn went up in flames, destroying cars parked there, ABC News reported. No injuries were reported in those fires.

正文: Merz und Merkel bedroht — Staatsanwaltschaft ermittelt gegen Kabarettist Uwe Steimle Zwei Häuser brennen gleichzeitig: Mann stirbt bei rätselhaftem Doppel-Feuer Heide (Schleswig-Holstein) – Feuerdrama morgens in dem kleinen Ort Schülp. Auf einem Grundstück brannten gleich zwei Gebäude lichterloh. In einem starb ein 32-Jähriger. Passanten bemerkten um 8.40 Uhr Rauch an einem Wohnhaus an der Hauptstraße in Schülp im Kreis Dithmarschen (Schleswig-Holstein), wählten sofort den Notruf. Als die Feuerwehr mit 65 Einsatzkräften eintraf, drang immer noch Qulam aus dem ersten Stock des Hauses. Und extreme Hitze breitete sich aus. Es kommt zu Explosionen Mysteriös: Noch während die Feuerwehrleute die Wasserversorgung zum Löschen aufbauten, schlugen plötzlich meterhohe Flammen aus einem ein paar Meter entfernten Nebengebäude. Es kam zu Explosionen: „Innerhalb weniger Minuten standen beide Gebäude im Vollbrand“, so Ole Kröger vom Kreisfeuerwehrverband Dithmarschen. Wegen der extremen Hitze durch den Brand öffneten die Einsatzkräfte die Fenster im Erdgeschoss des Wohnhauses. Dadurch konnten die Hitze und der Rauch ins Freie entweichen. Dann drangen die Feuerwehrleute ins Innere des Hauses und machten im Flurbereich eine schreckliche Entdeckung: Sie fanden einen leblosen Körper. Der Rettungsdienst konnte nur noch den Tod des Bewohners (32) feststellen. Brandursache noch unklar Um die Flammen endgültig zu löschen, öffnete die Feuerwehr in Absprache mit der Polizei das Dach. So sollte verhindert werden, dass Beweismittel zerstört werden. Noch ist völlig unklar, was auf dem Grundstück an der Hauptstraße passierte und warum die beiden Gebäude fast gleichzeitig brannten. 标题: 1 pulled from North York apartment following fire
正文: One person pulled from an apartment building unit that caught fire in North York has died, say officials. Speaking with the media at the scene on Tuesday afternoon, Toronto Fire Services Cmdr. Robert Hewson said crews were called to a highrise at 5 Needle Firway, near Finch Avenue West and Jane Street, just before 12:15 p.m. after receiving 911 calls about a fire near the top floor of the building. Upon arrival, firefighters encountered flames and saw black smoke coming from the penthouse level of the building, Hewson said. They then made entry and rescued a person from a unit on the 12th floor. “Crews made an aggressive attack on the fire and a very quick subsequent rescue. Unfortunately, the occupant of the building succumbed to their injuries,” he said, adding that investigators are on the scene waiting until the overhaul is completed before commencing their investigation. “Condolences from Toronto Fire Services to friends and family.” The commander said it appears that the fire was contained to the apartment of origin. The cause and circumstances of the fire are unknown. Toronto fire said primary and secondary searches are complete and the fire is now out. ‘Systems in place for calls like this’ Hewson went on to say that battling fires in highrises presents some unique challenges as they take about twice as many staff. “You’re dealing with elevators and we only put a certain amount of firefighters in the elevator to start, and we start to utilize stairwell, and it’s a coordinated effort. It does take more time, but we also send a lot more crews, staff, firefighters to the scene,” he said. “We have systems in place for calls like this.” The investigation into the cause, origin, and circumstances of this fire, which is a joint effort between Toronto police, the Ontario Fire Marshal’s office and our own TFS investigators, is in the early stages, Hewson said.

标题: Gateshead woman who set fire to bedding in  cry for help  is jailed
正文: Gateshead woman who set fire to bedding in 'cry for help' is jailed Lisa Taylor, of Dunston, set a fire in her downstairs flat and has now been locked up for arson A woman who said setting fire to her bedding was a "cry for help" has been jailed. It was around 6pm on May 15 last year that Lisa Taylor's neighbours say smoke coming from her downstairs flat on Holly Avenue, Dunston, Gateshead. Taylor, who had made previous threats to set the property alight, set the fire in the rear bedroom. It caused extensive damage and smoke penetrated upstairs. The court heard that the day before, Taylor had sent messages threatening to burn down the property and she tried to ignite some bedding. A fire investigation showed the blaze had either been started by the ignition of a naked flame to combustible material or she had carelessly disposed of smoking material. Taylor pleaded guilty to arson being reckless as to whether life was endangered. She was jailed for 28 months. Judge Tim Gittins said: "You maintain what happened was a cry for help and you were being reckless with your own life, because you stayed in the property to begin with." The judge said she had started the fire using a flame on her bedding and added: "The fact is you also caused a real substantial risk to others. The occupiers of the upstairs flat were present as were those in the dwelling adjacent. "I accept, fortunately, no one was significantly harmed but it was a residential building with a number of multiple occupants." Tony Cornberg, defending, said: "This came about as a result of a decline in her mental health. She lost everything." The court heard she had a traumatic early life. 标题: Claremont apartment fire displaces 10 residents
正文: CLAREMONT — A Friday night apartment fire displaced about 10 residents due to extensive property damage, a Claremont Fire Department news release said. Firefighters were dispatched to 147 Main St. at 9:30 p.m. on Friday. The four-story residential building had heavy fire showing from the second floor when emergency responders arrived, the release said. After initial suppression efforts, crews found that flames had extended into the attic of the building. The fire was extinguished about 25 minutes after the initial report. Golden Cross Ambulance treated one occupant for minor injuries. Firefighters rescued multiple animals, including dogs, cats and a bearded dragon, Red Cross volunteer George Sykes said by phone Monday. “As far as I know, all the pets were rescued,” said Sykes. While the fire was contained quickly by the emergency crews, the extent of the damage has not yet been formally evaluated, building owner Kevin Lacasse said Monday by phone. The unit where the fire originated suffered the most damage, he said, and the one under it was damaged by water. Multiple other units sustained smoke damage, though most belongings in those homes remained intact, Lacasse added. The building was appraised last year for a sum of $404,000, according to Claremont property records. Lacasse said that the building is insured. Sykes assisted impacted residents, who gathered at the Claremont Fire Department. “Due to significant fire and water damage, the building was deemed unsafe for occupancy,” the news release said. The New Hampshire State Fire Marshal’s Office has been tasked with investigating the cause of the fire, the release said. Windsor and Newport fire crews, Golden Cross Ambulance, and Claremont Police, the Department of Public Works and the city’s building inspector assisted at the scene. Unity and Weathersfield fire departments provided station coverage.

标题: Five injured in Tel Aviv fire , one in serious condition
正文: One person was seriously injured and four others sustained light injuries after a fire broke out in a residential building on Derech Hahagana Street in Tel Aviv–Yafo early Thursday morning, Israel Fire and Rescue Services’ Dan District said. Shortly before 3:40 a.m., multiple emergency calls were received at the district’s 102 hotline reporting flames inside an apartment. Three firefighting teams were dispatched to the scene. Deputy shift commander Reshef Tomer Kashri said crews encountered heavy smoke coming from a second-floor unit in a 12-story building. “Upon arrival, we noticed black smoke coming from the second floor of a 12-story building,” Kashri said. “We forced open the entrance door and saw electric bicycles completely engulfed in flames. Firefighters began conducting searches and extinguishing the source of the fire. The apartment’s residents were trapped in separate rooms. We rescued five residents. One was in serious condition and the others were lightly injured. They were transferred to MDA for treatment.” Fire officials reiterate safety guidance Emergency operators from the Dan District’s 102 center remained in continuous contact with those trapped inside the apartment, instructing them to stay sheltered in place throughout the incident until firefighters reached them. A fire investigator was called to the scene to examine the circumstances surrounding the blaze. Fire officials used the incident to reiterate safety guidance, urging the public to install smoke detectors, which they described as inexpensive, easy to install, and life-saving by providing early warning that allows residents to escape in time. They also warned against charging lithium batteries unattended and stressed that building entrances must never be blocked, particularly when storing items such as electric bicycles. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

It said it was responding to a report of a gas explosion that collapsed an incinerator shaft in the building in the Bronx. The rest of the building appeared to be stable with no apartments affected, but that was being investigated by the Department of Buildings. The building is city-owned public housing. Multiple messages seeking comment were left with the Housing Authority. Video from the scene shows a high-rise with one corner collapsed from the ground floor to the roof. Videos by nearby residents showed a cloud of dust billowing over the block moments after the collapse. Mayor Eric Adams said he was briefed about the emergency and officials were still getting a full assessment. "Please avoid the area for your safety," he wrote on X. Incinerator shafts in New York City buildings were once used to dispose of trash, which was then burned on site. But they have largely been replaced with trash compactors, which can use the same chutes. In July 2023, a towering construction crane caught fire high above the West Side of Manhattan, causing its long arm to snap off, smash against a nearby building and plummet to the street as people ran for their lives on the sidewalk below. 标题: Woman trying to burn cockroach sets South Korea apartment ablaze
命中: 照明失效|阳台窗口待援|身体受创|跳楼坠落
正文: South Korean police said they would seek an arrest warrant for a woman who set fire to her apartment building while trying to kill a cockroach with an improvised flamethrower, local media report. One of the woman's neighbours died after falling to the ground in a failed attempt to escape through a window. The woman, who is in her 20s, told police that she tried to torch a cockroach with a lighter and a flammable spray, adding she had used the method before. But on Monday, items in her home caught fire. Police in the northern city of Osan said the woman could be charged with accidentally starting a fire and causing death by negligence. Blasting cockroaches - with blowtorches or homemade flamethrowers - have emerged as a novel way of getting rid of house pests, made popular by videos on social media. In 2018, an Australian man set fire to his kitchen while trying to kill cockroaches with a homemade flamethrower made from insect spray. The woman who died in the Osan city fire, a Chinese national in her 30s, lived on the fifth floor of the building with her husband and two-month-old baby. When they realised that a fire had broken out, the couple opened their home window and called for help. They handed their baby through the window to a neighbour in the adjacent block, before trying to evacuate themselves. The woman's husband managed to climb over to the next block. She tried to do the same, but fell from the window. She was taken to the hospital and pronounced dead hours later. Police said they believed the couple had tried escaping through the window because thick smoke from the fire had blocked the stairway, local media report. The building houses commercial shops on its first floor and 32 residential units from its second to fifth floor. Eight other residents suffered from smoke inhalation because of the fire.

正文: Explosions And Smoke Force KARE 11 Staff To Evacuate This afternoon, a Minnesota-based television station caught fire forcing the employees inside to evacuate, and then turned around to report the fire. The main 5pm news team was not at the station at the time of the fire, and was prepared to broadcast the 5pm news from what appeared to be some sort of pressbox, but was really a studio at the tower site. KARE 11 Evacuated After Building Catches Fire The Golden Valley broadcaster, KARE 11, caught fire this afternoon at around 1:30pm, after what is believed to be a transformer malfunction outside, leading to the evacuation, and then subsequent coverage of the fire by their news team. KARE reported that employees inside could hear explosions shortly after the power went out, as well as smell smoke. News Anchor Was Prepared To Broadcast From Anywhere Julie Nelson, the top anchor at KARE, shared a social media post where it appeared she was preparing to broadcast the 5pm news from what looked like initially what you would see from a baseball pressbox. It wasn't however, a pressbox, but a view from the station's tower site. While it appeared Julie was inside what looked like a pressbox at a park, she was indeed at the TV stations tower site, located in the Twin Cities North Suburban town of Shoreview. KARE-11 Will Be Back For The 10pm Newscast In another social media post from the television station, the newscast for 10pm will air, from presumably the tower site, after technical issues prevented the broadcasts at 5 and 6pm. 标题: 5 - storey Shahdara building catches fire , 9 rescued safely : DFS
正文: 5-storey Shahdara building catches fire, 9 rescued safely: DFS Nine people were rescued from a fire in a Shahdara building in Delhi; they suffered smoke inhalation but were unharmed. Cause suspected as short circuit. New Delhi: Nine people were rescued safely from a five-storey residential building in Delhi’s Shahdara, which caught fire late on Saturday night, a Delhi Fire Services (DFS) officer said on Sunday. While no one was injured, the evacuees were admitted to a hospital after they complained of breathing issues due to smoke inhalation, the officer said. An alert of fire at Mansarovar Park area in Shahdara was received around midnight, the DFS officer said. “We rushed fire tenders to the spot. The fire had engulfed the building’s parking area and the parked vehicles, trapping residents on the upper floors. With the help of ropes and ladders, the residents were rescued by being helped to reach an adjacent building or to come out of the building. By 12.40 am, the fire was brought under control,” the officer said. All the rescued people had been shifted to GTB Hospital. “They were complaining of breathing problems and put under observation,” the officer said. The evacuees included two men, two women and five teenagers. DCP (Shahdara) Rajendra Prasad Meena said police suspect a short circuit as the cause of the fire. “According to the initial probe, a short circuit in a motor in the parking area caused the fire. Police and DFS personnel responded promptly, extinguished the fire, and safely rescued the residents from the upper floors,” the DCP said, adding that a probe is underway. On May 3 , a fire in Vivek Vihar’s four-storey residential building killed nine residents. According to DFS, the iron grill on the building, which covered the side and back portions, was a hurdle for the fire rescue operation.

标题: Major blaze put out in deprived area of Seoul
正文: A major fire that broke out in a deprived area of the upmarket Gangnam district of Seoul has been fully extinguished. "We are relieved that we were able to extinguish the fire without any casualties," the official said in a statement from the National Fire Agency. The fire that broke out just after 5am on Friday was fully extinguished about eight hours later. While no casualties were reported, 258 residents living in the affected areas of Guryong Village were evacuated, and a total of 324 firefighters and 106 vehicles deployed to put out the blaze.  A helicopter was also sent once the haze and fine dust shrouding the city in the morning had lifted. Authorities will conduct an investigation into the cause of the fire and the damages it caused, the statement said. Photographs from the scene showed a towering column of black smoke hanging over the area as elderly residents wearing face masks evacuated. Guryong Village is a pocket of ramshackle housing in Gangnam, one of Seoul's wealthiest districts. It is due to be redeveloped into high-rise residential buildings. Often described as Seoul's largest remaining shantytown, Guryong emerged when families displaced by public works projects in the 1970s and 1980s - including construction for the Asian Games and the Seoul Olympics - settled on the edge of Gangnam without permits, according to a Seoul city planning report. The makeshift homes are often densely packed together and built with highly flammable materials such as vinyl sheets, plywood and packing foam, making the area particularly vulnerable to fires, according to an assessment by the fire department after a blaze in 2023. Many residents have moved out of Guryong for the redevelopment, but about 336 households remain, according to the Gangnam District city planning department. Australian Associated Press

标题: Twee mensen in levensgevaar bij brand in appartementsgebouw in Ekeren
正文: Aan de Ferdinand Verbieststraat in Ekeren is maandagmiddag brand ontstaan in een appartementsgebouw van 7 verdiepingen hoog. 2 mensen raakten daarbij levensgevaarlijk gewond. De brand ontstond in de kelder en werd mogelijk veroorzaakt door een kortsluiting aan de elektriciteitskasten. Om 14.20 uur kreeg de brandweerzone Antwerpen een melding binnen van een brand in een appartementsgebouw aan de Ferdinand Verbieststraat in Ekeren; een gebouw van 7 verdiepingen hoog. Veel rook "Er kwam heel veel rook uit de schoorsteen van het gebouw, ook al bleek de brand in de kelder te zijn ontstaan", zegt Margot Mouton van de brandweer. De rook verspreidde zich via de liftschacht naar boven. Brand snel onder controle, 2 in levensgevaar "De brand zelf was vrij snel onder controle, maar de bewoners moesten geëvacueerd worden. 2 mensen zijn in levensgevaar naar het ziekenhuis gebracht." Ook de ladderwagen werd ingezet om te helpen bij de evacuatie van de bovenste verdiepingen", zegt Mouton. Bewoners verblijven de komende dagen best elders De bewoners werden elders opgevangen.
