正文: NYPD identifies ‘God-fearing,’ beloved 90-year-old woman killed in Bronx blaze See more of our coverage in your search results. Add The New York Post on GoogleA “God-fearing” 90-year-old woman killed when a blaze tore through her Bronx home Tuesday night has been officially identified by authorities. Allison Johnson, 90, was found lifeless inside the two-story apartment building on East 168th Street near Boston Road in Morrisania, where the fire erupted minutes before 9 p.m., police said Wednesday. Johnson – a resident of the building who a neighbor said used a wheelchair and likely couldn’t escape – was pronounced dead at the scene by EMS, cops said. “The lady that lives there, who is wheelchair-bound, that’s in that apartment. We haven’t seen nobody come out,” nearby resident Stacey said in the aftermath of the blaze. “Nice lady too … just being neighbors on the block, you see her coming and going, we all say hi, everybody says hi to each other around here,” she said. Dorita Joseph, one of Johnson’s neighbors for 25 years, said the nonagenarian was well-loved in the area. “She is a godly woman, God-fearing, she is very friendly, she is very well known in the community,” Joseph recalled. “We love gardening, so we both exchange flowers. She taught me a bit about gardening.” Roughly 60 firefighters and EMS workers rushed to the scene and extinguished the flames by 9:36 p.m., officials said. The cause of the blaze remained under investigation Wednesday.

标题: Five Bravest Injured in Four - Alarm Borough Blaze
正文: By Michael V. Cusenza Five firefighters were injured early Sunday morning battling a quick four-alarm inferno in South Jamaica. The Sutphin Boulevard blaze erupted on the first floor of a commercial/residential building shortly after 6 a.m. It was deemed under control at 8:02 a.m. “On arrival we had heavy fire showing from the first floor of a two story mixed occupancy which quickly extended to the second floor and through shafts into exposures two and four. A second alarm was transmitted just five minutes into the operation. The fire eventually escalated to a fourth alarm, bringing 49 units and roughly 170 firefighters to the scene. Units operated an aggressive interior attack on all buildings, conducted searches, and continued to check for extension,” said Assistant Chief Malcolm Moore, chief of City Fire Department Special Operations. “When I came to work and I went in the building, I smelled the fume and the smoke, and we looked around and all of it’s fuming and smoking, and me and another coworker was there,” a woman told WABC-7 Eyewitness News. “When I came outside, I see smoke out of the building, and I came out and then I rushed to my building upstairs, wake up my daughter and we headed out and then we called the fire truck.” The five Bravest were treated on scene and rushed to Jamaica Hospital Medical Center by EMS. Three suffered serious, but non-life-threatening injuries. The cause of the fire is under investigation by FDNY fire marshals.

标题: Two Head to Hospital After Apartment Fire in Sherman Oaks
正文: Two people were injured as flames roared through the upper floor of a two-story apartment building in Sherman Oaks Thursday, leading to a protracted battle by firefighters. The fire was reported at 8:54 a.m. Thursday in a garden-style apartment building at 14248 W. Dickens St., near the intersection of Ventura and Beverly Glen boulevards, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department. Crews evacuated residents and cut holes in the roof to ventilate the structure as flames shot through the openings. About 80 firefighters joined the battle and put the stubborn blaze out in two hours and 34 minutes, according to the LAFD. Two patients were taken to hospitals. One was a 69-year-old woman who had shortness of breath, possibly after sustaining smoke inhalation. The other was a man of undisclosed age whose condition was not immediately known, said the LAFD’s Jennifer Middleton. “Seven units/apartments were impacted by the fire,” she said, adding that three were deemed uninhabitable. Eight adults were displaced and the Red Cross was providing support for the victims. Crews saved two dogs from the affected second-floor apartment, where they contained the fire. The canines’ owner took possession of the dogs to take them to a veterinarian, Middleton said. The LAFD’s Arson unit was investigating the cause of the fire, she said. “LAFD companies will remain on scene for an extended period of time completing thorough overhaul procedures,” Middleton said.

标题: Up to 14 people displaced after fire in apartment building in SE Jamestown
正文: JAMESTOWN — Up to 14 people were displaced on Wednesday, May 20, after the Jamestown Fire Department extinguished a fire in an apartment building in southeast Jamestown, according to Jim Reuther, fire chief. "They are going to be displaced for awhile," Reuther said. The American Red Cross is helping the tenants. Six units and 19 firefighters responded to 503 15th St. SE at about 2:30 p.m. Wednesday to a report of smoke coming from an apartment unit's doorway. Capt. Sheldon Mohr said firefighters extinguished a small fire in the kitchen area inside the apartment unit and ventilated smoke out of the building. Mohr said the cause of the fire is under investigation. Reuther said the apartment building has been shut down. He said the water and power to the apartment building have been shut off. He said water is leaking through the ceilings. "It's pretty extensive damage to the one apartment (unit)," he said. Reuther said the entire apartment building received smoke damage. ADVERTISEMENT Reuther said the property has been handed back to Prolific Property Management. "We handed the property back over to them, so now they're in care of it," he said. Firefighters were on scene for about two hours. No injuries to firefighters were reported. Mohr said he was not aware of any injuries to tenants of the apartment building. The Jamestown Police Department, Stutsman County Sheriff's Office and Jamestown Area Ambulance also responded to the scene.

标题: Sprinkler system , firefighters prevent blaze from destroying White House apartm
正文: Sprinkler system, firefighters prevent blaze from destroying White House apartments One pet was safely rescued from the fire, per Smokey Barn News. WHITE HOUSE, Tenn. (WSMV) - The White House City Fire Department intervened to prevent a blaze from spreading across an apartment building last week, according to Smokey Barn News (SBN). The fire was reported midday Thursday at Safe North Apartments. White House City Fire Chief Garrett told SBN his crews were dispatched to the 900 building after a fire alarm was triggered, and they soon learned a structure fire with visible flames had started there. Per SBN, firefighters spotted smoke coming from a third-floor apartment. They forced entry into the smoky unit, safely rescued a pet from inside and began using water to extinguish the fire. Fire crews reported that the complex’s sprinkler system triggered as the fire was spreading, helping to prevent the fire from taking over the building. Between the sprinkler system’s early intervention and the fire department’s efforts, officials told SBN that damage to the apartment was “minimal.” While the cause of the fire remains under investigation, officials told SBN that they believe it started after an occupant left a candle burning after leaving the home. 标题: Five hospitalized after apartment fire at Sheridan Ridge complex
正文: Five hospitalized after apartment fire at Sheridan Ridge complex One adult and three children were transported to area hospitals in critical condition, and one adult was transported in stable condition. OVERLAND PARK, Kan. (KCTV) - Five people were hospitalized after a fire at the Sheridan Ridge Apartments early Saturday morning. Firefighters from Overland Park, Lenexa and Shawnee fire departments were dispatched to the building fire at 83rd and Farley Street shortly before 3 a.m., the Overland Park Fire Department said. According to OPFD, the first units on the scene reported smoke and fire showing from a two-story apartment building with victims on the roof. Officials said firefighters rescued two victims from the roof, while crews located two additional victims in a second-story bathroom and brought them out through a window. One additional victim was found on the ground outside the apartment. One adult and three children were transported to area hospitals in critical condition, and one adult was transported in stable condition, OPFD said. Crews brought the fire under control in about 15 minutes and did not spread to other apartments. No additional injuries were reported by OPFD, and the cause of the fire is under investigation. 标题: Cause of fire at Salina apartment complex determined
正文: SALINE COUNTy —Investigators determined the fire at a Salina apartment complex on Wednesday afternoon was accidental and caused by careless discarding of smoking materials, according to a statement from the Salina Fire Department. Just after 3p.m. Wednesday, crews were dispatched to The Ridge Apartment complex, 2363 Chapel Ridge after receiving reports of fire and smoke coming from the front of the two-story apartment building at the complex. Upon arrival, firefighters found heavy fire and smoke conditions extending from the front of the building into the soffit with fire already extending into the attic and through the roof. Crews immediately began fire suppression operations while also conducting a search for occupants in the affected apartment units. Due to the amount of active fire and potential for life safety issues, a second alarm was struck upon the arrival of the on-duty Battalion Chief. The fire was brought under control within approximately 30 minutes, with crews remaining on scene for an extended period to ensure the fire was fully extinguished and to check for any extension into neighboring units. While several residents were displaced as a result of the fire, all occupants were able to safely exit the building and there were no injuries to report. The cause of the fire has been ruled as accidental and likely due to the careless discarding of smoking materials near the front of the building.

标题: Calgary Fire Crews Respond to Early Morning SW Fire
命中: 热与温度|声音|时间序列
正文: Calgary Fire Crews Respond to Early Morning SW Fire At around 4:10am fire crews responded to the 1100 block of 17 AV SW for a structure fire. On arrival fire crews saw heavy smoke coming from the back alley of a single-story restaurant. A fire engine staged on the 17th AV side while a second fire engine went to the alley side. Crews stretched hose lines and made entry into the alley side door where they encountered heavy heat and smoke conditions. Crews reported there was fire in the drop-down ceiling and applied water to cool down the environment while working their way to the seat of the fire. Multiple fire crews were tasked with attacking the fire and utilized ventilation to decrease heat and smoke conditions before knocking down the fire. As the incident occurred in the early morning hours, fire crews needed to force entry into one neighbouring business to check for extension. They found light smoke and ventilated and no other signs of fire extension or damage. The building on the other side is a separate high rise building and not impacted by the fire. There were no occupants inside and no injuries reported. Fire watch crews have been rotating to ensure the fire is completely out. Fire Investigators are on scene and have started an investigation into the origin and cause. 标题: Two rescued from early morning fire in Manhattan
正文: RILEY COUNTY—Two people were rescued and hospitalized after an apartment fire in Manhattan. At 6:13 a.m. on Tuesday, the Manhattan Fire Department was dispatched to an apartment building fire at 509 Pierre Street in Manhattan, according to a media release. Upon arrival, crews found a two-story residential building with smoke and flames showing from the second floor, and two persons on the porch roof. A passerby had put up a ladder, climbed onto the porch roof, and helped an occupant out of a second-floor window and onto the porch roof. The driver of firetruck Quint 2 raised a fire department ladder, allowing the two to come down. Firefighters then entered the building to search for another occupant reported to be trapped inside. Firefighters found the person unconscious on the second floor and quickly removed them from the building. Both occupants of the second-floor apartment were transported by Riley County EMS. There were four occupants of the building in total, with two escaping the first-floor apartment fire prior to the fire department's arrival. The passerby was uninjured. One dog was transported by Riley County Animal Control to Kansas State Vet Med. Two dogs and a cat perished in the fire. The cause of the fire is under investigation at this time. The Kansas State Fire Marshal's Office and Riley County Police Department are assisting Manhattan Fire Investigators with the investigation.

标题: Incêndio atinge empresa química em Paulínia
正文: Um incêndio atingiu uma indústria de produtos químicos, na tarde deste sábado (21), em Paulínia (SP). Segundo a Prefeitura, houve uma explosão no reator da planta de fenol, e isso provocou o fogo. A EPTV, afiliada da TV Globo, recebeu imagens que mostram uma torre de fumaça preta, formada logo após o acidente, por volta de 16h. O vídeo também mostra uma chama alta (assista acima). O Corpo de Bombeiros e equipes da Rhodia, com apoio da Rede Integrada de Emergência (Rinem), do Plano de Auxílio Mútuo (PAM) e da Defesa Civil, atuaram no combate. O fogo foi controlado e ninguém ficou ferido. Equipes de segurança iniciaram o rescaldo e apuram se houve vazamento de produto para galerias e para o rio. Em nota, a Rhodia informou que o princípio de incêndio foi registrado após uma queda de energia externa não programada e que o fogo foi rapidamente controlado. "No momento, o evento já está dissipado e as equipes trabalham exclusivamente na etapa de rescaldo e monitoramento da área. As causas exatas do incidente estão sendo investigadas. A companhia reitera que, felizmente, não houve vítimas, tampouco danos ao meio ambiente ou às comunidades locais. Quanto às atividades produtivas, a Rhodia informa que a situação das instalações está sendo avaliada para que a retomada das operações ocorra com total segurança". 标题: Eaton Township firefighters battle residential fire after responding to car cras
正文: Eaton Township firefighters battle residential fire after responding to car crash EATON TOWNSHIP, Ohio (WOIO) - Eaton Township Fire and Rescue responded to a basement fire call while on scene assisting with a Columbia Township car accident Saturday morning. Eaton crews assisted the Columbia Township Fire Department with a car accident on Royalton Road at 11:59 a.m. Minutes later, crews received a call at 12:07 p.m. for a residential fire on Kara Court. When they arrived at the fire, it had advanced to the basement, according to the department, and extended into the first floor of the residential building. Occupants were evacuated before crews arrived on scene, and a pet was found and safely removed by firefighters. No civilian injuries were reported. One firefighter was evaluated for a minor injury. The department had the fire under control within 20 minutes. While working on the Kara Court fire, crews were dispatched to Copart on Royalton Road for a possible structure fire, the department said. They responded to the Copart call and found no hazards. Eaton Township Fire crews received assistance from Carlise Township Fire, Elyria Fire, Grafton Township Fire, North Ridgeville Fire, Lifecare EMS and the Lorain County Fire Investigation Unit. Crews said the cause of the Kara Court fire remains under investigation, and they did not release a loss value. Copyright 2026 WOIO. All rights reserved.

标题: Bermondsey Southwark Park Road shop fire - Child rescued
正文: A child has been rescued from a third-floor flat after a shop fire broke out in Bermondsey. The blaze started just before 6pm today (March 25) at a commercial property on Southwark Park Road in Bermondsey. Eight fire engines and approximately 60 firefighters were called to the scene. The ground-floor shop was destroyed and a small part of a first-floor flat was damaged by fire. Firefighters wearing breathing apparatus led a child to safety from a third-floor flat using a fire escape hood. Station Commander Tony Perks, who was at the scene, said: "Initial crews faced a very intense fire on arrival and worked swiftly to bring it under control and ensure residents in flats above the shop were safe." A fire escape hood was used during the rescue. The hoods provide up to 15 minutes of protection against toxic smoke and gases and were first introduced in 2018 following the Grenfell Tower fire. The child was safely led out of the building and there were no reports of injuries. Fire crews were dispatched to the scene from Dockhead, Old Kent Road, Deptford, New Cross, Peckham, Dowgate, Whitechapel, and surrounding fire stations. The fire was brought under control by 7.08pm. Mr Perks said: "There are road closures in place, which are expected to remain for a number of hours this evening, and we recommend people continue to avoid the area." The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

标题: Tolv sjekkes etter ? ha pustet inn r?yk under brann i boligblokk i Oslo
正文: Tolv sjekkes etter å ha pustet inn røyk under brann i boligblokk i Oslo Tolv personer sjekkes av helsepersonell etter å ha pustet inn røyk under en brann i en oppgang i en boligblokk på Rødtvet i Oslo lørdag kveld. Den første meldingen gikk ut på at det var røyk i en oppgang i 5. etasje. Politi og brannvesen kom til stedet. Flere beboere hadde da evakuert seg selv. – Brannvesenet har vært inne med røykdykkere. Det har vært brann i oppgangen og ikke i en leilighet. Brannen er slukket, men det er fortsatt mye røyk i oppgangen og også i noen leiligheter, opplyste operasjonsleder Per-Ivar Iversen i Oslo politidistrikt klokken 23.08. Senere opplyste han at brannen fremsto som påsatt. – Det er påtent en barnevogn som sto i fellesarealet/trappeoppgangen. Åpenbart påsatt, opplyste Iversen klokken 23.22. Brannvesenet sjekket sent på kvelden alle leilighetene i blokkens 5., 6. og 7.-etasjer med tanke på røyk og for å forsikre seg om at alle beboerne var i god behold. Politiet hadde først opplyst at tre personer hadde fått i seg røyk. Ved 2-tiden natt til søndag opplyste politiet at det dreier seg om tolv mennesker. – Totalt er per nå tolv personer fraktet til sykehus og legevakt for undersøkelser i forbindelse med brannen, primært knyttet til røykinhalering. Ingen fremstår alvorlig skadet, opplyser operasjonsleder Øyvind Hammervold. Politiet meldte om brannen klokken 22.52 lørdag kveld.

标题: 4 killed as fire engulfs 3 floors of Navi Mumbai residential building
正文: Four people were killed and at least 10 others were injured as a fire engulfed three floors of residential building in Navi Mumbai’s Vashi early Tuesday morning, prompting a multi-agency rescue and firefighting operation that lasted several hours. Police said the fire started shortly after midnight on the 10th floor of Raheja Tower and quickly spread to the 11th and 12th floors. Firefighters from Vashi, Airoli, Nerul, and Koparkhairane fire stations were rushed to the spot. “The fire has been brought under control, and cooling operations are underway. Four people were found dead on the 10th floor, and the bodies were sent to hospitals. Around 10 to 15 other residents were rescued safely,” said Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) chief fire officer Purushottam Jadhav. The cause of the fire is yet to be determined. “A detailed investigation is underway to ascertain whether the incident was caused by an electrical fault, gas leak, or any other reason,” he said. The cooling operations continued until morning to prevent re-ignition. 标题: 17 firefighters put out La Vergne grain silo fire
正文: 17 firefighters put out La Vergne grain silo fire Fire crews quickly brought a blaze under control at a Tennessee Farmers Co-Op grain facility in La Vergne after employees reported smoke coming from the building, authorities said. On Tuesday, Feb. 10, the La Vergne Fire Department responded within minutes to the co-op and saw smoke rising from one of the six-story towers of the grain structure. Officials said the fire was located in a hopper in the basement of the main building, part of the facility’s grain silo system. Seventeen La Vergne Fire & Rescue personnel responded to the scene. The Smyrna Fire Department provided mutual aid, and Box 55 offered additional support. Officers with the La Vergne Police Department assisted with scene safety and traffic control. Curtis Brinkley served as incident commander and said crews brought the fire under control within about 25 minutes of arrival. Firefighters remained on scene afterward to check for extension, including climbing exterior tower ladders to ensure the fire had not spread within the structure. Fire Chief Ronny Beasley credited the department’s pre-fire planning for the swift response. “We are familiar with the building, its operations, and the management team,” Beasley said in a statement. “This allowed us to know exactly where and how to approach the fire in an efficient and safe manner.” No injuries were reported.

标题: Mehrfamilienhaus brennt , aber die Feuerwehr kann sich den Flammen kaum n?hern
正文: Rauchentwicklung Mehrfamilienhaus brennt: Feuerwehr kann sich den Flammen kaum nähern Ravensburg • Lesedauer: 1 min. Gleich mehrere Elektrogeräte gerieten in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Brand. Wie die Polizei mitteilt, seien wohl aufgrund eines technischen Defekts fünf Waschmaschinen beziehungsweise Trockner vollständig ausgebrannt. Wegen der starken Rauchentwicklung rückten die Feuerwehr Ravensburg sowie die Johanniter aus. Der Brand ereignete sich gegen 20:30 Uhr im Absenreuterweg. +++Alle Informationen zum Brand im Video.+++ Selbst die Straße war so stark verraucht und verqualmt, dass sich Einsatzkräfte nur schwer nähern konnten. Die Feuerwehr musste mit Atemschutzausrüstung in das Gebäude eindringen, um den Brand zu löschen. Einige Bewohner wurden über die Drehleiter der Feuerwehr aus dem Gebäude gebracht. Durch die starke Rauchentwicklung war das Wohnhaus auch nach den Löscharbeiten nicht mehr bewohnbar. Alle Bewohner konnten sich selbständig um eine entsprechende Bleibe kümmern. Bei dem Brand entstand ein Schaden von circa 200.000 Euro. Es wurden zwei Personen durch eine Rauchgasintoxikation leicht verletzt. Davon musste eine Person in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert werden. 标题: Explosión de casa en Ecatepec deja una persona lesionada – Periódico Zócalo | No
正文: Los hechos ocurrieron la mañana de este domingo 21 de diciembre en la colonia Granjas Valle de Guadalupe dentro de una casa habitación. Explosión por gas deja un lesionado A través del Centro de Mando se reportó un incendio en una casa habitación, ubicada en la calle Pascual Morales, esquina Avenida Gobernador Gustavo Baz, por lo que de inmediato intervino personal de Protección Civil y Bomberos. Al llegar al lugar, los miembros de Atención Prehospitalaria, Rescate Urbano y Bomberos se percataron que se trató de una explosión por acumulación de gas en el segundo nivel de la vivienda, por lo que resultó lesionado un hombre de 43 años. El hombre fue atendido de inmediato por personal médico que diagnosticó que presentaba una superficie corporal quemada del 30 por ciento, por lo que fue traslado al Hospital 1ro. de Octubre del Instituto de Seguridad y Servicios Sociales de los Trabajadores del Estado (ISSSTE), ubicado en la alcaldía Gustavo A. Madero, en Ciudad de México. Evalúan riesgos de colapso También acudió al sitio personal de gestión de riesgos para evaluar el domicilio, ya que por la magnitud de la onda expansiva existe el riesgo de colapso, motivo por el cual bomberos realizaron el apuntalamiento provisional. Por último, Rescate Urbano reportó tres domicilios aledaños afectados, así como un poste de telefonía y varios vehículos dañados.

标题: 34 displaced after Covington apartment fire , Red Cross assisting
正文: COVINGTON, Ky. — The American Red Cross is stepping in to help after an apartment fire in Covington left 34 people displaced Friday. The Covington Fire Department said reports of smoke in an apartment building, located at 729 Edgecliff Rd., came in just before 12:15 p.m. Friday. Crews found smoke and fire between the second and third floors of the building, fire officials said. There were no injuries reported in the fire, the department confirmed. The event was upgraded to a second-alarm fire because of the "complexity of the building," according to Covington fire officials. The American Red Cross said an overnight shelter has now been set up for those displaced in the 13-unit fire. The shelter is at the Wilder City Building at 520 Licking Pike in Wilder, Ky. The organization said it anticipates 31 people to utilize the shelter Friday night. Emergency financial assistance, food and relief items like toiletries are provided by the American Red Cross. The organization also offers condolence care, health services, mental health services and one-on-one support to help connect people with local recovery assistance. The Covington Fire Department said the cause of the fire is still under investigation. Anyone impacted by the fire who has not yet contacted the American Red Cross can call 1-800-RedCross for more information on how to get support.

标题: Kreis Würzburg : Mehrfamilienhaus in Brand - zwei Bewohner schwer verletzt
正文: Ein Feuer brach am Donnerstagabend in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Ochsenfurt aus. Bei dem Versuch, den Brand zu löschen wurden zwei Bewohner des Hauses schwer verletzt. Zwei Bewohner sind am Donnerstagabend (18. Juni 2026) bei einem Feuer in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Ochsenfurt (Landkreis Würzburg) schwer verletzt worden. Gegen 18 Uhr wurde der Feuerwehr eine Rauchentwicklung im zweiten Obergeschoss des Hauses in der Hauptstraße gemeldet, berichtet die Polizei Unterfranken. Schnell waren zahlreiche Einsatzkräfte von Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst und Polizei vor Ort. Der Brand konnte rasch durch die Feuerwehren aus Ochsenfurt, Kleinochsenfurt und Darstadt eingedämmt und gelöscht werden. Bei eigenständigen Löschversuchen wurden zuvor jedoch die 21-jährige Wohnungsinhaberin und ein weiterer, 40-jähriger Hausbewohner, durch das Einatmen von Rauchgasen schwer verletzt. Beide wurden schließlich in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Die anderen Hausbewohner wurden unverletzt in Sicherheit gebracht. Der entstandene Sachschaden beläuft sich auf einen mittleren, fünfstelligen Betrag, so die Polizei. Derzeit ermittelt die Kriminalpolizei Würzburg unter anderem zur Brandursache.

In seiner Akte finden sich unter anderem Einträge zu Verdacht auf Körperverletzung, Fahren ohne Fahrerlaubnis und Sachbeschädigung. Laut Zeugen gab es Hinweise darauf, dass der Bewohner möglicherweise bewaffnet war. Polizistinnen sichern Feuerwehreinsatz in Schwalmtal Deshalb rückten deutlich mehr Beamte als sonst üblich an, um die Löscharbeiten zu schützen - einige sogar mit Maschinenpistolen. Auch die Feuerwehrleute hielten anfangs Abstand, um sich nicht in Gefahr zu bringen. Polizeibekannter Bewohner im Nachbarort festgenommen Der mutmaßlich gefährliche Bewohner wurde schließlich im Nachbarort gefunden und festgenommen - daraufhin konnten die Feuerwehrleute näher an die Flammen ran und das Feuer schließlich löschen. Waffen wurden bei dem Festgenommenen derweil keine gefunden. Die Kripo untersucht jetzt, wodurch der Brand in Schwalmtal ausgelöst wurde - und was es mit den Explosionsgeräuschen auf sich hatte. 标题: St . Paul firefighters find one dead during apartment fire
命中: 热与温度|声音|时间序列
正文: Firefighters putting out a blaze in a St. Paul senior living community early Friday found a person dead inside an apartment unit. The St. Paul Fire Department responded about 3:45 a.m. to a report of smoke in the first-floor hallway of Como by the Lake Senior Apartments at 901 E Como Blvd. Crews arrived to find moderate smoke coming from an apartment in the senior living community for ages 55 and older. Fire crews extinguished the fire and found a person dead inside the unit during a search, according to the Fire Department. St. Paul police are investigating the death, which can’t be ruled a fire fatality until all investigations are complete. The Ramsey County Medical Examiner’s Office will determine the cause of death. If ruled a fire fatality, this would be the fifth of 2025. The city averages two to three annually, according to the Fire Department. Three of the previous fire fatalities this year resulted from two back-to-back garage fires in February. In both incidents, people were taking shelter in a detached garage. One fire on Sims Avenue near White Bear Avenue was caused by a space heater that was accidentally knocked over. Another garage fire in the 1400 block of Mayre Street near Arlington Avenue and Rice Street was caused by either a two-burner electric hot plate with food on it or an electric portable radiant heater.

标题: Early morning apartment fire in downtown Lincoln , near Governor Mansion
正文: Early morning apartment fire in downtown Lincoln, near Governor’s Mansion LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - Lincoln Fire and Rescue responded to an apartment building fire near the Nebraska Governor’s Mansion Wednesday morning. Reports of a structure fire near the intersection of S. 13th and F streets, just one block from the Governor’s Mansion, began coming in around 3:39 a.m. Approximately nine emergency response vehicles were spotted on scene. Footage from the 10/11 Skyview camera showed high flames and thick smoke rising above the tree-line as the first reports came in. No occupants found; fire investigator on scene The building involved is a multi-unit apartment complex that had been previously red-tagged. LFR said the building had been condemned since March 2025. Crews arriving on scene found no occupants inside. LFR did speak with the owner at the scene. The fire was fully involved in one of the upper-level units upon arrival. The fire also made its way into the attic space. A fire investigator is now on scene. It is unknown at this time what caused the fire. 10/11 has a reporter on scene, but this is a developing story, stick with us for more updates as they come in. 标题: Effingham firefighters respond to apartment fire ; no one injured
正文: The Effingham Fire Department received a call at 10:37 a.m. Tuesday for a report of an apartment building on fire in the 300 block of North Oak Street, according to a press release. The fire was reported by a neighbor across the street. Upon arrival, crews saw light smoke coming from the front of the six-unit apartment building and heavier smoke and flames from the rear. Fire crews performed an aggressive interior fire attack and quickly brought the fire under control. They checked for occupants in the building and conducted a primary search, confirming all occupants were out of the building, according to the release. The fire originated on the first-floor rear porch area of apartment 308 and was contained to the apartment and the area of origin. Firefighters completed overhaul operations and checked for extension. Crews were on scene for just under one hour. Ameren Electric responded to the scene and secured power to the affected apartment. The fire was determined to be accidental, and damage is estimated at $40,000. Two occupants were displaced as a result of the fire. The Effingham Fire Department was assisted by the Effingham Police Department, Rural Med EMS, Teutopolis Fire Protection District and Shumway Fire Protection District. There were no injuries. The cause is determined to be accidental.

标题: Vacant apartment building burns through the night on Taylor Avenue in Oak Park
正文: It took local firefighters roughly 10 hours to extinguish a large structure fire in Oak Park that burned into the early hours of Wednesday morning. The Oak Park Fire Department responded to a significant structure fire on the 1200 block of N. Taylor Ave. at approximately 8:57 p.m. on Feb. 17. The fire continued to burn until Wednesday morning just before 7 a.m., village officials said in a statement. In the hours since, firefighters have remained on scene to contain “spot fires” that have emerged since the blaze was brought substantially under control, officials said. The building is a three-story apartment building with some retail space facing North Avenue. Firefighters closed traffic on North Avenue between Ridgeland Avenue and Austin Boulevard while they battled the fire, officials said. A passerby initially reported smoke and flames coming from a window at 1239 N. Taylor. The fire spread and OPFD requested a Level 1 box alarm, bringing many neighboring fire departments to the scene to help put out the fire, village officials said. The building is vacant, and no one was inside at the time the fire broke out, village officials said. No firefighters were injured during the response. The Office of the State Fire Marshal is leading an investigation into the cause of the fire, village officials said.

标题: Firefighters Rescue Four from Overland Park , KS , Fire
正文: Firefighters Rescue Four from Overland Park, KS, Fire Three children and two adults were hospitalized with injuries after an apartment fire in Overland Park early Saturday morning. Crews from the Overland Park, Lenexa and Shawnee Fire Departments responded just before 3 a.m. to the Sheridan Ridge Apartments at 83rd and Farley Streets. The first crew to arrive reported seeing smoke and fire from a two-story apartment building and that people were on the roof, according to a news release. While firefighters were rescuing two people from the roof, crews found two more people in a second-story bathroom and brought them out through a window, according to the release. Another person was found on the ground outside the apartment. One adult and three children were transported to a hospital with critical injuries, according to the Overland Park Fire Department. A second adult was transported with what was believed to be less serious injuries. The fire was contained to the apartment where it originated, the news release said, and did not spread to other units. Residents from the other units should be able to reoccupy their homes, a fire department spokesman said. An investigation into what caused the fire is ongoing. ©2026 The Kansas City Star. 标题: Corée du Sud . Elle veut tuer un cafard et met le feu à son immeuble avec un lan
正文: Corée du Sud Elle veut tuer un cafard et met le feu à son immeuble avec un lance-flamme artisanal : un mort En Corée du Sud, une jeune femme qui avait confectionné un lance-flamme artisanal pour se débarasser d'un cafard a mis le feu à son immeuble lundi, provoquant le décès d'une mère de famille. Sa méthode radicale pour se débarasser d'un cafard a tourné au drame. En Corée du Sud, une femme âgée d'une vingtaine d'années a été arrêtée pour avoir mis le feu à son immeuble lundi en tentant de tuer un cafard, rapporte la BBC. Une mère de famille est décédée dans l'incendie. La mise en cause a utilisé une technique, popularisée par les réseaux sociaux, qui consiste à approcher la flamme d'un briquet d'un spray inflammable. Elle a indiqué avoir déjà utilisé cette méthode par le passé. Mais cette fois, ce lance-flamme artisanal, censé permettre de se débarrasser des nuisibles, a été à l'origine d'un incendie mortel. Huit résidents hospitalisés Une voisine, âgée d'une trentaine d'années, est décédée en sautant du cinquième étage en tentant d'échapper aux fumées. Elle vivait dans un appartement de l'immeuble incendié avec son mari et leur nourrisson de quelques mois. Huit autres résidents ont été admis à l’hôpital après avoir inhalé de la fumée. La mise en cause est poursuivie pour « mort par négligence ».

标题: Five - alarm fire rips through Bronx buildings : FDNY – amNewYork
正文: The FDNY took on a five-alarm fire that tore through a Bronx building on Thursday night. At around 10:30 p.m. on Dec. 18, FDNY units responded to a call regarding a five-alarm fire at 855 Prospect Ave., which is located in a row of commercial buildings. The fire had started to extend to the nearby buildings. “Units arrived in less than four minutes. We found fire at a commercial establishment and it was extending to the adjacent stores. We also had fire on the roof of the six-story multiple dwelling and fire extended to the second floor. Those were quickly contained. The multiple dwelling was entirely evacuated,” said Assistant Chief Kevin Brennan. As many as four tower ladders were set up and three exterior house lines were used by fire personnel. As of 1:30 a.m., heavy smoke was still pushing from one of the buildings. “The smoke was drifting into my building as I was leaving. I came outside, and the sky was orange. This is not normal,” Bronx resident Grace Rivera told amNewYork. A resident was treated for minor injuries at the scene, and there were no further serious injuries as a result of the fire. The cause of the fire is under investigation by the FDNY Fire Marshals. This incident comes one day after the FDNY rescued a 15-month-old baby from an apartment fire on Anderson Avenue in the Bronx.

标题: CCTV image released after arson attack?at Carton House in New Road , Chatham
正文: More on KentOnline CCTV of a woman police want to speak to after vehicles were damaged in an alleged arson attack has been released. Officers were called to the blaze at Carton House in New Road, Chatham, just after midnight on Saturday (December 13). Video footage captured at the time showed a Jaguar engulfed in flames, along with two other cars. Residents had feared an explosion beneath their homes as they screamed and banged on doors to raise the alarm. One said they had a flashback of the Grenfell Tower fire, which killed more than 70 people at a London high-rise in 2017. Smoke surged up the front of the block as panicked residents ran door to door, screaming warnings to wake neighbours. According to the force, it is reported that a pile of rubbish was set alight, which caused the damage. The fire service, which joined police at the scene, extinguished the flames and eventually declared the building safe at about 3am. An investigation is underway, and officers have released an image of a woman who may be able to assist with the enquiries. While it is blurred, it is hoped somebody recognises her and contacts the appeal line. Anyone with information should call 01634 792209, quoting reference 46/215215/25. 标题: Dresden Fire Department experiences multiple fires over past 2 days
正文: Dresden Fire Department experiences multiple fires over past 2 days JACKSON, Tenn. (WBBJ) - The Dresden Fire Department is being kept busy with multiple fires occurring during a period of severe drought in West Tennessee. On Tuesday morning, the Dresden Fire Department was dispatched to a commercial structure fire on East Main Street in Dresden. Upon arrival, there was heavy smoke and fire conditions intensified and began venting through the roof. Mutual aid was requested from the Martin, Sharon, and Palmersville Fire Departments. It took approximately five hours to extinguish the fire. On Wednesday at 1:30 a.m., DFD responded back to East Main Street where the fire from Tuesday started to experience a small rekindle. DFD remained on scene for approximately one hour extinguishing the hot spots. Later that day at 4:28 a.m., DFD was dispatched to a hay barn fire near the intersection of Fire Tower Road and Gullyview Road. Mutual aid was requested from Latham Fire Department and it took approximately three hours to extinguish the fully involved barn. On Thursday morning around 5:15 a.m., DFD received a request from Palmersville Fire for mutual aid after a barn caught on fire off of Boydsville Road. 标题: Pullman arsonist sentenced to maximum 34 months following guilty plea
正文: PULLMAN, Wash. — A man who set fire to a Pullman apartment building in October 2025 received the maximum possible sentence this week after pleading guilty to arson and eluding police. Elijah Reagan entered guilty pleas for first-degree arson and attempting to elude law enforcement, resulting in a 34-month prison sentence. The charges stem from an intentional fire that damaged an apartment building in Pullman last fall. Investigators determined Reagan deliberately set the October 2025 blaze at the apartment complex. When officers attempted to arrest Reagan in connection with the arson, he fled, leading police on a high-speed pursuit. The chase ended when law enforcement called in a SWAT team. Trained negotiators convinced Reagan to surrender peacefully, and he was transported to the Whitman County Jail. Reagan's decision to enter guilty pleas this week avoided a lengthy trial and allowed for immediate sentencing. The 34-month sentence represents the maximum penalty available for the combined charges. The October apartment fire caused property damage and forced residents to evacuate their homes. 标题: Cop saves families as gas cylinder catches fire
正文: A potential disaster was averted in Delhi’s Dwarka district when a constable showed exceptional courage and presence of mind. He single-handedly removed a burning gas cylinder from a four-storey residential building, saving the lives of several families. The police received a PCR call at around 9.39 pm on Saturday about a cylinder blast in a building under Mohan Garden police station’s jurisdiction. The command room relayed the information immediately to Inspector Mukesh Antil, the Station House Officer (SHO), even before it reached the district control room. While rushing to the scene, the SHO alerted local beat staff. Constable Anil arrived first, ahead of the PCR van, fire brigade, and senior officers. Flames raged inside a kitchen on one floor, prompting him to assess the danger and act decisively. Ignoring personal risk, Anil entered the flat, dragged out the burning cylinder and extinguished the fire alone. His swift intervention stopped the blaze from spreading through the building, home to 16 families. Evacuating all residents on such short notice would have been extremely challenging, police noted, underscoring the constable’s critical role. “The instinct and daredevilry of a Delhi Police officer we all aspire to see, a proud moment for us all,” said DCP (Dwarka) Ankit Singh.

正文: Kontroll på brannen i Tønsberg sentrum Brannvesenet har fått kontroll på brannen i en bygård i Tønsberg sentrum. En kvinne er fraktet til sykehus, og 52 personer fra fire bygninger er evakuert. 正文: Destroyed homes, cancelled events: Hong Kong counts economic cost of Tai Po fire Wang Fuk Court flats that went up in flames worth about HK$5 billion, while losses from cancelled mega-events, banquets are likely to rise Economists and industry leaders estimate the losses could run into billions of Hong Kong dollars, with the total market value of the flats alone amounting to an estimated HK$5 billion (US$642.3 million). Last month’s blaze killed at least 160 people, including a firefighter, and left nearly 5,000 people homeless. While the consequences were still unfolding, some experts noted there were few cases elsewhere in the world in recent decades comparable to the Tai Po fire in terms of circumstance and scale. Others cited the Grenfell Tower blaze in west London in 2017 that claimed 72 lives and incurred £1.2 billion in financial losses, and a fire at a high-rise residential building in Shanghai in 2010 that led to 58 deaths and losses of at least 500 million yuan. “The responsibility of the fire has not yet been clarified,” Eric Tso Tak-ming, chief vice-president of mReferral Mortgage Brokerage Services, said of the Tai Po disaster. “The compensation process has not yet started, so who should be responsible for paying the compensation and how much are all unknown factors.”

标题: Six floor building catches fire in Kaneohe
正文: Six floor building catches fire in Kaneohe KANEOHE (HawaiiNewsNow) - A six floor residential building caught on fire Saturday in Kaneohe. The Honolulu Fire Department (HFD) received a 911 call at 7:30 p.m. and responded to a building fire at 46-270 Kahuhipa Street in Kaneohe. The first unit arrived and reported no signs of smoke or a fire. As the first unit investigated further, they reported smoke and flames coming from a sixth floor unit on the other side of the building. Fire fighters proceeded to the sixth floor to initiate an aggressive fire attack while other units secured a water supply. Once units arrived on the sixth floor, they witnessed neighbors using the building’s fire fighting hose to control the fire and assisted with evacuating the occupants. Firefighters provided basic life support for the residents and patient care was transferred to the Honolulu Emergency Medical Services Department at 7:50 p.m. The fire was brought under control at 7:53 p.m. and extinguished at 8:00 p.m. All HFD personnel were accounted for with no injuries reported. The Red Cross was requested to assist the displaced occupants. An investigation has been initiated to determine the fire’s origin and cause and to provide damage estimates. 标题: Belvedere St Thomas Road fire - pictures of the scene
正文: Pictures show a blaze that caused significant damage to a warehouse in Belvedere. The London Fire Brigade was called to St Thomas Road at around 2.15pm today (March 20). 70 firefighters in ten engines battled the flames that damaged half a single-storey warehouse. There were no reports of any injuries. Residents are warned to keep their windows and doors closed as smoke billows from the building. Station Commander Lee McCauley said: "Crews have made steady progress at the scene of the fire to bring it under control, a small part of the warehouse remains alight and crews will stay at the scene into the evening. "There are multiple road closures in place in the direct vicinity, which are likely to cause disruption for a number of hours. "The fire is producing some smoke and we urge people to avoid the area where possible and keep windows and doors closed if you live or work nearby." One of the Brigade's 32-metre turntable ladders was used as an observation tower, providing a vantage point for the incident commanders to assess the incident and develop tactics. Crews from Erith, Plumstead, East Greenwich, Greenwich, Sidcup and surrounding fire stations brought the fire under control soon after 6pm.. The cause of the fire is to be investigated by the London Fire Brigade.

标题: Feuer - Verletzte nach Explosion in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Kropp - Panorama
正文: Kropp (dpa/lno) - In einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Kropp (Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg) hat es am Morgen eine Explosion und ein Feuer gegeben. Mehrere Menschen hätten Rauchgasvergiftungen erlitten, sagte der Einsatzleiter der Feuerwehr. In dem Haus befinden sich demnach Wohnungen für Senioren. 29 Bewohner sind hier gemeldet. Von 28 wisse man, wo sie sich aufhielten, einer werde noch vermisst, sagte der Einsatzleiter. Die Feuerwehr hatte viele der Bewohner unter anderem mit einer Drehleiter von Balkonen gerettet. Bis zu 200 Einsatzkräfte sind am Morgen vor Ort. Auch etwa 20 Rettungswagen waren dabei. Die Explosion trat ersten Erkenntnissen zufolge in einer mittleren Erdgeschosswohnung auf, wie die Polizei mitteilte. Beim Eintreffen der Rettungskräfte stand die Wohnung in Vollbrand. Die durch die Explosion entstandene Druckwelle führte nach Angaben der Polizei dazu, dass Fenster und Türen des Mehrfamilienhauses und auch von umliegenden Häusern zum Teil aus den Rahmen sprangen. Die Explosionsursache ist bisher nicht bekannt. Der Einsatzort ist großflächig abgesperrt. Das THW wurde angefordert, um das Haus abzustützen. Vorher kann die Brandwohnung nach Angaben des Einsatzleiters nicht betreten werden. Das Haus ist demnach unbewohnbar. © dpa-infocom, dpa:260616-930-229530/2

标题: Hotelier races to shelter Hong Kong fire victims using Grenfell disaster lessons
正文: Hotelier races to shelter Hong Kong fire victims using Grenfell disaster lessons Dorsett Hospitality’s Winnie Chiu is leading logistics at Runway 1331 in Kai Tak to accommodate up to 2,000 displaced residents A hotelier is drawing on her experience sheltering survivors of London’s Grenfell Tower disaster to spearhead a relief operation at a former Covid-19 isolation centre in Hong Kong as she races to source 700 beds for families displaced by the Wang Fuk Court fire. Winnie Chiu Wing-kwan, the president and executive director of Dorsett Hospitality International, has taken personal charge of logistics at youth hostel and cultural hub Runway 1331 in Kai Tak, which has opened 500 guest rooms to accommodate up to 2,000 affected residents. “I worked until 4am for two consecutive days … the most urgent need is to make rooms habitable immediately for those in need, so we need mattresses and bed frames,” Chiu said. With about 300 rooms already occupied, the operator is seeking 700 ready-made single beds to maximise space, noting that traumatised families are requesting to share rooms for emotional support despite the compact unit sizes. “Even if the units are small, they want four people in one room because … they just want to be together with each other,” Chiu said.

标题: 17层住宅凌晨起火 他们科学自救成功逃生
命中: 嗅觉|通道被锁|楼梯间充烟|自行发现|固守待援
正文: 近日 广东省中山市三乡镇某小区 17层住宅凌晨发生火灾 消防部门接警后迅速到场处置 所幸着火住宅及相邻住宅的住户 接受过消防安全培训 在火灾发生时科学逃生自救 火灾并未造成人员伤亡 起火原因正在进一步调查当中 事发时 他们做对了什么？ 发现火情，及时报警 据了解，着火住宅屋主发现起火后，立即叫醒家人，当发现无法自行扑灭火灾后，众人便疏散到地面并报警求助。消防员到场后迅速展开行动，攻坚小组利用室内消火栓铺设水带，压制火势蔓延；搜救小组对着火楼层及相邻楼层展开搜救，在起火住宅对面的住宅发现一名被困住户，随即护送其沿疏散楼梯安全撤离至地面。 浓烟关门，固守待援 被困住户向消防员表示，在发现火情且楼梯间充满烟气后，她并没有慌乱逃窜，而是立即关闭房门，用湿毛巾堵住门缝，防止浓烟侵入，并用手机向外界发送求救信息。这一系列正确的自救行为，为自身安全脱险争取了宝贵时间。 冷静判断，捂口鼻有序撤离 住宅上层另有6名群众察觉楼下着火后，发现浓烟尚未充满楼梯间，且能见度正常，6人捂住口鼻，沿着疏散楼梯有序向下撤离，安全脱离险境。 高层建筑火灾 有这些危险性↓ 1.火险隐患多 高层建筑，特别是综合性的高层建筑，功能复杂，可燃物多，消防安全管理不严，火险隐患多，火灾危险性大。特别是火灾中产生烟雾和毒气，对生命安全造成很大威胁。 2.火势蔓延快 高层建筑一般室内可燃物较多，有的高层住宅建筑还违规设置可燃物品库房，一旦起火，燃烧猛烈，容易蔓延。 3.安全疏散困难 多数高层建筑安全疏散主要靠楼梯，但由于层数多，垂直距离长，疏散到地面或其他安全场所的时间也相对较长，且楼梯间内一旦窜入烟气，就会严重影响疏散。 4.扑救难度大 高层建筑高达几十米，甚至数百米，一旦室内消防设施不能正常发挥作用，从室外进行扑救相当困难。 如果要想成功逃生 很多时候要靠自救 这些大家要记牢 往上跑，还是往下跑？ 楼下起火 如楼梯间有浓烟 千万不要盲目通过楼梯间逃生 楼上起火 要往楼下跑 家外面着火 应第一时间判断起火点、火势大小 选择相应的逃生路线 出口被浓烟大火封住怎么办？ 如果出口被浓烟或者是大火给堵住不能安全穿越时，应该选择在目前的楼层关门避难，而不是往上或往下跑。切记，关上房门，用湿毛巾封堵门缝，迅速拨打119等待救援！ 眼下正值冬春季节 用火用电用气量增加 火灾隐患增多 消防安全不容小觑 这些安全细节要留心↓ （来源：中华人民共和国应急管理部、央视新闻客户端） 特别声明：以上内容(如有图片或视频亦包括在内)为自媒体平台“网易号”用户上传并发布，本平台仅提供信息存储服务。 Notice: The content above (including the pictures and videos if any) is uploaded and posted by a user of NetEase Hao, which is a social media platform and only provides information storage services.

标题: Wallingford apartment fire forces people , pets into cold
正文: Wallingford apartment fire forces people, pets into cold SEATTLE — Dozens of people and their pets were forced out into the cold after a fire broke out at an apartment building in Seattle's Wallingford neighborhood. It started at the Wallingford Inn apartments in the 4400 block of Green Lake Way North shortly before 3 a.m. Wednesday. When firefighters arrived, residents were evacuated, and there was concern that the flames from a second-floor unit could quickly spread to others. Video from the scene showed a burned-out window, and at least one unit is a total loss. Other apartments were affected by smoke. One resident said her pets alerted her to the fire. "My cats started stirring, my dogs started getting restless, and I heard somebody yelling, so I ran up and went to the door, and saw all the smoke, and shut the door, and went to gather my animals," said Cheryl Stepleton. A Seattle Fire Department spokesperson said the fire was under control within about 20 minutes and was completely out in less than 40 minutes. Because the building is near busy Aurora Avenue North, lanes had to be closed during the firefight, but have since reopened. A 40-year-old man with minor injuries was treated by medics at the scene. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

标题: 本堂 、 庫裏全焼 火元か 高岡 ? 大法寺 少なくとも10棟延焼 鎮火まで8時間40分｜社会｜富山のニュース｜富山新聞
正文: １６日夜、高岡市利屋町（とぎやまち）の日蓮宗大法寺から出火した火事で、高岡署と市消防本部は１７日、実況見分を行った。大法寺本堂と住職の住居部分にあたる庫裏が全焼して火元の可能性もあるとみて調査を進める。この火災で、通町御車山交流館と空き家１棟を含め、少なくとも周辺の民家など計１０棟に延焼し、延焼棟数は増える可能性がある。両署は１８日午前９時半から実況見分を再開し、火元と出火原因などを調べる。 ●檀家「心のよりどころ無く」 １６日午後６時４５分ごろに出火し、約８時間４０分後の１７日午前３時２８分に消し止めた。けが人は確認されていない。 大法寺の本堂と庫裏のほか、位牌堂、開山堂、納骨堂、土蔵などが燃え、焼失状況を調査している。風の影響で、大法寺から西に約７０メートル離れた通町御車山交流館と空き家１棟に飛び火したとみられる。 １７日、大法寺では午前１０時から午後５時すぎまで、警察や消防、栗原啓允（けいいん）住職ら寺の関係者が出入りし、実況見分が行われた。栗原住職は取材に「１８日に総代会を開いて経緯を説明したい」と述べた。 周辺は規制線が張られ、住民や檀家らが不安そうな表情で様子を見守った。 「檀家なんだけど」と規制線をくぐって寺の中を見に行こうとする人や、寺に向かって手を合わせて涙ぐむ人もいた。 寺の世話をする男性（７４）によると、寺には仏像をはじめ日蓮宗の教本や檀家から寄進された焼香台、掛け軸などがあり、「何百年の歴史をかけて受け継いだものが全部燃えてしまった」と肩を落とした。 檀家の男性（８５）は焼け落ちた建物を見て言葉を失った。男性は「心のよりどころが無くなり、胸が痛む。住職らが無事だったのは何よりで、再建に向け、支えていかないといけない」と話した。 納骨堂に両親の遺骨を納めている男性（７０）は慌てた様子で駆けつけ、「骨が残っているか心配。火葬した上、火事で燃えてしまうのはあまりにもかわいそうだ」と語った。 近くに住む５０代女性は、自宅の玄関前に散らばった黒い燃えかすをほうきとちりとりでかき集めた。女性の自宅もガラスが割れたり家の一部が溶けたりしたといい、「きのうは消火活動で家に近寄れず、帰ってきたのは夜１１時を過ぎてからだった」と振り返った。 近くに住む男性は「家族の知らせで外を見ると、本堂東側から煙が出て、あっという間に炎が燃え広がった」と話した。 ●重文など１０点、 美術館で保管 市美術館によると、大法寺は安土桃山時代の七尾出身の絵師、長谷川等伯（信春）筆の仏画など１０点を美術館に寄託し、全て、無事に保管されている。 このうち、国重要文化財は「紙本著色一塔両尊像（しほんちゃくしょくいっとうりょうそんぞう）」「紙本著色日蓮像」「紙本著色鬼子母神十羅刹女（きしもじんじゅうらせつにょ）像」「絹本（けんぽん）著色三十番神像」でいずれも等伯作。 現場は高岡駅から北西約１キロで寺院や民家が密集。近くに重伝建（重要伝統的建造物群保存地区）の山町筋が位置し、高岡御車山会館や高岡信用金庫本店、高岡郵便局などがある。

标题: Berlin & Brandenburg : Brand in Fürstenwalde - 84 - J?hrige kommt ins Krankenhau
正文: Berlin & BrandenburgBrand in Fürstenwalde - 84-Jährige kommt ins Krankenhaus Nach einem Brand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Fürstenwalde musste eine 84-Jährige ins Krankenhaus. Wie die Feuerwehr und Polizei den Einsatz schildern. Fürstenwalde (dpa/bb) - Eine 84-Jährige ist nach einem Brand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Fürstenwalde (Landkreis Oder-Spree) zur ärztlichen Kontrolle ins Krankenhaus gebracht worden. Das teilte die Polizei mit. Die Feuerwehrleitstelle hatte in der Nacht zu Freitag zunächst von zwei Personen gesprochen, die ins Krankenhaus kamen. Nach Angaben der Polizei brach das Feuer am Donnerstagabend im vierten Stockwerk eines Hauses in der Trebuser Straße aus. Durch den entstandenen Rauch kam die 84-Jährige nicht aus ihrer Wohnung über der Brandwohnung, wie die Polizei mitteilte. Demnach holten Einsatzkräfte die Frau aus ihrer Wohnung. Das Gebäude wurde evakuiert, darunter auch die 49 Jahre alte Mieterin der Brandwohnung. Diese ist vorerst nicht bewohnbar. Durch die Löscharbeiten wurden nach Polizeiangaben zudem weitere Wohnungen in Mitleidenschaft gezogen. Zur Brandursache machten Polizei und Feuerwehr keine Angaben. Nach ersten Erkenntnissen der Polizei war das Feuer in der Küche der Wohnung ausgebrochen. Die Kriminalpolizei ermittelt.

标题: Leiche bei Brand in Düsseldorf entdeckt - Rheinland - Nachrichten

标题: Boligbrann i Ski sentrum : – Flere evakuert
正文: Brannvesenet meldte litt før klokken 23 mandag kveld at det brant i boligblokka i Åsveien 4, i Ski sentrum. På det tidspunktet var røyken synlig i store deler av Ski sentrum. Litt over midnatt bekrefter politiets innsatsleder Gjermund Westberg Hage til ØB at brannen er slukket, og at de har fått en oversikt over alle beboerne i blokka. Ingen er alvorlig skadd. Tre personer er imidlertid fraktet til Ahus etter å ha fått i seg røyk. Flere evakuert Politiets operasjonsleder, Håkon Hatlen, skrev at 27 personer ble evakuert fra leilighetsbygget. Disse ble innlosjert på hotell som følge av brannen. Klokka 02.47 melder politiet at de er ferdig på stedet, og at en av leilighetene er utbrent, og flere er ubeboelige. Tror de vet hvordan brannen startet Det har brent i en av de øverste leilighetene i blokka, som har tre etasjer. Ifølge brannvesenets vaktleder Thomas Silva er det en leilighet som har vært overtent. Westberg Hage sier at politiet har en formening om hvordan brannen startet, basert på det noen av de evakuerte selv har fortalt. Politiet oppretter sak på hendelsen. På et tidlig tidspunkt ble det også meldt om fare for at brannen kunne spre seg. – Det er røyk i hele Ski sentrum, fortalte Silva til ØB klokken 22.58. Åsveien ble stengt for biltrafikk.

标题: 500 . 000 Euro Schaden bei Brand mit Explosionen in Wohnhaus
正文: 500.000 Euro Schaden bei Brand mit Explosionen in Wohnhaus Laute Knallgeräusche sind bei einem Brand in Stuttgart zu hören. Feuerwehrleute retten auch eine Katze vor den Flammen. Nun gibt die Polizei weitere Details zur Schadenshöhe bekannt. Nach dem Brand eines Stuttgarter Mehrfamilienhauses, in dem es mutmaßlich Explosionen gegeben hat, schätzen die Ermittler den Schaden auf rund eine halbe Million Euro. Bei dem Fall am Freitag sei ein Mann leicht verletzt worden, teilte die Polizei mit. Die Feuerwehr hatte nach dem Einsatz zuvor von einer schwer verletzten Person berichtet, der Polizei lagen dazu aber keine Informationen vor, wie ein Sprecher sagte. Die Einsatzkräfte retteten zudem eine Katze aus dem brennenden Haus. Sie wurde dem städtischen Tiernotdienst übergeben. Eine Nachbarin hatte den Angaben zufolge am Freitag laute Knallgeräusche gehört und den Notruf gewählt. Als die Feuerwehr an dem Haus ankam, sollen die Flammen bereits Flammen aus dem Wohnhaus geschlagen und sich über mehrere Etagen ausgebreitet haben. Zudem hörten die Einsatzkräfte weitere Knallgeräusche. Die Feuerwehrleute mussten Teile des Daches abdecken. Das Gebäude ist demnach unbewohnbar. Warum das Feuer ausbrach, war zunächst unklar. Die Ermittlungen der Polizei dauern an.

标题: Brand in Schwarzenbek : Seniorin verletzt , hohe Schadenssumme
正文: Ein Wohnungsbrand in der Straße Pirschgang in Schwarzenbek löste am Samstag einen Einsatz der Feuerwehr aus. Die Hochparterre-Wohnung stand beim Eintreffen der Einsatzkräfte in Flammen. Eine Seniorin wurde verletzt ins Krankenhaus gebracht. Der Schaden ist beträchtlich. Brand in Schwarzenbek: Laut Angaben der Polizei kam es im Pirschgang am Samstagnachmittag, 15. November, gegen 13 Uhr zu einem Wohnungsbrand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus. 74-Jährige leicht verletzt Sandra Kilian, Pressesprecherin der zuständigen Polizeidirektion Ratzeburg, erklärt: „Beim Eintreffen der Einsatzkräfte der Feuerwehr stand die Wohnung im Hochparterre bereits im Vollbrand.“ Durch das Eingreifen der Einsatzkräfte sei eine weitere Ausbreitung des Feuers auf andere Wohnungen verhindert werden können. Die Bewohnerin der brennenden Wohnung habe sich jedoch leichte Verbrennungen und eine Rauchvergiftung zugezogen. Die 74-Jährige sei daher in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert worden. Ermittlungen dauern an Nach dem Löschen sei der Brandort beschlagnahmt worden: Ein Routineverfahren, wenn wie in diesem Fall die Ursache für ein Feuer noch unklar ist. Die Ermittlungen dauern an. Kilian: „Weitere Personen wurden nicht verletzt.“ Der Schaden werde auf circa 150.000 Euro geschätzt.

标题: Incêndio atinge apartamento em prédio na Avenida S?o Jo?o , no Centro de SP
正文: Um incêndio atingiu na tarde desta sexta-feira (25) um apartamento em um prédio residencial na icônica Avenida São João, na altura da Rua Pedro Américo, no Centro de São Paulo. Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, o fogo começou no 14º andar do edifício. Por volta das 17h, uma pessoa estava sendo avaliada pela equipe médica no local. Não há informações sobre vítimas. Ao menos cinco viaturas foram enviadas ao local para atendimento ao chamado de emergência. Devido à ocorrência, uma faixa da Avenida São João ficou bloqueada pelas equipes dos bombeiros e da Polícia Militar por cerca de uma hora. Em uma imagem obtida pela TV Globo, é possível observar muita fumaça branca saindo do apartamento. A fumaça é tanta que encobre o prédio. Nesse momento, dá para ver as equipes dos Bombeiros, Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) e Polícia Militar chegando no local (veja imagens acima). Em nota, a Secretaria da Segurança Pública (SSP) afirmou que as equipes do Corpo de Bombeiros foram mobilizadas e "atuaram rapidamente no combate às chamas, que já foram extintas". A pista foi liberada por volta das 18h, segundo a Companhia de Engenharia de Tráfego (CET). Incêndio atinge apartamento em prédio no Centro de SP — Foto: Carol Pinheiro/Reprodução

标题: Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus in Frankenthal : 100 . 000 Euro Schaden
正文: Frankenthal. Am Samstagmorgen ist ein Brand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Frankenthal ausgebrochen. Wie die Polizei mitteilte, meldeten Personen der Polizeiinspektion Frankenthal explosionsartige Geräusche aus dem betroffenen Haus im Stadtteil Eppstein. Daraufhin rückten die Feuerwehr, der Rettungsdienst und die Polizei aus. Vor Ort war eine starke Rauchentwicklung am Mehrfamilienhaus sichtbar. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt hatten die Anwohner das Gebäude bereits verlassen. Bei einer Person bestand der Verdacht einer Rauchvergiftung, weshalb sie von Rettungskräften versorgt wurde. Sie musste jedoch nicht in ein Krankenhaus gebracht werden. Nachdem die Feuerwehr das Feuer gelöscht hatte, stellte sie die vermutliche Ursache des Brandes fest. 标题: Sidcup Heron Crescent fire : Firefighters to remain on scene
正文: Firefighters are expected to remain at the scene of a large blaze in Sidcup this afternoon after battling flames that tore through the roof of a derelict building. The London Fire Brigade confirmed that eight fire engines and around 60 firefighters responded to the incident on Heron Crescent, which began shortly after 1.30pm today (July 24). Crews from Orpington, Bromley, Lee Green and nearby stations were mobilised after the first of eight emergency calls was received at 1.31pm. The fire, which broke out in the roof of a two-storey vacant building, was brought under control by 3.48pm. Despite this progress, firefighters will remain on site into the evening to fully extinguish the blaze and carry out dampening down operations to prevent any flare-ups. A 32-metre turntable ladder from Greenwich Fire Station was deployed and used as both a water tower and observation platform. A drone was also flown to provide the Incident Commander with greater situational awareness during the response. Local residents were advised to keep windows and doors shut due to heavy smoke in the area. Motorists are warned to expect ongoing disruption on Main Road near the scene. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation.

标题: Apartment fire leaves one dead , one injured in Wiggins
正文: Apartment fire leaves one dead, one injured in Wiggins WIGGINS, Miss. (WXXV)- A tragic loss in Wiggins as the Wiggins Fire Department was dispatched to a reported structure fire Tuesday evening. Wiggins Fire Department personnel were supported by the Wiggins Police Department, Stone County Fire Service, Stone County Sheriff’s Department, and Pafford Ambulance Service to assist with fireground operations, scene control, and patient care. Upon arrival to the scene, firefighters established a water supply from a nearby hydrant and initiated an aggressive fire attack while conducting a rapid primary search for possible victims inside the structure. Once the main body of the fire was extinguished, it was determined that two apartment units sustained heavy damage, while a third suffered significant smoke damage. There was one confirmed fatality at the scene. A second patient was transported by Pafford EMS to Memorial Hospital in Gulfport where they were reported to be in stable condition. Wiggins Fire Department confirms there were no reports of injured firefighters or other responders from the incident. We will continue to keep you update with more details as they become available.

标题: Bayern : Hochhaus in Regensburg wegen Balkonbrand evakuiert
正文: BayernHochhaus in Regensburg wegen Balkonbrand evakuiert Die Feuerwehr wird wegen eines Brandes auf einem Balkon gerufen. Weil Rauch in das Gebäude zieht, müssen Dutzende Menschen ihre Wohnungen verlassen. Regensburg (dpa/lby) - Ein Hochhaus in Regensburg ist wegen eines Brandes auf einem Balkon evakuiert worden. 85 Menschen, darunter 18 Kinder, mussten am Abend vorsorglich das Gebäude verlassen, wie die Feuerwehr mitteilte. Der Rauch sei vom Balkon in das Treppenhaus des achtstöckigen Hauses gezogen. Die Betroffenen kamen zwischenzeitlich in einer nahegelegenen Pfarrei unter. Die Flammen verursachten laut Polizei auf dem Balkon einen geringen Schaden. Lediglich die Hausfassade sei durch den Ruß schwarz gefärbt, sagte ein Sprecher. Nach einer guten Stunde konnten die Bewohner zurück in das Haus kehren. Verletzt wurde ersten Erkenntnissen zufolge niemand. Warum der Brand ausbrach, war zunächst unklar. Direkt nach dem Eintreffen der Feuerwehr mussten mehrere Einsatzkräfte zu einem anderen Einsatz weiterfahren. Eine Brandmeldeanlage hatte ausgelöst - der Alarm stellte sich später als Fehlalarm heraus. Die Feuerwehrleute konnten den Brand an dem Hochhaus dennoch schnell löschen.

标题: Mehrere Verletzte bei Br?nden in Nordhessen
正文: Mehrere Verletzte bei Bränden in Nordhessen In einem Fall wird ein 54-Jähriger im Schlaf vom Feuer überrascht, im anderen ein 69-Jähriger durch Rauch schwer verletzt. Einige Mieter müssen nun vorerst woanders unterkommen. Bei zwei Bränden innerhalb weniger Stunden in Nordhessen sind insgesamt drei Personen verletzt worden. Das erste Feuer sei am Donnerstagabend in Vellmar vermutlich in der Küche eines Wohn- und Geschäftshaus ausgebrochen, teilte die Polizei mit. Ein 54 Jahre alter Bewohner, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt bereits schlief, erlitt eine Rauchvergiftung. In der Wohnung sei glücklicherweise nur ein geringer Schaden entstanden, teilten die Beamten weiter mit. Eine schwere Rauchvergiftung trug ein 69-Jähriger bei einem Feuer davon, zu dem einige Stunden später Einsatzkräfte in Lohfelden eilten. Den ersten Ermittlungen zufolge war das Feuer in einer Wohnung im ersten Stock eines Mehrfamilienhauses ausgebrochen. Neben dem 69-Jährigen wurde ein weiterer Bewohner - allerdings leicht - durch eingeatmeten Rauch verletzt. Die Beamten schätzten den Sachschaden an dem derzeit unbewohnbaren Gebäude auf mindestens 150.000 Euro. Die Brandursache in beiden Fällen war zunächst unklar.

标题: No injuries reported after fire in Danville , officials say
正文: No injuries reported after fire in Danville, officials say DANVILLE, Va. (WSET) — The Danville Fire Department (DFD) said no injuries were reported after a fire on Monday evening. Firefighters responded to a reported structure fire at 9:10 p.m., to Ricketts Street. The DFD responded with three Engines, 1 Tower truck, 1 Support unit, and 1 Command unit with a total of 15 personnel. The first arriving unit saw fire coming from the rear of the home near the back door. Upon further investigation, the fire was located in the kitchen area and was put out quickly, Officials said. SEE ALSO: Motorcyclist dead following Danville crash, police say charges are pending The home was searched for any people inside, but no one was located inside; and the home was ventilated of all smoke, according to officials. No injuries were reported, officials said. The Danville Fire Department was helped on scene by the Danville Life Saving Crew, Electric Dept. contractors, and the Danville Police Dept. The Danville Fire Marshal's Office will conduct an investigation to determine the cause of the fire, officials said. The people who live in the home are being helped by the Red Cross, officials said.

标题: Crews fight fire at farmer co - op in La Vergne
正文: Crews fight fire at farmers’ co-op in La Vergne Crews fought the fire and were able to get it under control within 25 minutes of LVFD’s arrival. LA VERGNE, Tenn. (WSMV) - The La Vergne Fire Department extinguished a fire at Tennessee Farmers Co-Op on Thursday afternoon. The department said crews arrived within minutes of the fire being reported and saw smoke coming from one of the six-story towers of the grain structure. “The fire was located in a hopper in the basement of the main structure, which is part of the grain silo system,” LVFD said. Crews fought the fire and were able to get it under control within 25 minutes of LVFD’s arrival. Firefighters then conducted checks for fire extension, which included climbing the exterior tower ladders. The Smyrna Fire Department and the La Vergne Police Department also responded to the scene. “This is a great example of our pre-fire planning process,” said Fire Chief Ronny Beasley. “We are familiar with the building, its operations, and the management team. This allowed us to know exactly where and how to approach the fire in an efficient and safe manner.” No injuries have been reported. Copyright 2025 WSMV. All rights reserved.

标题: Hessen : N?chtliches Feuer in Offenbach – 71 - J?hriger verletzt
正文: HessenNächtliches Feuer in Offenbach – 71-Jähriger verletzt Dichter Rauch, Flammen an der Fassade und Evakuierung in der Nacht: Ein Sperrmüllbrand führt zu einem Großeinsatz. Was ist in dem Mehrfamilienhaus passiert? Offenbach (dpa/lhe) - Bei einem nächtlichen Feuer in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Offenbach ist der Bewohner einer Erdgeschosswohnung verletzt worden. Der 71-Jährige kam laut Polizei mit einer Rauchgasvergiftung und leichten Armverbrennungen ins Krankenhaus. Ein Sperrmüllhaufen vor dem Gebäude war aus zunächst unbekannten Gründen in Brand geraten. Das Feuer griff auf die Fassade über und beschädigte mehrere Wohnungen, vor allem auch diejenige im ersten Stock. Die dortige Familie konnte sich rechtzeitig in Sicherheit bringen. Der Schaden beläuft sich auf rund 100.000 Euro. Starke Rauchentwicklung Die Feuerwehr war mit einem Großaufgebot im Einsatz und brachte die Flammen zügig unter Kontrolle. Wegen der starken Rauchentwicklung mussten alle Hausbewohner das Gebäude verlassen. Mehrere Bewohner klagten über eingeatmete Rauchgase und wurden vorsorglich vom Rettungsdienst untersucht. Nach umfangreicher Belüftung gab die Feuerwehr die oberen Stockwerke wieder frei.

标题: Bonn - Auerberg : Kellerbrand in Mehrfamilienhaus – Feuerwehr verhindert Rauchau
正文: Die Feuerwehr konnte eine Rauchausbreitung im Treppenhaus verhindern. Verletzt wurde bei dem Einsatz niemand. Großeinsatz in Bonn-AuerbergKellerbrand in Mehrfamilienhaus sorgt für Feuerwehreinsatz Am Samstagabend ist die Bonner Feuerwehr gegen 18.23 Uhr zu einem Einsatz in der Pariser Straße im Ortsteil Auerberg gerufen worden. Aus dem Keller eines Mehrfamilienhauses wurde eine Rauchentwicklung gemeldet, die sich bei Eintreffen der Einsatzkräfte bestätigte. Feuerwehr schützt Treppenhaus vor Rauch Um eine Ausbreitung des Rauchs im Treppenraum zu verhindern, setzten die Einsatzkräfte einen Rauchschutzvorhang ein. Ein Trupp ging unter Atemschutz mit einem Löschrohr zur Brandbekämpfung in den Keller vor. Gleichzeitig betreuten weitere Kräfte mehrere Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner, darunter eine gehbehinderte Person, im sicheren Bereich des Gebäudes. Das Feuer war nach Angaben der Feuerwehr schnell unter Kontrolle. Da die Nachlöscharbeiten und die Entrauchung jedoch sehr umfangreich waren, wurde eine weitere Löscheinheit zur Unterstützung nachalarmiert. Verletzt wurde bei dem Einsatz, der gegen 21.00 Uhr beendet war, niemand. (red) Dieser Inhalt wurde mit Hilfe von KI erstellt.

命中: 嗅觉|声音|照明失效|时间序列
正文: 周日（11月16日）下午，奇诺岗（Chino Hills）一栋房子在毫无预警之下突然爆炸，随后引发火灾。 据当地邻居表示，爆炸后许多人从房子里逃了出来，其中有几个小孩，有的没穿鞋就跑了出来，一些邻居帮着把孩子送去医院抢救。 据初步统计，一共有8人受伤，经过抢救都没有生命危险。 根据圣贝纳迪诺县警方通报，爆炸发生下午3 点 45 分左右，地点位于奇诺岗塞拉维斯塔大道（ Sierra Vista Drive ） 4222 号，由于是周日，许多人都在家里忙自己的事，突然传出一声巨响。 附近房屋窗户被震碎，车道上的多辆车辆被飞溅的碎片覆盖，甚至还能看到玩具泰迪熊被掀落在车顶，显示爆炸冲击强烈程度。 “突然，我听到一声巨响，听起来就像炸弹爆炸一样。”邻居安德鲁·胡因（ Andrew Huynh ）描述当时的震撼瞬间，“过了几秒的沉默，就听到汽车警报声、尖叫声，到处都是碎片。” 胡因表示，他看到对面房子的一家人抱着孩子逃出来，宠物狗也在街上狂奔。“火势开始往外蔓延，情况变得非常危险。”他说。 另一位邻居表示，她们看到受害者（其中一些是孩子）从烧毁的房屋中跑出来。 “他们当时就大声呼救，说着‘哎哟！好痛！救命！’你知道，他们光着脚，穿着睡衣。小男孩没穿上衣，只穿着运动裤。情况很危急，”一位目击者说道“他们的头发被烧焦了，脸上沾满了血迹。” 原因 疑似天然气爆炸 根据圣贝纳迪诺县警方表示，爆炸发生时屋内一共有8名受害者，有一半的人被急救车送去医院，另外一位邻居将一些年轻的受害者送去了医院，目前均没有生命危险。 根据网上流传的事故照片显示，爆炸后的房屋正面几乎完全被烧毁。外墙焦黑、屋顶塌陷，火舌甚至蔓延至邻近围栏，整个街区弥漫着刺鼻的烟味。 圣贝纳迪诺县警长办公室和奇诺谷消防局接警后迅速赶到现场，与燃气公司协调切断燃气、控制火势，并对周围住户进行紧急疏散。 奇诺谷消防局局长乔恩·克里普（Jon Cripe）表示，现场救援人员到达后立即检测到燃气泄漏。“目前我们已疏散 16 户居民。燃气公司已到达现场，我们正在合作隔离燃气并继续控制紧急状况。”克里普说。 邻居不满 邻居称该住户“问题不断” 虽然官方初步判断爆炸与煤气泄漏有关，但确切原因仍在调查。 然而，许多邻居向媒体透露，他们对这栋房屋发生事故一点也不惊讶——原因是那里“长期出问题”。 邻居艾德琳·阿尔瓦雷斯（Adrienne Alvarez）表示，她很少在白天看到屋内的居民，但曾亲眼见到社会服务人员多次上门。“他们一直都有问题。”她说。 另一位邻居胡因证实，过去一两周警方多次到过该物业，“警察这几天来这里不止一次，每次都一样，他们拘留一些人，但从没发生真正的改变。然后突然之间，这房子就爆炸了。” 有住户表示，社区一直担心该住宅内可能存在违法活动，但目前尚无官方证实。 目前，具体情况还在调查之中。

标题: Hessen : Neunter Brand in einem Wiesbadener Wohnhaus
正文: HessenNeunter Brand in einem Wiesbadener Wohnhaus Schon wieder brennt es in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Wiesbaden. Ein Mann wird per Drehleiter aus seiner Wohnung gerettet. Die Kriminalpolizei ermittelt. Wiesbaden (dpa/lhe) - In einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Wiesbaden ist erneut ein Feuer ausgebrochen. Ein Bewohner alarmierte in der Nacht die Einsatzkräfte, nachdem er Rauch und Flammen im Flurbereich entdecke und der Rauch kurze Zeit später in seine Wohnung eingedrungen war, wie die Polizei mitteilte. Der 63-Jährige sei angewiesen worden seine Wohnung nicht zu verlassen, sondern auf dem Balkon auf Hilfe zu warten und sich bemerkbar zu machen. Den Angaben zufolge wurde der Mann über eine Drehleier gerettet. Er blieb unverletzt. Unterdessen löschten mehrere Einsatzkräfte der Feuerwehr die Flammen, sechs Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner des Hauses wurden vom Rettungsdienst betreut. Die Kriminalpolizei hat die Ermittlungen zu Brandursache übernommen. Laut den Angaben kommt es sei Anfang 2024 immer wieder zu Bränden in dem Wohnhaus im Stadtteil Biebrich. "Der aktuelle Einsatz ist bereits der neunte in Folge", hieß es. In allen Fällen werde von vorsätzlicher Brandstiftung ausgegangen.

正文: Am Mittwochabend eilten Polizei, Feuerwehr und Rettungskräfte in die Borntalstraße in Sondershausen, um nach einer unklaren Rauchentwicklung aus einer Wohnung in einem Mehrfamilienhaus zu schauen.
