标题: Brand in W?hring – Rauchwolken über Wien ! Dachstuhlbrand artet aus
正文: Blaulicht und dunkle Rauchwolken über Wien-Währing! Sonntagabend kam es gegen 21.00 Uhr zum Großeinsatz in der Theresiengasse. Der Grund: Im Dachstuhl eines Wohnhauses hatte sich ein Feuer ausgebreitet. So wurde für die Bewohner ein ursprünglich ruhiger Abend zum wahren Schockmoment. Sofort rückten die Einsatzkräfte der Wiener Berufsfeuerwehr an, um die Flammen zu bekämpfen. Doch dazu musste zuerst das Dach geöffnet werden, um einen entsprechenden Löschangriff vorzunehmen. Mehrere "Heute"-Leser beobachteten gespannt den Einsatz und sahen wie die Einsatzkräfte das Dach aufsägten. "Nachdem sie das Dach geöffnet hatten, konnte man sehen wie sich darunter Flammen befanden", erklärt ein geschockter Leserreporter. "Der Brand wurde recht schnell wieder unter Kontrolle gebracht", beschreibt ein Feuerwehrsprecher den Einsatz gegenüber "Heute". Glücklicherweise war ein Mieter rechtzeitig auf die Flammen aufmerksam geworden und so konnte das Gröbste verhindert werden. So gab es keine Verletzten bei dem Feuer und die Einsatzkräfte konnten nach getaner Arbeit wieder abrücken. Wie genau es zu dem Brand kam ist derzeit noch offen und Gegenstand laufender Ermittlungen.

标题: Section of Strovolos avenue reopens after fire
正文: All possibilities remain open, including that of criminal activity, fire service spokesman Andreas Kettis said on Tuesday after a fire broke out the previous evening at an electronics store in Strovolos. Speaking to CyBC radio, he said there was “plenty of material to fuel the blaze.” The fire started at approximately 7pm on the ground floor of a three-storey building, causing a partial closure of the busy Strovolos Avenue for several hours. Kettis said fire service teams worked to extinguish the blaze while police assisted with traffic management and evacuated a nearby apartment building. “The ground floor and mezzanine were on fire. During the firefighting operation, we checked whether the basement was also affected. Inside the building there were electrical appliances and office equipment,” he said. The building includes a basement, ground floor, and mezzanine, with offices on the upper floors and the electronics store on the ground floor. Two additional fire engines were deployed to support the operation. All staff had safely exited the building. No injuries have been reported. Fire service and police are now investigating the cause of the fire.

标题: Rockford Fire : Apartment kitchen goes up in flames while man takes his dog for
正文: Rockford Fire: Apartment kitchen goes up in flames while man takes his dog for a walk ROCKFORD, Ill. (WIFR) - One man is displaced after a fire at his Rockford apartment. Around 3 p.m. Monday, firefighters were called to a two-story apartment building in the 100 block of N. Rockton Ave. for a fire. First responders report seeing heavy smoke and flames with zero visibility. Firefighters attacked the source of the fire, but they learned that it extended from the first floor walls and up to the second story, which was vacant. A second hose was used to extinguish the hidden fire in the walls. The Rockford Fire Department says a man was heating up oil in preparation to cook food, took his dog for a walk and forgot his stove was on. When he got back home, he says the kitchen of his first-floor apartment was engulfed in flames. He got out of the house and the neighbors called for help. A report from the fire department also notes smoke detectors were present and working in the building. No occupants or firefighters were injured from the fire, but the man and his dog are displaced and being helped by the Red Cross. Copyright 2026 WIFR. All rights reserved.

标题: Küchenbrand sorgt in Reutlingen für Feuerwehreinsatz - Reutlingen - Reutlinger G
正文: REUTLINGEN. Am frühen Sonntagmorgen ist die Feuerwehr zu einem Küchenbrand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in der Heilbronner Straße ausgerückt. Gegen 2:10 Uhr ging der Notruf bei der Integrierten Leitstelle für Feuerwehr und Rettungsdienst ein. Beim Eintreffen der Feuerwehr drang bereits Rauch aus der betroffenen Wohnung. Unter Atemschutz kämpften sich Einsatzkräfte in die verqualmten Räume vor und brachten die Flammen rasch unter Kontrolle und verhinderten so eine mögliche Ausbreitung des Feuers. Um auszuschließen, dass sich Rauch auch in angrenzende Wohnungen ausgebreitet hatte, kontrollierten weitere Einsatzkräfte das Gebäude. Eine Wohnungstür musste dabei mit Spezialwerkzeug geöffnet werden. Für die übrigen Bewohner bestand keine Gefahr. Die Feuerwehr belüftete die verrauchten Bereiche maschinell. Mit einer Wärmebildkamera wurde die Brandstelle sorgfältig auf mögliche Glutnester überprüft, dazu mussten Teile der Küche demontiert werden. Der Einsatz dauerte rund eine Stunde. Mit insgesamt fünf Fahrzeugen und 20 Einsatzkräften waren die Berufsfeuerwehr und die Abteilung Stadtmitte vor Ort. Polizei und Rettungsdienst unterstützten die Maßnahmen. (pm)

标题: Il fulmine , lalbero e la stalla in fumo
正文: Il fulmine, l'albero e la stalla in fumo Un incendio è divampato ieri sera a Cauco, in Val Calanca. L'edificio è andato completamente distrutto. Un incendio è divampato ieri sera a Cauco, in Val Calanca. L'edificio è andato completamente distrutto. CAUCO - Un fulmine, caduto ieri sera in zona Camana a Cauco in Val Calanca (GR), ha provocato un incendio che ha completamente distrutto una stalla. La saetta - per la precisione - è finita su un albero (vicino al rustico), incendiandolo. «Abbiamo ricevuto la segnalazione della presenza di fumo nero nella zona di Camana attorno alle 19.30,», precisa la polizia cantonale dei Grigioni. Vista la posizione isolata del luogo, i pompieri della Calanca hanno utilizzato un drone per capire cosa fosse accaduto. Le immagini hanno mostrato le fiamme che lambivano una stalla isolata e vuota. Un dettaglio, questo, che - unito alle (pessime) condizione meteo che non permettevano di effettuare voli di spegnimento - ha convinto il comando operativo di lasciare che la stalla bruciasse in modo controllato. Questa mattina, poi, un elicottero di Heli Rezia ha completato l'opera di spegnimento per conto dei pompieri.

标题: Brand in Prenzlau : Feuer in Mehrfamilienhaus , zwei Menschen verletzt
正文: Brand in Prenzlau: Feuer in Mehrfamilienhaus, zwei Menschen verletzt Im Flur eines Mehrfamilienhauses in Prenzlau hat es gebrannt. Dabei wurden zwei Personen verletzt. - Brand in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Prenzlau am Sonntagnachmittag (18. Januar). - Sperrmüll im Flur geriet in Brand, Rauch vernebelte das Gebäude. - Feuerwehr löschte schnell und lüftete das Haus. - Zwei Personen (14 und 54 Jahre) mit Verdacht auf Rauchgasvergiftung ins Krankenhaus gebracht. - Kriminalpolizei ermittelt zur Brandursache. Die Zusammenfassung wurde durch künstliche Intelligenz erstellt. War das hilfreich für Sie? Am Sonntagnachmittag (18. Januar) hat es in einem Wohnhaus in Prenzlau gebrannt. Feuerwehr und Polizei wurden in die Dr.-Wilhelm-Kültz-Straße gerufen. Im Flur eines Mehrfamilienhauses war Sperrmüll in Brand geraten. Rauch hatte den Flur vernebelt. Die Kameraden der Feuerwehr konnten den Brand rasch löschen und das Haus lüften. Zwei Bewohner wurden in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Bei dem 14-Jährigen und der 54 Jahre alten Frau bestand der Verdacht auf Rauchgasvergiftung. Die Kriminalpolizei hat die Ermittlungen zur Ursache des Feuers aufgenommen.

标题: Venezuelada petrol tesisinde dev patlama
正文: Venezuela'da petrol tesisinde dev patlama Venezuela'nın önemli enerji merkezlerinden biri olan Anzoátegui'deki bir ham petrol ve kimyasal işleme tesisinde büyük bir patlama meydana geldi. Reuters, Venezuela'da Petrocedeño'nun ana şirketi olan Petróleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) kaynaklarına dayandırdığı haberinde, Çarşamba günü Anzoátegui eyaletindeki Petrocedeño petrol işleme tesisinde bir patlama ve ardından yangın meydana geldiğini bildirdi. Patlama öğleden sonra meydana geldi ve etkilenen petrol iyileştirme tesisinin bir parçası olan bir damıtma kulesinin yakınında yoğunlaşan alevler ve duman bulutu oluştu. CNN Espanol'un haberine göre, olayın ardından kompleksteki çalışanların önlem olarak tahliye edildiğini belirtirken, olay yerindeki yerel medya, acil durum ekiplerinin yolda olduğunu bildirdi. Şimdiye kadar herhangi bir yaralanma bildirilmedi. İtfaiye ve teknisyenler yangını kontrol altına almaya ve olayın kaynağını belirlemeye çalışıyor. Etkilenen tesis, Venezuela'nın ana petrol üretim bölgesi olan Orinoco Petrol Kuşağı'nda bulunuyor ve ülkenin ağır ham petrolünü ihracata uygun petrollere dönüştürmede kilit rol oynuyor. Odatv.com

标题: Busy weekend for WFPS as crews tackle multiple fires across Winnipeg - CHVNRadio
正文: No one was injured following a fire Sunday afternoon in downtown Winnipeg. The fire broke out shortly after 7:30 a.m. in a commercial building in the 200 block of Garry Street. Smoke and flames were coming from the building when crews arrived. It took about two hours to get under control. No injuries were reported. Meanwhile, earlier Sunday morning, at around 1:45 a.m., the WFPS responded to reports of a garage fire in Elmwood. When they arrived, two garages were on fire, with heavy smoke and flames coming from both. There were also reports of a vehicle exploding in one of the garages. Both garages suffered extensive damage. However, no injuries were reported. The cause of all three fires remains under investigation. And late Saturday evening, firefighters were called to a high-rise building in downtown Winnipeg. Flames were pouring out of a suite on one of the floors, and due to the size of the building and the high risk, additional crews were called to the scene. Crews were able to quickly contain the fire, declaring it under control within half an hour. No one was injured. The cause of all three fires remains under investigation.

标题: Virginia Beach fire leaves 21 displaced , including 9 children
正文: Virginia Beach fire leaves 21 displaced, including 9 children VIRGINIA BEACH — After a multi-familiy structure fire on Malibu Palms Drive, eight apartments were affected, leaving 12 adults and nine children displaced, according to a news release from the Virginia Beach Fire Department. Friday at 9:03 p.m. VBFD went to the fire reported in the 3600 block of Malibu Palms Drive, which is off of Virginia Beach Boulevard. At the site, there was heavy black smoke and flames visible from the second floor of a two-story apartment building. At 9:16 p.m., the fire department requested additional resources. After using hose lines, there was water on the fire by 9:12 p.m., the fire was brought under control at 9:35 p.m. and it was declared out at 10:01 p.m. There were no injuries reported. Multiple pets were saved from several apartments, including four cats and one dog. Eight apartments were affected in total, four on the first floor and four on the second. This has left 12 adults and nine children displaced. The American Red Cross was contacted to assist with temporary housing. The origin and cause of the fire are still under investigation.

标题: Tragedia en Monterrey , gemelos de 4 a?os mueren en incendio de su vivienda – Pe
正文: Monterrey Por Milenio Publicado el jueves, 23 de octubre del 2025 a las 20:54 Monterrey, Nuevo León. – Dos gemelos de tan solo cuatro años de edad murieron este jueves a consecuencia de un incendio que consumió parte de su vivienda en la colonia Los Remates, al sur de Monterrey. La tragedia se registró alrededor de las 19:00 horas en una casa ubicada en la calle Privada Valle Azul. De acuerdo con el reporte de Protección Civil de Nuevo León, a pesar de la rápida llegada de los cuerpos de auxilio, poco se pudo hacer por los menores, quienes fallecieron debido al fuego y la inhalación de humo. Se informó que el incendio comenzó en la planta alta del domicilio. Los gemelos se encontraban en una habitación de cuatro por cuatro metros, que contenía plásticos y otros objetos que dificultaron su salida oportuna. 标题: Incendie dans un immeuble de 8 étages à Charleroi : des dizaines de personnes év
正文: Incendie dans un immeuble de 8 étages à Charleroi: des dizaines de personnes évacuées Le feu a pris au 3e étage d'une tour à appartements de la Sambrienne, la société de logements publics de Charleroi-Gerpinnes. - Publié le 14-02-2026 à 19h10 Ce samedi, un incendie s'est déclaré au 3e étage d'une tour comprenant 8 étages et plusieurs dizaines d'appartements, à Charleroi. Il s'agit d'un immeuble de la Sambrienne, la société de logements publics de la région. Vers 18 heures, les pompiers de Marcinelle et de Jumet sous les ordres du capitaine Gailly et du lieutenant Housse, ont été requis à la rue de Lodelinsart. Un dégagement de fumée était signalé. À l'arrivée des secours, venus avec trois échelles, une citerne et une ambulance, une bonne partie des occupants avaient déjà évacué. Le feu avait en fait pris au 3e étage. La cause est inconnue pour l'instant. Toujours est-il que les pompiers ont pu éteindre les flammes et placer un évacuateur de fumées. Le quartier a été totalement bouclé le temps de l'intervention, par plusieurs équipes de la police locale de Charleroi envoyées en renfort. Il semblerait que personne n'ait été blessé.

标题: Dog dies in Grand Island apartment fire
正文: Dog dies in Grand Island apartment fire GRAND ISLAND, Neb. (KSNB) — A dog died in a fire at an apartment building on West Koenig on Tuesday afternoon. Grand Island Fire responded to a structure fire around 2:30 p.m. at a building near Walnut and Koenig, just southeast of St. Mary’s Cathedral. Smoke detectors were going off, and someone in the building pulled the fire alarm. Battalion Chief Ryan Seaman said there were no people in danger and no one was injured, but firefighters found a dog that was unresponsive. Tower One arrived on scene and made entry to the basement, where crews found heavy black smoke. The fire was upgraded to a structure fire at 2:47 p.m. and was extinguished by 2:57 p.m. “Unfortunately, there was one dog in the residence at the time. Firefighters did perform resuscitation attempts, but they were unsuccessful,” Seaman said. Seaman reminded everyone to keep ovens, stoves and grills clean and to be mindful and prepared in case of smoke or fire. 标题: Wohnwagen brennt : Zwei Menschen verletzt , Haus unbewohnbar - Kirkel
正文: Kirkel Wohnwagen brennt: Zwei Menschen verletzt, Haus unbewohnbar Weil ein Wohnwagen in Kirkel-Neuhäusel brennt, werden zwei Menschen verletzt und ein Haus wird unbewohnbar. Wie ein Sprecher der Feuerwehr Kirkel am Dienstag mitteilt, seien die Einsatzkräfte am Montagnachmittag zu dem brennenden Wohnwagen im Fliederweg gerufen worden. Schon von weitem habe man eine Rauchwolke gesehen. Besonders gefährlich: Der Wohnwagen stand direkt vor einem Wohnhaus, die Flammen hatten bereits aufs Haus übergegriffen. Ein Trupp unter Atemschutz löschte die Flammen am Wohnwagen, ein weiterer kümmerte sich um die Flammen, die aufs Wohnhaus übergriffen, und schützte angrenzende Bereiche. Auch im Inneren des Wohnhauses überprüften Feuerwehrleute mit einer Wärmebildkamera die Räume auf mögliche Brandnester. Eine Person habe sich Brandverletzungen zugezogen, eine weitere habe über Herzbeschwerden geklagt. Beide wurden ins Krankenhaus gebracht. Das Haus bleibt laut Feuerwehr unbewohnbar, am Wohnwagen entstand Totalschaden. Auch zwei Fahrzeuge seien durch die Hitze der Flammen beschädigt worden. Die Feuerwehr war für rund vier Stunden im Einsatz.

标题: Ruuanlaittaja nukahti kesken paistelun – pelastuslaitosta tarvittiin Hyvinkn kes
正文: Uhkaava tilanne päättyi onnellisesti. Hyvinkään keskustan kerrostalossa rappukäytävään tulvinut käry toi Keski-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitoksen paikalle keskiviikkona puoli viiden aikaan iltapäivällä. Syyksi paljastui hellalle palanut ruoka, kun ruuanlaittaja oli nukahtanut kesken aterian valmistuksen. Käytävässä leijaillut käry ja palovaroittimen ääni sai naapurin soittamaan pelastuslaitokselle. – Se oli tällainen perinteinen nakit ja muusi -tapaus. Palovaroitin toimi juuri niin kuin palovaroittimen pitää toimiakin. Myös naapuri toimi oikein ja soitti hätänumeroon ja huoltoyhtiölle, päivystävä paloesimies kertoi. – Rakennuspalon vaara tilanteessa oli, sillä savu itsessään on riskitekijä. Pelastuslaitoksen tullessa paikalle palovaroittimen ääntä ei enää kuulunut. Paloesimiehen mukaan tällaisissa tapauksissa palokunta tarkistaa kaikki asunnot, jotta hälytyksen syy saadaan selville. Tarkastettujen huoneistojen oviin piirretään rastit, jotta kaikki tulee käytyä läpi. Näin löytyi nyt myös oikea asunto, jonka asukas oli pahoillaan tilanteesta. – Asunnossa oli näkyvästi savua ja tuuletimme sen koneellisesti, paloesimies kertoi.

标题: Tragischer Wohnungsbrand in Neunkirchen : 58 - J?hriger tot aufgefunden
正文: Ein 58-jähriger Mann ist bei einem Wohnungsbrand in Neunkirchen ums Leben gekommen. Die Brandursache ist noch unklar. Brand in NeunkirchenFeuerwehr findet toten 58-Jährigen in Dachgeschosswohnung Ein Brand in einem Wohngebäude in Neunkirchen, einer Gemeinde im Kreis Siegen-Wittgenstein, hat am frühen Morgen ein Menschenleben gefordert. Wie die Feuerwehr berichtete, wurde in der Wohnung unter dem Dach der Leichnam des 58-jährigen Mieters von den Rettungskräften aufgefunden. Fußgänger hatten zuvor eine Rauchentwicklung wahrgenommen, die aus einer Wohnung in dem Mehrfamilienhaus kam, und die Einsatzkräfte verständigt. Zwei andere Hausbewohner aus den unteren Stockwerken verließen das Gebäude eigenständig und blieben unversehrt. Auf den Brand waren sie durch die Signale von Rauchmeldern hingewiesen worden. Ermittlungen zur Brandursache laufen Die Kriminalpolizei nahm am Ort des Geschehens ihre Arbeit auf. Derzeit sind sowohl der exakte Grund für das Feuer als auch die Ursache für den Tod des 58-Jährigen ungeklärt. Die Nachforschungen sind noch nicht abgeschlossen. 标题: No one injured after fire breaks out at Beamsville home
正文: LATEST STORIES: No one injured after fire breaks out at Beamsville home The fire department at the Town of Lincoln says no one was reported hurt after a fire broke out at a home in the area of Village Park Drive and Crescent Avenue Wednesday afternoon. The Lincoln Fire Rescue deputy fire chief Bill Blake says firefighters were dispatched to a possible fire at around 4:20 p.m. He says a sizable amount of smoke and flames on the second floor became visible after a window broke due to the high heat. Blake says the fire appeared to be confined to a room on the second floor. Firefighters were able to keep the fire from spreading further, and quick actions kept it from reaching the attic. The deputy fire chief says the fire was brought under control within minutes of their arrival, and the scene was cleared by 7:30 p.m. They have not determined the cause of the fire, or have an estimate on the damages to the building. 标题: Monday night fire displaces Marshall residents | News , Sports , Jobs
正文: Monday night fire displaces Marshall residents MARSHALL — A Monday night fire displaced the residents of a Marshall apartment building. An American Red Cross spokesperson said Tuesday that a total of six people were affected by the fire. Marshall Fire Chief Quentin Brunsvold said no injuries were reported to people, but a dog in one of the apartments died. Brunsvold said the Marshall Fire Department received a call around 11:09 p.m. Monday for a fire in an apartment at 501 Village Drive. The occupant of the apartment had returned home to find the fire, he said. Brunsvold said there was a lot of thick black smoke in the apartment building, which prevented some residents from leaving by the stairs. A resident of the only occupied apartment on the building’s second floor escaped by jumping from a window, Brunsvold said. Brunsvold said the tenant was uninjured. Another resident of the building was assisted out by Marshall Police, he said. The Red Cross was contacted to assist residents of the apartment building. The fire is under investigation by the Minnesota State Fire Marshal’s Office, Brunsvold said.

标题: Bewohner bei Kellerbrand eingeschlossen – Schwerverletzte
正文: Bewohner bei Kellerbrand eingeschlossen – Schwerverletzte Mit rund 80 Einsatzkräften ist die Feuerwehr in Hamburg im Einsatz, um Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner aus einem brennenden Mehrparteienhaus zu retten. War es Brandstiftung? Bei einem Kellerbrand hat die Feuerwehr zwölf Menschen aus einem Mehrfamilienhaus in Hamburg-Niendorf gerettet. Das Treppenhaus war stark verraucht, sodass mehrere Personen in ihren Wohnungen eingeschlossen waren, wie die Feuerwehr mitteilte. Die Einsatzkräfte holten die Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner demnach aus dem Gebäude. Zwei von ihnen wurden schwer verletzt. Sie kamen mit einer Rauchgasvergiftung in ein Krankenhaus, sagte ein Polizeisprecher. Die anderen blieben unverletzt. Angaben der Polizei nach brannte im Keller Unrat. Laut Feuerwehr konnte das Feuer zügig gelöscht werden. Nachdem das Treppenhaus wieder rauchfrei war, konnten die Bewohner in ihre Wohnungen zurückkehren. Außerdem wurden in der Nähe zwei brennende Müllcontainer gelöscht. Die Brandursache war zunächst unklar. Die Polizei nahm die Ermittlungen auf und schließt den Angaben nach Brandstiftung nicht aus.

标题: Br?nde : Ein Mann stirbt bei Wohnungsbrand
正文: Brände 62-Jähriger stirbt bei Wohnungsbrand im Emsland In der Gemeinde Geeste an der Ems brennt am Morgen eine Wohnung in einem Mehrfamilienhaus aus. Ein Mann stirbt, sein Bruder erleidet eine Rauchgasvergiftung. Geeste - Bei einem Wohnungsbrand in Geeste im Landkreis Emsland ist ein 62-Jähriger ums Leben gekommen. Die Polizei wurde am Morgen um kurz nach acht Uhr über das Feuer im ersten Obergeschoss des Zweifamilienhauses benachrichtigt, wie ein Sprecher bestätigte. Ein 64-jähriger Mann, der auf das Feuer aufmerksam geworden war, rettete seine 86 Jahre alte Mutter aus dem Wohnhaus ins Freie. Sein zwei Jahre jüngerer Bruder, der ebenfalls dort lebte, konnte von den Einsatzkräften noch geborgen werden. Trotz sofort eingeleiteter Reanimationsmaßnahmen starb er noch am Brandort, wie es in einer Mitteilung hieß. Der 64-Jährige erlitt bei dem Versuch seinen Bruder zu retten eine Rauchgasvergiftung und wurde leicht verletzt. Die Mutter blieb den Angaben nach unverletzt. Die Wohnung im Obergeschoss ist durch den Brand derzeit nicht bewohnbar. Die Polizei nahm die Ermittlungen zur Brandursache auf.

标题: Br?nde : Mann stirbt bei Wohnungsbrand in Lippstadt
正文: Ein 58-Jähriger ist bei einem Wohnungsbrand in Lippstadt im Kreis Soest gestorben. Ein Zeuge habe am späten Montagabend Rauch aus einem Mehrfamilienhaus bemerkt, teilte die Polizei mit. Der 60-Jährige sei in das Gebäude gelaufen, um die Bewohner auf den Brand aufmerksam zu machen. Zudem habe er die Wohnungstür des 58-Jährigen eingetreten. Zwei weitere Männer seien leicht verletzt worden, der 60 Jahre alte Zeuge sowie ein 28 Jahre alter Bewohner des Hauses. Bei beiden bestehe der Verdacht einer Rauchgasvergiftung. 标题: Mom climbs down wall to rescue kids from burning home
命中: 身体搬运|身体受创|时间序列
正文: A woman in her 40s carried out a perilous rescue in South Jeolla Province on Monday, climbing down the exterior wall of an apartment building to reach her three young children trapped inside their burning home. The fire broke out at about 5:23 p.m. at a fifth-floor unit in Gwangyang, leaving three girls under the age of five stranded inside. Their mother could not enter through the front door because of heavy smoke and flames. She instead went to the unit directly above and climbed down the outer wall with her bare hands to reach her daughters. She stayed with the children and kept them safe until firefighters arrived. All four sustained minor smoke inhalation and were discharged from the hospital by Tuesday. The blaze was fully extinguished by 6:18 p.m. Fire authorities said scaling an apartment facade is extremely dangerous even for trained professionals, calling it highly unusual for a civilian to succeed in such an attempt. The family has been placed in temporary housing provided by the city, and Gwangyang officials are reviewing financial assistance for them. minsikyoon@heraldcorp.com

标题: Fire at under - construction building in City Light | Surat News
正文: Surat: A fire broke out at an under-construction residential building in the City Light area on Saturday, but no injuries were reported. The blaze erupted at the Roongta Estella apartment near Anu Vrat Dwar, sending thick plumes of smoke visible from several kilometres away into the sky. The fire reportedly started in bamboo scaffolding and other construction material, creating chaos among residents and passers-by. Videos showing massive clouds of smoke soon went viral on social media, raising concern across the city. On receiving the alert, teams from Surat Fire and Emergency Services rushed to the spot and launched firefighting operations. At least seven fire tenders from three fire stations were pressed into service. Officials said the blaze was brought under control within an hour. The exact cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained. "Construction material caught fire and it was controlled quickly by the fire team. The building is under construction and there was no one inside the apartments. Various materials stored at the site, including bamboo, caught fire," a fire official said.

标题: Apartment in Vienna High - Rise Building Fully Engulfed in Flames
命中: 热与温度|阳台窗口待援|医疗设备依赖
正文: Apartment in Vienna High-Rise Building Fully Engulfed in Flames In a high-rise building in Meidling on Lichtensterngasse, an apartment on the fifth floor was fully ablaze on Saturday evening. The fire department triggered alarm level 2 – upon the arrival of the emergency services, flames were bursting from the windows both on the street side and the rear of the building. Due to the open apartment door, the stairwell was heavily smoked. Because of the intense heat, presumably fueled by an oxygen tank in the apartment, three fire hoses had to be used. Major Operation for Apartment Fire in Vienna-Meidling According to fire department spokesman Christian Feiler, the fire was fought in a so-called “comprehensive” firefighting attack. One fire hose was advanced inside the building through the stairwell under respiratory protection, while the other two fire hoses were used via two turntable ladders to prevent the fire from spreading to other apartments or the facade. Four people were brought to safety. (APA/Red) This article has been automatically translated, read the original article here.

标题: Kuriose Brandeins?tze in Hamburg – zwei Verletzte
正文: Was macht ein Buch im Backofen? Zwei Verletzte bei kuriosen Brandeinsätzen in Hamburg Die Hamburger Feuerwehr ist am Samstagabend und in der Nacht zu Sonntag gleich zweimal zu kuriosen Bränden ausgerückt. Zunächst brannte in Barmbek eine Steckdose im Keller eines Wohnhauses. Etwas später geriet in Rissen ein Buch in einem Backofen in Brand. In beiden Fällen gab es jeweils einen Verletzten. Der erste Einsatz ereignete sich am Samstagabend gegen 20.40 Uhr an der Desenißstraße in Barmbek. Dort brannte aus bislang ungeklärter Ursache eine Aufputzsteckdose im Keller eines Wohnhauses. Verschmorendes Plastik sorgte für starke Verqualmung. Ein Bewohner wurde mit einer Rauchvergiftung in eine Klinik gebracht. Zwei Brände mit jeweils einem Verletzten in Hamburg In der Nacht zu Sonntag wurden die Retter dann gegen 1.35 Uhr zur Straße Nagelshof in Rissen gerufen. Dort war ein Feuer in einer Küche gemeldet worden. Als Ursache stellten die Feuerwehrleute ein brennendes Buch im Backofen fest. Die Bewohnerin kam mit einer Rauchvergiftung in ein Krankenhaus. In beiden Fällen ermittelt die Polizei.

标题: Steiermark : Feuerwehr barg 3 Menschen nach Brand von Balkon
正文: Steiermark: Feuerwehr barg 3 Menschen nach Brand von Balkon Überhitztes Fett auf einem Herd hat am Sonntag bei Graz zu einem Küchenbrand in einem Mehrparteienhaus geführt. Auf Balkon ausgeharrt Eine Bewohnerin hatte den Qualm bemerkt und mit ihrem Ehemann die anderen Bewohner gewarnt und ins Freie gebracht. Drei mussten wegen des Qualms im Stiegenhaus auf einem Balkon ausharren und wurden von der Feuerwehr über eine Leiter gerettet. Das Feuer wurde rasch gelöscht. Sieben Bewohner wurden mit Verdacht auf Rauchgasvergiftung ärztlich behandelt. Sieben Menschen wurden ins Spital gebracht Das Feuer war am Sonntag gegen Mittag in dem Mehrparteienhaus in Gratwein nördlich von Graz ausgebrochen. Die meisten Hausbewohner und auch jene eines angrenzenden Wohngebäudes konnten selbstständig ins Freie gelangen. Sieben Personen aus vier verschiedenen Wohnungen wurden von der Rettung vorsorglich zur Untersuchung ins LKH Graz gebracht. Die Feuerwehren Judendorf, Gratwein und Eisbach sowie die Betriebsfeuerwehr Sappi führten die Bergungs- und Löscharbeiten durch, teilte die Polizei am Montag mit.

标题: Fauske , Brann | Kraftig brann i bolig i Fauske – fare for spredning
正文: Brann i bolig i Fauske for andre gang på få dager En person er sendt til sykehus for sjekk etter en brann i Fauske, og brannvesenet lar bygget brenne ned. En mann er siktet etter en tidligere brann samme sted. Nordland politidistrikt meldte om brannen like etter klokka 22 fredag kveld. – Det pågår nå kontrollert nedbrenning av huset. En person er fraktet til sykehus for sjekk, skriver operasjonsleder Yngvar Fredriksen i politiloggen natt til lørdag. Det skal ikke være snakk om alvorlige skader. De andre som bor i bygningen, er gjort rede for og er OK, ifølge politiet. Det var en stund spredningsfare, og beboere i nærheten ble oppfordret til å lukke vinduer grunnet røyk. Politiet gjorde natt til lørdag undersøker på stedet. Det dreier seg om en flermannsbolig, og ifølge Avisa Nordland er åtte boliger tapt. En mann er siktet etter en brann i samme bygning natt til tirsdag denne uka. Ifølge NRK og Avisa Nordland dreier det seg om en mann som nylig fikk tilslag med et bud på en leilighet i bygningen, men tapte den på forkjøpsrett. Han ble onsdag varetektsfengslet i to uker. 标题: Mumbai high - rise fire : Tenants , shop owners allege massive safety violations
正文: MUMBAI: A fire broke out on Thursday morning at a high-rise commercial building on SV Road, Jogeshwari West, Mumbai, officials said.  The blaze started at around 10:50 am at JNS Business Center, near Gandhi School, Behrampada. The fire brigade initially declared it a Level-II fire call, which was later upgraded to Level-III.  The fire is reportedly confined to the 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th floors of the 13-storey glass facade building. Rescue operations are underway, with firemen using breathing apparatus (BA) to evacuate anyone trapped inside. No injuries have been reported so far. Just 100 kms From Mumbai Is A Village That Time Forgot | I Witness  The building houses approximately 120 shops. Shop owners and tenants allege multiple violations of construction and safety norms by the builder.  The three-storey parking area and basement have been rented out to commercial establishments, with the basement reportedly leased to Zepto for a storage hub.  Officials noted that the building lacks fire sprinklers and has inadequate space for small fire vehicles to access the premises.

标题: Three taken to hospital after fire in central Singapore
正文: Three taken to hospital after fire in central Singapore SINGAPORE, Aug. 22 (Xinhua) -- Three people were taken to hospitals after a fire broke out in a residential building in central Singapore early Friday morning. About 50 people in the affected block in Toa Payoh area were evacuated as a precaution, the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) said on social media. When officers arrived, they found the living room of a 12th-floor unit on fire. The SCDF conducted forcible entry into the unit and extinguished the fire with a water jet. The blaze was confined to the living room. One person rescued from the kitchen was assessed for smoke inhalation and minor burn injuries. Two others from neighboring units were also sent to hospitals, one for breathlessness and the other for an injured ankle. Preliminary investigations indicated that the fire involved a personal mobility aid in the living room, the SCDF said. The authority advised the public not to leave batteries or devices charging for prolonged periods or unattended overnight, and to avoid using non-original batteries.

标题: Phoenix fire investigators seek cause of blaze that displaced 11 people
正文: Phoenix fire investigators seek cause of blaze that displaced 11 people PHOENIX - Eleven people are without a home on Saturday morning after a fire ripped through their Phoenix apartment complex. What we know: Crews responded to the fire at the single-story building at around 12:50 a.m. on Feb. 14 near 11th and Roosevelt streets. "Crews arrived to find heavy smoke and flames coming from a window of one of the units. The assignment was upgraded to a first alarm due to the size of the building and number of resources needed. Firefighters quickly deployed handlines into the structure to fight the flames while simultaneously ensuring that all four units of the building were checked and any occupants were evacuated," said Phoenix Fire Capt. Kimberly Ragsdale. Firefighters were able to stop the fire from spreading to a nearby building. The Community Assistance Program came out to the scene to help the 11 residents who were displaced by the fire. No injuries were reported. What's next: The cause of the fire is under investigation. 标题: Cause of Salina apartment fire under investigation
正文: SALINE COUNTY —Authorities are investigating the cause of a fire at an apartment complex in Salina. A significant fire occured at the Ridge of Salina apartments on Wednesday afternoon, as the investigation is ongoing within first responders to determine the cause of fire. The fire occurred in the attic of one of the apartment building at Ridge of Salina apartments, 2363 Chapel Ridge Place, at around 3:00 p.m., according to Salina Fire Department Chief, Shane Pearson. The interior of the building had significant amounts of smoke and water damage. Supervisor of the apartments, Edwin Rodriguez said nobody was injured and everyone is safe. "We followed protocol and the maintenance guys did their job," he said. "Thank God nobody was hurt." Pearson also confirmed there were no reported injuries. A resident who lives across from the building that was on fire stated they were simply relaxing inside their room, when they looked out of their window and suddenly saw the fire. 标题: 刻不容缓 ！ 一场与时间赛跑的紧急救援 -- 中国警察网
命中: 嗅觉|声音|通道被锁|自行发现|官方指令|主体属性|时间序列|政策通稿
正文: 10月23日凌晨，按照安徽省马鞍山市公安局花山分局常态化夜间巡防部署，绿地警务站民警潘小虎与辅警张文龙沿朝霞路开展巡逻值守。行至某居民小区附近时，潘小虎凭借多年夜巡积累的敏锐洞察力，发现临街一栋高层住宅楼20多层处有异常火光闪烁。 因高层建筑遮挡，无法锁定起火楼层，二人当即分工：潘小虎前往小区，同步向上级详细汇报火情位置、现场火势等实时动态；张文龙紧随其后，在小区入口做好秩序维护与引导准备。 “不确定火源，就从20层开始逐层排查！”面对紧急态势，二人迅速敲定方案，沿楼梯从20层开始逐层向上排查。随着排查推进，空气中的焦糊味愈发浓烈。当二人排查至25层时，一股刺鼻浓烟从一户居民家门缝渗出，起火点找到了！ 潘小虎一边向指挥中心上报起火点准确地址，请求支援警力及消防力量紧急驰援，一边与张文龙轮番用力敲打起火住户房门。“屋里有人吗？着火了，快开门！”急促的呼叫声与敲门声在空旷的楼道内回荡，屋内却始终无人回应。 因房门为加固结构，二人尝试撬动、撞击均无法打开。情况愈发紧急，潘小虎继续在门外呼喊提醒，张文龙则迅速逐户敲门，引导25层及以上住户有序向楼下安全区域疏散。 随后，花山分局特巡警大队、霍里派出所警力接到指挥中心支援指令后迅速响应，火速抵达现场，共同疏导住户30余人，并同步引导消防救援车、120急救车顺利入场。很快，消防救援力量与120急救人员相继赶到。 消防救援人员使用破拆工具打开起火房门，浓烟与热浪瞬间涌出。消防救援人员迅速展开灭火救援，仅用10分钟便成功控制住火势，并救出被困在卧室内的谷先生一家四口，其中包括一名年仅1岁的幼儿。经120急救人员初步检查，4人虽吸入少量浓烟，但意识清醒，随后被紧急送往医院做进一步观察。 “当晚家中用电饭锅炖煮排骨后忘记关闭电源，全家睡着后未察觉异常，连门外的救援呼喊和敲门声都没听见。”事后，谷先生回忆事发经过时仍心有余悸。参与救援的消防救援人员表示，凌晨时段是居民熟睡、安全防范意识最薄弱的时期，若火情未被及时发现，待火势与浓烟大范围蔓延后，极可能造成无法挽回的后果。睡前要仔细检查相关电器、煤气灶是否关闭。 据悉，花山分局科学规划16条夜间警力必巡路线，在重点商圈、居民小区、交通要道设置12个必守点位，通过“定点值守+动态巡逻”的常态化模式，全力守护群众安全。 “花山分局通过夜间巡防工作筑牢辖区治安防线，全力守护群众生命财产安全。”花山分局副局长张阅表示。据统计，今年以来，该局通过夜间巡防累计及时发现并处置各类安全隐患146起，协助侦破案件149起，为群众办实事、解难题890余次。

标题: 25 человек эвакуировали при пожаре в многоэтажном доме в Ижевске
正文: Ночью 19 августа в многоэтажном доме по улице Драгунова в Ижевске произошел пожар. Об этом сообщили в пресс-службе МЧС Удмуртии. Возгорание началось в квартире на 8 этаже. После внезапного отключения света хозяин жилья начал обходить комнаты и заметил, что в одной из них загорелся телевизор. Мужчина попытался потушить пламя самостоятельно, но техника упала на пол, и огонь начал стремительно разрастаться. Вызванные на место пожарные помогли жильцам выбраться на свежий воздух. Всего из подъезда эвакуировали 25 человек, в том числе 4 ребенка. Одному из жильцов, 49-летнему мужчине, стало плохо после того, как он надышался едким дымом. Его увезли в больницу. 标题: New York flats in flames as 200 firefighters rush to scene
正文: New York flats in flames as 200 firefighters rush to scene More than 200 firefighters and emergency crews were scrambled to the scene as thick smoke poured from the building and flames lit up the night sky Firefighters battled a huge blaze in the early hours of Saturday after flames tore through the top two floors of a high-rise apartment building in New York City. The four-alarm fire broke out shortly after midnight in the Bronx, rapidly spreading to several flats inside the 17-storey block, according to the New York City Fire Department. More than 200 firefighters and emergency crews were scrambled to the scene as thick smoke poured from the building and flames lit up the night sky. Shocking footage shared on social media shows fire engulfing parts of the upper floors, with huge plumes of smoke rising above the tower. The cause of the fire is not yet known and officials said it was too early to confirm whether anyone had been injured. Emergency services remained at the scene as crews worked to bring the blaze under control and make the building safe.

标题: Man in critical condition after fire in Bronx apartment building
正文: A man is in critical condition after a fire engulfed his apartment on the top floor of a Bronx apartment building, FDNY officials said Friday. Firefighters started receiving calls about excessive smoke rising from the six-story building on Bronx Park East and Thwaites Pl. in Pelham Parkway around 1 p.m. and arrived at the scene about five minutes later, according to officials. They found a man believed to be roughly in his 50s unconscious and unresponsive in an apartment on the top floor, in which the blaze originated, Deputy Chief James Sangiamo said. First responders rushed the victim to Jacobi Hospital, where he is currently in critical condition, officials said. The smoke eaters were able to “aggressively extinguish the fire and confined it to one apartment,” bringing it under control in about an hour, Sangiamo said. Another civilian suffered minor smoke inhalation but refused medical attention. A firefighter also sustained a minor injury and was transported to Jacobi Hospital, according to FDNY officials. The fire’s cause is under investigation.

标题: Nordrhein - Westfalen : Brand in Hochhaus - 20 Personen in Klinik gebracht
正文: Nordrhein-WestfalenBrand in Hochhaus - 20 Personen in Klinik gebracht Dichter Rauch, Rettung per Drehleiter – und ein Haus mit sieben Stockwerken ist vorerst unbewohnbar. In Meckenheim südlich von Bonn hat ein Feuer die Einsatzkräfte beschäftigt. Meckenheim (dpa/lnw) - Nach einem Brand in einem mehrstöckigen Haus in Meckenheim südlich von Bonn sind 20 Personen in ein Krankenhaus gebracht worden. Grund war der Verdacht auf Rauchgasvergiftungen, wie ein Sprecher mitteilte. Die Maßnahme diene der weiteren Abklärung. Der Brand war nach Einschätzung der Einsatzkräfte am Montagabend im Keller des Mehrfamilienhauses ausgebrochen. Dort habe unter anderem Kleidung gebrannt. Das Feuer führte zu einer starken Rauchentwicklung. Das Haus hat den Angaben zufolge sieben Stockwerke. Die Feuerwehr brachte den Brand schließlich unter Kontrolle. Einige Bewohner wurden dabei auch mit einer Drehleiter gerettet. Nach Angaben der Feuerwehr ist das Gebäude, in dem 75 Personen gemeldet sind, vorerst nicht bewohnbar. Es müsse nun zunächst von Spezialfirmen gereinigt werden.

标题: Hei?e Asche setzt Wohnhaus in Schierling in Brand
正文: Ein vermeintlich harmloser Fehler führt in Schierling zu einem verheerenden Feuer. Ein Wohnhaus brennt und ein Großaufgebot der Feuerwehr muss anrücken. Ein Feuer hat ein Wohnhaus in Schierling (Landkreis Regensburg) massiv beschädigt. Ausgelöst wurde das Feuer möglicherweise durch eine Unachtsamkeit: Wie die Polizei mitteilte, war der Brand nach bisherigen Erkenntnissen durch falsch gelagerte heiße Asche entstanden. Zunächst habe sich ein Freisitz entzündet, der rasch in Vollbrand geraten sei. Von dort griffen die Flammen auf die Fassade und den Dachstuhl des angrenzenden Wohnhauses über. Durch das Feuer und den starken Rauch wurden das Erdgeschoss und das Obergeschoss schwer in Mitleidenschaft gezogen. Das Anwesen sei infolge der Schäden vorerst nicht mehr bewohnbar, hieß es von der Polizei. Die Bewohner konnten sich in Sicherheit bringen. Da die Betroffenen nicht in ihr Haus zurückkehren konnten, stellte die Gemeinde eine Notunterkunft zur Verfügung. 标题: Massive fire at Mumbai JMS Business Centre
正文: Mumbai: A fire broke out in a 13-storey commercial building in Mumbai’s western suburb of Jogeshwari on Thursday morning, filling the high-rise with thick black smoke, officials said. There has been no report of any injury to anyone in the blaze that broke out at JNS Business Center near Gandhi School around 10.50 am, they said. Citing preliminary inputs, a civic official said that 10-15 persons were stranded in another wing of the building. “They are safe,” he said. The fire is confined to the 9th to 12th floors of the glass-facade building. Flames were rising along the glass panels, while thick black smoke billowed, he said. “The operation to rescue the stranded persons is being carried out by firemen equipped with breathing apparatus (BA) sets,” the official said. A fire brigade official said that at least 12 fire engines and other firefighting equipment are being used to control the blaze. Various agencies have been mobilised at the scene, he said. The authorities are yet to share more details about the fire, including what triggered it.

标题: Horror fire in Spain leaves at least five dead and others injured
正文: Horror fire in Spain leaves at least five dead and others injured For reasons not yet known, the victims could not escape the attic storage room, authorities said Five people have reportedly died after a fire broke out at an apartment block in Spain. And five others suffered light injuries in northeastern Spain in a fire that broke out in an apartment building, regional emergency services said. 标题: Victim , possible causes of deadly fire in northern Maine identified
正文: Victim of deadly fire in northern Maine identified, possible causes pinpointed Investigators have released the name of the woman who died in an apartment building fire in Fort Kent on Monday. On Thursday, the Maine Fire Marshal's Office said the victim has been tentatively identified as Ruth Charles, 56, who lived in the building. The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner will make the final identification. Firefighters were called to an apartment building on East Main Street just after noon on Monday and found fire on the first floor. After the fire was put out, firefighters say they learned that there was likely someone inside. Firefighters found Charles and tried to resuscitate her, but were not able to save her. State Fire Marshal's Office investigators determined the fire started in the bedroom of the apartment where Charles lived alone. The fire has been ruled accidental, but investigators say they cannot rule out either a candle or an electrical issue as the actual cause. Two other tenants of the building were displaced temporarily.

标题: Blackfen Road Sidcup building fire was  accidental
正文: A fire which broke out at a building under renovation in Sidcup was "accidental". Twelve fire engines and around 80 firefighters tackled the fire in Blackfen Road just after 1pm yesterday (July 22). The ground and first floor, the roof of a shop with flats above, along with part of the roof of an adjacent building were alight. The property's first floor collapsed. There were no reports of any injuries. Station Commander Steve Howlett, who was at the scene, said: "This was a very visible fire which produced a significant amount of smoke in the area. "We advised people who live and work in the vicinity to keep windows and doors closed. "One of our 32-metre turntable ladders was used as a water tower at the incident, to help tackle flames from height. "Blackfen Road was closed and some bus routes were affected. "We asked people to avoid the area while we worked to make the scene safe." The blaze was under control just before 4.40pm. The fire is believed to have been accidental and caused by hot works, according to the London Fire Brigade.

标题: Improper disposal of smoking material causes apartment fire in Fairhaven neighbo
正文: (Updated 10:50 a.m. July 19, 2025) Numerous 911 calls flooded the Saskatoon Fire Department Communications Cente around 3:30 Tuesday morning reporting an apartment building on fire in the 400 block of Fairmont Drive. Firefighters could see heavy smoke and flames coming from a second-floor suite in the three storey apartment complex when they arrived which was within five minutes of getting the call. Another fire engine was requested a few minutes later because the blaze was moving towards the roof and attic space. All occupants safely evacuated, and the fire was completely extinguished by 4:39 a.m. Two suites sustained fire damage and four people were relocated and rehoused by the property owner. Fire officials estimate $200,000 in damage and an investigator has determined the fire originated on a balcony and the cause of the fire was improper disposal of smoking material. The fire department reports that the fire alarm system is being serviced, and some smoke alarms replaced. All other occupants are able to return to their suites.

标题: Caldwell home near Canyon Hill destroyed after garage fire spreads
正文: CALDWELL — Just north of the city’s water tower, a family’s residence is destroyed after a garage fire spread throughout the back of their home resulting in the loss of their house. The Caldwell Fire Department responded to reports of a fire at a home on the corner of North Plateau Avenue and Roosevelt Street at approximately 5 p.m. on Monday. Black smoke from the fire site could be seen driving westbound on Interstate 84. According to a city of Caldwell press release, a child was inside the home at the time of the fire but was able to safely evacuate and call 911. The family owned a variety of pets including two dogs, two birds and a bearded dragon that did not survive the fire, the press release stated. As a result, two pet cages can be seen outside the burnt home with plywood boarding up the windows. The displaced family was assisted by the fire department in securing a temporary shelter. Although the incident still remains under investigation by the fire department, it appears to have been accidental, Caldwell’s release said.

正文: Wohnungsbrand in Neukölln: Feuerwehr rettet drei Menschen aus brennendem Haus Im vierten Stock eines Wohnhauses in der Böhmischen Straße bricht am Dienstagabend ein Feuer aus. Rauchmelder schlugen Alarm, woraufhin 60 Feuerwehrkräfte ausrückten. Eine Person konnte sich mit leichten Verletzungen aus der Wohnung retten, zwei weitere wurden von der Feuerwehr ins Freie gebracht – im einen Fall mit schweren, im anderen mit leichten Verletzungen. Die Feuerwehr konnte bei ihrem einstündigen Einsatz verhindern, dass sich die Flammen weiter ausbreiteten. Nähere Angaben zur Brandursache und den Verletzten lagen zunächst nicht vor. 标题: Explosion kills 1 at high - rise building in the Bronx , New York
正文: ALBAWABA - A gas explosion killed one person and injured 14 others in in New York City early on Saturday, American authorities announced. The explosion happened at a high-rise apartment building in the Bronx, causing a big fire that spread through the top floors. Firefighters were called shortly before 12.30 a.m. to the 17-story New York City housing authority (Nycha) building in the Bronx, due to the fire. The Guardian cited officials who said people rushed to windows screaming for help as flames engulfed parts of the top floors. The New York fire department chief, John Esposito, revealed that authorities confirmed that a gas odor was reported on the 15th and 16th floors when the explosion happened. He also confirmed that theblast caused serious damage to a dozen apartments and fires in 10 apartments on the 16th and 17th floors. "It's an incredible tragedy. We’re sending all our thoughts to the families involved," New York City’s deputy mayor for housing and planning, Leila Bozorg, revealed during a morning news conference.

标题: Incendio en apartamento de residencial fue por un cigarrillo , según Vivienda Pú
正文: El incendio que se registró a las 8:40 de esta mañana en un apartamento del residencial Manuel A. Pérez en San Juan habría sido provocado por un cigarillo en una de las habitaciones, informó Juan Rosario Hernández, administrador de Vivienda Pública. Según el funcionario, el incendio en el apartamento 194 del edificio J14 fue provocado "por un cigarrillo que estaba utilizando un familiar". En el apartamento estaban registradas tres personas, dos adultos mayores y su hijo, quien era el que estaba en el apartamento al momento del fuego. El incendio que pudo ser controlado rápidamente, fue en solo una de las habitaciones. Rosario Hernández informó que ya identificaron una vivienda en el mismo residencial para relocalizar a la familia. Personal de bomberos de San José y San Juan, así como la Policía Municipal y Oficina Municipal de Manejo de Emergencias (OMME) atendieron la emergencia. 标题: Brand in Floridsdorf – Gro?einsatz ! Flammeninferno in Wiener Wohnhaus
正文: Dramatische Szenen in Wien-Floridsdorf! Mittwochfrüh knapp vor 7.00 Uhr wurde der Notruf abgesetzt: Gleich zwei Balkone eines Wohnhauses in der Herzmanovsky-Orlando-Gasse standen in Flammen. Als der Löschtrupp eintraf, standen die betroffenen Balkone bereits im Vollbrand. Die Flammen verursachten massive Schäden und ließen die Loggien verkohlt zurück. Ein "Heute"-Leser filmte die dunklen Rauchwolken und das lodernde Feuer. Die Berufsrettung Wien musste mit der Sondereinsatzgruppe ausrücken – ganze 16 Personen benötigten in der Krisensituation Betreuung. Glücklicherweise erlitt niemand der Bewohner schwere Verletzungen und somit konnten die Betroffenen wieder in häusliche Pflege entlassen werden. Wie die Pressestelle der Wiener Berufsfeuerwehr bestätigte, waren 30 Einsatzkräfte und sieben Einsatzfahrzeuge notwendig um die Flammen zu bekämpfen. Nach rund zwei Stunden konnte der Brand unter Atemschutz erfolgreich bekämpft werden. Was genau das Feuer ausgelöst hatte, ist derzeit noch unklar und Gegenstand von Ermittlungen.

标题: Quezon City condo fire forces evacuation , no casualties reported
正文: MANILA, Philippines — Residents of a condominium building in Quezon City were forced to evacuate Thursday morning after a fire broke out in Eastwood, Barangay Bagumbayan. Initial reports from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) indicated that the incident was first reported as a rubbish fire before it escalated and was raised to first alarm at 6:53 a.m. Thick smoke billowed from the Olympic Tower 3 building, prompting the evacuation of residents as firefighters rushed to contain the blaze. Videos and photos shared online showed occupants leaving the condominium while emergency responders carried out firefighting operations. Firefighters remained at the scene Thursday morning to extinguish the fire and prevent it from spreading to other parts of the building. No casualties or injuries were immediately reported. Authorities have yet to determine the extent of the damage. The BFP said an investigation was underway to determine the cause and assess the losses incurred. No other details are available as of posting time.

标题: Cucina difettosa , fiamme in appartamento : tragedia sfiorata a Torre del Greco
正文: La cucina difettosa prende fuoco, bruciando mobili ed altre suppellettili: il provvidenziale intervento di un cittadino, che si introduce nell'appartamento e rimuove una bombola di gas, evita conseguenze molto peggiori.  È quanto accaduto questa mattina a Torre del Greco, nella zona di via Scappi, nella parte alta della città, dove si è sfiorata la tragedia. Erano circa le 10 quando le urla provenienti da una palazzina hanno richiamato l'attenzione dei passanti: «La mia cucina sta bruciando». Afragola, raid nella scuola "Aldo Moro": identificato il secondo ladro Quando le fiamme hanno preso il sopravvento, gli occupanti dell'appartamento sono scappati in strada. «C'è una bombola del gas» ha urlato qualcuno. A questo punto un uomo ha deciso di introdursi nell'abitazione per recuperare la bombola e portarla all'esterno, tutto poco prima che arrivassero sul posto i vigili del fuoco, ai quali è toccato il compito di domare il rogo.  I danni sono in fase di quantificazione ma per fortuna non si registrano feriti.

标题: 5 - alarm fire in Longwood , Bronx rips through 3 businesses and apartment build
正文: LONGWOOD, The Bronx (WABC) -- A five-alarm fire burned through a row of stores and an apartment building in the Longwood section of the Bronx. Fire broke out in the Prospect Avenue businesses just before 10:30 p.m. Thursday night. Flames burned through a bodega, a fruit shop and a dollar store. Fire also jumped to the roof and second floor of an adjacent six-story apartment building, but it was quickly extinguished. That apartment building was evacuated, one resident was treated at the scene. 标题: Berlin & Brandenburg : 14 - j?hriger Intensivt?ter l?sst Balkon in Flammen aufge
正文: Berlin & Brandenburg14-jähriger Intensivtäter lässt Balkon in Flammen aufgehen Ein Sprengkörper, ein lauter Knall – plötzlich brennt ein Balkon in Gropiusstadt. Fast greift das Feuer über. Ein 14-Jähriger und seine Mutter werden verletzt. Berlin (dpa/bb) - Ein 14-jähriger polizeibekannter Jugendlicher hat in Berlin-Gropiusstadt einen Balkon angezündet und zwei Menschen in Gefahr gebracht. Der Jugendliche warf am Mittwochmorgen laut Zeugen einen Sprengkörper auf den Balkon eines Mehrfamilienhauses, wie die Polizei mitteilte. Kurz darauf gab es einen Knall und der Balkon stand in Flammen. Eine 53-jährige Mutter und ihr 14-jähriger Sohn, die sich in der Wohnung befanden, erlitten Rauchvergiftungen. Sie wurden ins Krankenhaus gebracht. Die Feuerwehr konnte ein Übergreifen der Flammen auf das Haus verhindern und den Brand löschen. Die Polizei nahm den 14-Jährigen in der Nähe fest. 标题: Buknuo po?ar u stanu u zagreba?kom kvartu : Stanari krenuli sami gasit vatru , s
正文: U zagrebačkom naselju Vrbani u nedjelju ujutro buknuo je požar u stanu na nižem katu stambene zgrade u Horvaćanskoj cesti, a na teren su odmah upućena tri vatrogasna vozila. 标题: Tucsonans reminded to safely handle lithium - ion batteries after electric scoot
正文: TUCSON, Ariz. (KVOA) - The Tucson Fire Department is reminding residents to handle lithium-ion batteries safely after an electric scooter caught on fire inside of a two-story apartment building on Wednesday morning. On March 18 at 8:07 a.m., TFD crews responded to a commercial fire report in the 700 block of West Thurber Road, near Fairview Avenue and Prince Road. The Engine 8 crew arrived four minutes later, reporting smoke coming from the apartment building. Investigators determined that lithium-ion batteries in an electric scooter ignited as it was being charged, causing flames to spread to several beanbags nearby. TFD said the residents were asleep when the fire started, but escaped through a bedroom window safely. The two residents declined medical transport after they were evaluated for smoke inhalation, and they have been displaced. The fire was under control at 8:48 p.m. Tucson Fire advises the community to carefully handle lithium-ion batteries and follow recommended charging practices.

标题: Handheld Fan Sparks Fire in 10 - Story Tokyo Building
正文: TOKYO - A fire broke out in a 10-story apartment building in Higashi-Shinagawa, Tokyo, on the morning of July 24th, leaving six people with minor injuries. Authorities believe the blaze was triggered by a handheld fan that was charging at the time. Footage from the scene showed white smoke billowing from one of the upper floors, with firefighters using ladder trucks to respond. The fire started around 8:30 a.m. in a unit on the ninth floor of the building. A total of 51 emergency vehicles were dispatched, and the flames were extinguished about an hour and a half later. Approximately 20 square meters were burned. According to the Metropolitan Police Department and other sources, six people—including the man living in the apartment where the fire started, a woman living in the unit above, and several firefighters—sustained minor injuries. Authorities are investigating the cause of the fire, which is believed to have originated from a handheld fan left charging in the room. Source: TBS

标题: Firefighters protect homes from outside fire
正文: Firefighters kept an outside fire from spreading to adjacent structures Saturday night. Deputy Chief James P. Campbell of Wilson Fire/Rescue Services said firefighters were dispatched to an outside fire at 1901 Oakdale Drive at 8:47 p.m. “Fire crews arrived on the scene of a single-story 2,040-square-foot residential building to find a wooden fence on fire between the adjacent properties,” Campbell said. “The fire had begun to spread across the grass, threatening both properties. Both properties sustained heat damage to the exterior. The fire was quickly controlled and prevented from entering the buildings.” Campbell said the cause of the fire was accidental. He estimated the damage to property at $6,000 to property and no loss of contents. Six firefighting vehicles and 19 firefighters responded. Firefighters were assisted on scene by Wilson Police Department, Wilson Utilities, and Wilson County Emergency Communications Center. There were no firefighter or civilian injuries.

标题: Fire inside walls of Roswell apartment building displaces 17 residents
正文: ROSWELL, GA — A fire that spread through the walls of a Roswell apartment building left several units damaged and displaced 17 residents. Roswell Fire and Rescue says crews arrived at the complex on Ashley Forest Drive, off Nesbitt Ferry Road, to find only light smoke coming from the building. Firefighters quickly discovered hidden flames moving through wall spaces between apartment units and worked through the night to open the walls and stop the fire from spreading. Several apartments sustained significant fire, smoke, and water damage. No one was critically hurt, though one firefighter from a neighboring agency suffered a minor injury. A cat was also safely rescued and returned to its owner. The Red Cross is now assisting 17 displaced residents. Roswell Fire officials say the incident serves as an important reminder to check smoke detectors and have an emergency action plan, especially heading into the holiday season. WSB Radio’s Veronica Waters contributed to this story.

标题: Unattended cooking  causes kitchen fire in Syracuse apartment
正文: 'Unattended cooking' causes kitchen fire in Syracuse apartment SYRACUSE, N.Y. — The Syracuse Fire Department responded to a kitchen fire in a multi-story senior living apartment building on Crouse Avenue on the evening of Jan. 15. The fire department said crews were dispatched to the fire at 501 S. Crouse Ave. around 6:36 p.m. Crews encountered a large amount of smoke coming from the building's fifth floor. Inside, crews found a small fire in a fifth-floor apartment. The department noted that the fire was put out quickly. Crews also searched the building for additional fires and for people who may have been overcome by smoke. One resident who left the building by the time crews arrived was evaluated by EMS. High-powered fans were used to ventilate affected areas. The apartment that caught fire sustained minor smoke and water damage. The fire was caused by unattended cooking, the department said. There were no injuries reported to firefighters and no one was displaced.

正文: A vacant house was damaged by a fire that emitted a tower of smoke visible to motorists traveling on Interstate 78 near Shartlesville, officials said. Crews from northern Berks and southern Schuylkill County responded to the fire in the 400 block of Bloody Spring Road in Upper Tulpehocken Township after it was discovered shortly before 5 p.m. Wednesday. Numerous 911 callers reported the fire, said Trooper Corey Heimbach, a state police fire marshal. The first crews found part of the rancher home on engulfed by flames, according to reports. Heimbach said crews isolated the flames to a single room and damage was limited to two rooms, but there was smoke and water damage throughout the building. No one was injured. The cause hasn’t been determined. Heimbach planned to investigate further. Crews opened up parts of the building and used fans to ventilate the structure. The fire was reported knocked down about 5:53 p.m., with crews dealing with a few remaining hot spots.

标题: Westwood High - Rise Fire Quickly Doused
正文: A small fire on the 15th floor of a 23-story high-rise in Westwood prompted residents to shelter in place, but no injuries were reported. Firefighters responded at about 1:50 p.m. Monday to the building in the 10500 block of West Wilshire Boulevard after receiving reports of a fire that activated a smoke alarm, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department. Fire crews climbed the stairwell to the 15th floor and found a small “contents fire” that was quickly doused. Residents who sheltered in place were evaluated, but there were no immediate reports of injuries, LAFD spokeswoman Lyndsey Lantz said, adding that three people were assessed at the scene and declined further medical treatment. Lantz said three units on the 15th floor suffered significant smoke damage and were being assessed for habitability, while other residents were able to return to their units. Traffic was impacted in the area, with Wilshire Boulevard closed between Warner Avenue and Manning.

标题: R?ykutvikling i boligblokk - én beboer f?r helsehjelp
正文: Røykutvikling i boligblokk – én beboer fikk helsehjelp – Vi måtte rive noen fasadeplater for å komme til. 标题: Baden - Württemberg : Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus – Sieben Verletzte in Furtwangen
正文: Baden-WürttembergBrand in Mehrfamilienhaus – Acht Verletzte in Furtwangen Wegen eines Feuers in Furtwangen muss die Innenstadt kurzzeitig gesperrt werden. Unter den Verletzten sind Bewohner und Helfer – einer von ihnen erlitt schwere Verletzungen. Furtwangen (dpa/lsw) - Acht Menschen sind beim Brand eines Mehrfamilienhauses in Furtwangen (Schwarzwald-Baar-Kreis) verletzt worden - davon einer schwer. Rettungswagen brachten sie in Krankenhäuser. 标题: Baden - Württemberg : Brand im Keller – Mutter und Kind von Balkon gerettet
正文: Baden-WürttembergBrand im Keller – Mutter und Kind von Balkon gerettet Der Rauch breitet sich schnell im ganzen Gebäude aus. Nicht alle Bewohner schaffen es eigenständig nach draußen. Freiburg im Breisgau (dpa/lsw) - Die Feuerwehr hat eine Mutter und ihr Kleinkind vom Balkon eines Wohnhauses gerettet. Am Vormittag war in der Sauna im Keller der Doppelhaushälfte in Freiburg im Breisgau ein Feuer ausgebrochen. Das Treppenhaus und die Wohnungen in dem Gebäude waren nach Angaben der Feuerwehr stark verraucht. Die sechs weiteren Bewohner hätten das Gebäude noch eigenständig verlassen, sagte der Einsatzleiter der Feuerwehr. Sie seien vom Notarzt betreut worden. Das Kleinkind sei vorsorglich ins Krankenhaus gebracht worden. Laut Feuerwehr wurde das Haus nach den Löscharbeiten belüftet und die Sauna teilweise ausgeräumt. Das Gebäude ist demnach aber nicht mehr bewohnbar. Die Polizei ermittelt zum Schaden und der Brandursache.

标题: 65 - year - old woman found dead after bungalow fire in Hyde Park
正文: HYDE PARK, LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Rescuers found a woman dead in Hyde Park on Sunday after a fire inside a unit in a row of bungalows. The Los Angeles Fire Department responded to the fire in the 6300 block of South Brynhurst Avenue just after 4:30 p.m. Dozens of firefighters were able to knock down the flames and prevent the fire from spreading to adjoining units in less than half an hour. They found the body inside the burning unit. Authorities did not immediately name the 65-year-old woman who died. Investigators noted that the building had functioning smoke alarms. Arson investigators are now looking into how the fire started. "I opened my front door and I saw a big ball of black smoke coming from the apartment building across the street," said witness Rita Rogers. "And I saw a lady coming out screaming, saying that there was an old lady inside the apartment that was on fire. They were so engulfed with black smoke." No other injuries were reported.

标题: Montreal - North fire : 2 kids injured
正文: A nine-year-old boy, one of two children hospitalized with serious burns following a fire at a residential building in the borough of Montreal North, remains in critical condition, a Montreal police spokesperson confirmed Saturday. 标题: Flames tear through roof of 3 - story vacant apartment building in Koreatown
正文: Flames tear through roof of 3-story vacant apartment building in Koreatown Firefighters battled a large blaze at a vacant apartment building in Koreatown on Wednesday evening. Crews said heavy fire extended into the attic of the building. AIR7 video showed fire crews battling the blaze as flames tore through the roof, with a large plume of smoke rising into the air above the neighborhood. It appeared smoke was coming out of all four sides of the building. Shortly before 6 p.m., LAFD said the blaze had been knocked down in about 34 minutes with the help of 80 firefighters. AIR7 video showed smoke still rising, but the plume was much smaller. Authorities said all searches were clear and no injuries were reproted. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

标题: Two rescued from burning apartment building in Woodbridge
正文: Firefighters rescued two residents from the second floor of a burning apartment building in Woodbridge early Monday morning. Crews were dispatched at 1:11 a.m. to the Potomac Ridge Apartments in the 2800 block of Woodmark Drive and arrived to find smoke showing with residents still in the building, fire officials said. Two adult occupants were rescued from the second floor using ground ladders, Prince William County fire and rescue Assistant Chief Matt Smolsky said in a news release. The fire was then quickly brought under control. One adult resident suffered non-life-threatening injuries and was taken to an area hospital. No other injuries were reported. A county building official deemed two apartments unsafe to occupy, displacing three adults and one child, Smolsky said. The Red Cross is assisting. The Prince William County Fire Marshal’s Office determined improper disposal of smoking materials ignited the blaze, Smolsky said.

标题: Cause of Kansas City apartment fire under investigation
正文: KANSAS CITY—Authorities are investigating the cause of a fire at an apartment building in Kansas City, Missouri. Just after 5a.m. Friday, Kansas City Fire Department crews were dispatched to a reported apartment fire in the 2200 block of East 8th Street, according to Battalion Chief Riley Nolan. On arrival, crews reported smoke and fire showing from a 3-story apartment building, as well as fire showing from a second apartment building across the parking lot. Crews initiated an offensive fire attack on both fires, advancing multiple hose lines into the structures to extinguish the fires. The fire has been placed under control, and companies are in the process of picking up and returning to service. Occupant searches were performed throughout all units within the structures, coming back all clear. No injuries have been reported from this incident City Planning and Dangerous Buildings were requested to the scene.

标题: Early morning garage fire leaves family without home
正文: Early morning garage fire leaves family without home SAN ANTONIO - A vehicle fire early Tuesday morning at a home on the Northeast Side led to the evacuation of all four units in a small apartment building, leaving one family temporarily displaced. The fire started just before 2:30 a.m. Tuesday at a four-plex off Arancione Avenue near Lookout Road. Firefighters arrived to find flames coming from both the car and the attached garage. Crews quickly brought the fire under control, preventing further damage. Fortunately, no injuries were reported. While three of the four families were able to return to their homes, one family has been displaced and is receiving support from the American Red Cross. Investigators say the fire may have been linked to recent work done on the vehicle just a few days ago, though the investigation is ongoing. T he fire caused moderate damage to the garage and the car.

标题: One hospitalized after fire in a 3 - story KC apartment building
正文: KANSAS CITY—Authorities are investigating the cause of an apartment fire in Kansas City. Just before 2:30a.m. Wednesday, Kansas City Fire companies were dispatched to a reported apartment fire in the 3400 block of Holmes Road, according to Battalion Chief Riley Nolan. The first arriving company reported nothing showing from the exterior of a 3-story apartment building and entered to investigate. Smoke was encountered on the 3rd floor and crews forced entry into a unit where they found the source and extinguished a small fire on the kitchen stovetop. An occupant of the unit was located and brought out by firefighters to a waiting ambulance. They were then transported to a nearby hospital for smoke inhalation. A second ambulance was ordered to the scene to evaluate an additional occupant of the building, but that person was not transported. Authorities released no additional details.

标题: Vier Menschen retten sich aus brennender Wohnung - Speyer
正文: Speyer Vier Menschen retten sich aus brennender Wohnung Ein Brand in einer Küche hat am Sonntag gegen 18.30 Uhr in Speyer einen Großeinsatz der Feuerwehr ausgelöst. Laut Feuerwehr retteten sich vier Personen rechtzeitig und unverletzt aus der betroffenen Wohnung in einem Mehrfamilienhaus in der Schulze-Delitzsch-Straße. Dennoch musste eine Person aus einer anderen Wohnung im Obergeschoss ins Freie geführt werden. Die Feuerwehr löschte den Brand unter Atemschutz und entrauchte die Wohnung mit Überdruckbelüftung. Ein Rauchschutzvorhang verhinderte die Ausbreitung von Rauch und Gasen im Treppenhaus. Weitere Bewohner des Hauses wurden während des Einsatzes von einer Schnelleinsatzgruppe betreut. Die betroffene Wohnung ist derzeit unbewohnbar, die Familie kommt privat unter. Die Polizei hat Ermittlungen zur Brandursache aufgenommen. Sie schätzt den Sachschaden auf etwa 30.000 Euro.

标题: Küchenbrand in Bodelshausen : Feuerwehr rettet zwei Senioren - Region Neckar - A

标题: Champlain Street fire contained to kitchen , no injuries in Brandon
正文: BRANDON — Though no one was reported injured, several people have been displaced by a fire that started, and was kept to, a kitchen in an apartment building on Champlain Street Sunday. Brandon Fire Chief Tom Kilpeck said his department was dispatched to 14 Champlain St. shortly after noon. They were there until about 3 p.m. for a fire that started in the kitchen area of one of three apartment units. Kilpeck said 8-9 people were displaced. Two of the units will be habitable once electricians look over the building and power is restored, but the unit where the fire was may take longer to fix. No pets were reported lost, he said. Vermont State Police fire investigators were at the scene Monday to determine the cause of the fire, said Kilpeck. Besides Brandon, fire departments from Pittsford and Salisbury responded, as did Brandon Rescue and Green Mountain Power, he said.

标题: Winnipeg Apartment Blaze Sends Two to Hospital
正文: Winnipeg firefighters tackled two separate blazes on Thursday, including one that sent multiple people to hospital. Firefighters first responded to a monitored alarm at a three-storey apartment building on Qu’Appelle Avenue just after 6:30 p.m. The fire was brought under control within 30 minutes. Three residents were assessed by paramedics, with two taken to hospital in stable condition. Several cats were also rescued, and emergency social services helped displaced tenants. Investigators believe the fire was accidental, linked to an electrical appliance. Earlier in the afternoon, crews were called to a vacant warehouse fire in the 600 block of Keewatin Street. Heavy smoke and flames forced firefighters to shift from an interior to a defensive attack before the blaze was extinguished at 7:41 p.m. No injuries were reported, and the cause remains under investigation.

标题: 3 hospitalized after fire in eastern Singapore - Xinhua
正文: SINGAPORE, Feb. 19 (Xinhua) -- Three people, including one who sustained burn injuries, were assessed for smoke inhalation and taken to the hospital after a fire broke out early Thursday morning in a residential building in eastern Singapore, the Singapore Civil Defense Force (SCDF) said. A total of six people were rescued. The remaining three did not require ambulance assistance. About 100 people had evacuated on their own before SCDF crews arrived. The fire broke out in a two-story unit on the 14th floor, where crews heard calls for help. Four of the six residents were rescued from the first level and two from the second. The fire, which involved the kitchen and living room on the first level, was extinguished with one water jet. The rest of the unit suffered varying degrees of heat and smoke damage. The SCDF said the cause of the fire is under investigation. ■

标题: Crews battle fire on 10th floor of Lake Avenue apartment building
正文: Crews battle fire on 10th floor of Lake Avenue apartment building ROCHESTER, N.Y. — Multiple fire companies battled flames early Monday morning on the 10th floor of a 15-story apartment building on Lake Avenue. The Rochester Fire Department says it took 36 firefighters about 30 minutes to control the flames at the building between Phelps Avenue and Lorimer Street. Crews arrived around 4:15 a.m., finding heavy smoke in the hallway of the 10th floor and calling in a second alarm. Firefighters evacuated an apartment near the hallway but told other residents to shelter in place. Crews went around checking on residents on the upper floors to make sure they were safe from the smoke. RFD says they contained the damage to the hallway. No one was injured but multiple residents needed to be checked by medics at the scene. The cause of the fire is still under investigation.

标题: Thermal imaging helped crews find fire at SW Kansas power plant
正文: 30FINNEY COUNTY— There were no injuries after fire at a southwest Kanas power plant. Just before 1a.m. Thursday, the Garden City Fire Department was dispatched to a fire at the Sunflower Power Plant, 2440 South Holcomb Lane in Holcomb, according to a media release. After arriving, firefighters observed no signs of smoke or fire on the outside of the power plant, but employees led firefighters inside and reported that the fire was located within the walls at the top of the coal tower. Fire crews used thermal imaging cameras to identify hotspots and subsequently cut trenches into the walls and ceiling before fully extinguishing the fire. It was learned that employees had been performing grinding work on the walls, which is believed to have ignited the insulation and initiated the fire. There were no injuries reported from the incident.

标题: Two dead , 13 injured in apartment building fire in Seoul
正文: SEOUL: (Bernama-Yonhap) Two people were killed and 13 others injured after a fire broke out in an apartment building in Seoul on Sunday (Aug 17), authorities said, Yonhap News Agency reported. The blaze began on the 14th floor of the 20-story building in Seoul's western ward of Mapo at about 8.10 am, forcing 89 residents to evacuate. A woman in her 60s and her 20-something son died in the fire. One person was seriously injured, while the rest sustained minor injuries. The fire agency said it mobilised 252 personnel and 79 vehicles and extinguished the flames at 10.42 am after receiving a report of black smoke from the building. Fire sprinklers were not installed on the 14th floor where the fire started, according to the fire agency. It plans to investigate the exact cause of the fire. - Bernama-Yonhap Thank you for your report!

标题: Utica Fire Crews Battle Fire Inside Boarded - Up Algonquin Building
正文: UTICA, N.Y. -- Firefighters responded to a fire at the former Algonquin apartment building on Genesee Street on Thursday evening after smoke was seen coming from several upper-floor windows. The building has been vacant and boarded up since last year, and the calls for the fire came in just before 6 p.m. When firefighters arrived, they saw smoke coming from the second-, third-, and fourth-floor windows. The deputy fire chief said there was fire in the stairwell between the first and second floors and that the smoke was moderate enough to call it a working fire. He believes squatters were inside the building, and while the exact cause is still under investigation, it is not believed to be intentional. No one was injured. Department of Public Works crews remained at the scene into the evening to board the entrances back up.

标题: Woman injured in fire at Uptown building
正文: A woman suffered smoke inhalation at an overnight fire at an apartment building in the Uptown neighborhood that left seven people, including a child, displaced, Chicago police said. Police responded to a call of a fire shortly before 1:15 a.m. at a residential building in the 4900 block of North Glenwood Avenue in the Uptown neighborhood, police said. Upon their arrival, the fire was extinguished by firefighters at the scene, police said. Officers said multiple people were displaced in the fire, including a child. A woman who had suffered smoke inhalation was taken to Advocate Illinois Masonic Medical Center where she was listed in good condition, police reported. The Red Cross was summoned to the scene. No other injuries were reported in the fire, and the Chicago Fire Department was investigating the cause of the blaze.

标题: No casualties reported in S . Korea building fire - Xinhua
正文: SEOUL, Oct. 21 (Xinhua) -- No casualties were reported Tuesday in a high-rise building fire in South Korea's capital Seoul, which led to the evacuation of more than 100 people, according to Yonhap news agency. The fire broke out at the 16-storey building near Seoul Plaza in front of the Seoul City Hall at around 9:46 a.m. local time (0046 GMT). The blaze was contained about 44 minutes later, with no casualties found from the building, which had been under renovation. A total of 104 workers who were remodeling fled the building, while three received emergency care. Some 10 construction workers, who failed to evacuate due to heavy fumes, were waiting for rescue at the rooftop. Fire authorities estimated that the fire started from the third floor of the building, planning to investigate the exact cause of the accident. ■
